lessons.title: Meeting the new consultant
lessons.scene: أول يوم للاستشاري الجديد في الموقع، وإنت بتعرّفه بنفسك وبشغلك.
dialogue: Good morning. I'm Hassan, the site quantity surveyor.
صباح الخير. أنا حسن، مهندس الكميات في الموقع.
Good morning, Hassan. I'm David from the consultant's office.
صباح الخير يا حسن. أنا ديفيد من مكتب الاستشاري.
Nice to meet you, David. Welcome to the site.
اتشرفت بمعرفتك يا ديفيد. أهلًا بيك في الموقع.
Thank you. What do you do here exactly?
شكرًا. إنت بتعمل إيه هنا بالظبط؟
I measure the work and prepare the payment applications.
Great. So you work closely with the surveyors.
عظيم. يعني بتشتغل قريب جدًا من المساحين.
Yes, every day. We check the levels together.
أيوه، كل يوم. بنراجع المناسيب مع بعض.
Good. I'd like to see the earthworks area first.
تمام. حابب أشوف منطقة الحفريات الأول.
Of course. Let me show you around.
hard: MEZH-er — مِيـجَر (الـ ژ زي الجيم الخفيفة)
read: I'm Hassan, the site quantity surveyor.
I measure the work and prepare the payment applications.
We check the levels together every day.
Welcome to the site, nice to meet you.
Let me show you around the earthworks area.

tasks.q: Introduce yourself to a new engineer and explain your job.
tasks.q_ar: عرّف نفسك لمهندس جديد واشرح شغلك.
tasks.model: Good morning, I'm Hassan, the site quantity surveyor. I measure the work on site and I prepare the payment applications. I work closely with the surveyors.

tasks.q: Offer to show a visitor the site.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض على زائر إنك تفرّجه على الموقع.
tasks.model: Welcome to the site. Let me show you around. We can start with the earthworks area and then visit the stockpiles.

lessons.title: Where do we work today?
lessons.scene: الصبح بدري، بتسأل مهندس الموقع عن أماكن شغل المعدات النهاردة.
dialogue: Morning, Mark. Where are we working today?
صباح الخير يا مارك. إحنا شغالين فين النهاردة؟
Morning. The excavators are in Zone B today.
صباح النور. الحفارات في منطقة B النهاردة.
Are we cutting or filling there?
We're cutting in Zone B and filling in Zone C.
بنقطع في منطقة B وبنردم في منطقة C.
How many trucks do we have?
Eight trucks are working from seven o'clock.
تمان عربيات شغالين من الساعة سبعة.
OK. I'll go to Zone B and count the trips.
تمام. هروح منطقة B وأعدّ النقلات.
Good. Please send me the numbers at lunchtime.
كويس. ابعتلي الأرقام وقت الغدا لو سمحت.
No problem. I'll send them before one o'clock.
مفيش مشكلة. هبعتهم قبل الساعة واحدة.
hard: TRUKS — تْرَكس (من غير ألف في الأول)
read: Where are we working today?
We are cutting in Zone B and filling in Zone C.
Eight trucks are working from seven o'clock.
I will go to Zone B and count the trips.
Please send me the numbers at lunchtime.

tasks.q: Ask the site engineer where the equipment is working today.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل مهندس الموقع المعدات شغالة فين النهاردة.
tasks.model: Good morning. Where are we working today? Are the excavators cutting or filling? How many trucks do we have?

tasks.q: Tell your manager what you will do this morning.
tasks.q_ar: قول لمديرك هتعمل إيه الصبح.
tasks.model: This morning I will go to Zone B and count the truck trips. I will send you the numbers at lunchtime.

lessons.title: Counting trips at the gate
lessons.scene: عند بوابة الموقع، بتراجع مع مسؤول البوابة عدد النقلات وتذاكر الشحن.
dialogue: Hi Tom. How is the counting going?
أهلًا يا توم. العدّ ماشي إزاي؟
Fine. The trucks are coming every ten minutes.
كويس. العربيات بتيجي كل عشر دقايق.
Are you writing the truck numbers on the sheet?
إنت بتكتب أرقام العربيات في الكشف؟
Good. Please check the tickets too.
كويس. راجع التذاكر كمان لو سمحت.
Then write a note next to the truck number.
يبقى اكتب ملاحظة جنب رقم العربية.
OK. When do you need the sheet?
At the end of the shift, please. Thank you.
في آخر الوردية لو سمحت. شكرًا.
phrases: at the end of the shift
hard: DRY-verz — دْرَايـ-ـفَرز (فاء بأسنان فوق الشفة: v)
read: How is the counting going this morning?
Please write the truck numbers on the sheet.
Some drivers forget their tickets.
Write a note next to the truck number.
I need the sheet at the end of the shift.

tasks.q: Ask the gate checker how the counting is going and remind him about the tickets.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل مسؤول البوابة العدّ ماشي إزاي وفكّره بالتذاكر.
tasks.model: Hi Tom, how is the counting going? Please write every truck number on the sheet, and please check the tickets too.

tasks.q: Explain what to do when a driver has no ticket.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح يعمل إيه لو السواق مامعهوش تذكرة.
tasks.model: If a driver has no ticket, write the truck number and add a note next to it. Then tell me at the end of the shift.

lessons.title: Booking a survey
lessons.scene: بتطلب من رئيس فريق المساحة رفع للأرض الطبيعية قبل بداية الحفر.
dialogue: Ali, can your team survey Zone D tomorrow?
يا علي، فريقك يقدر يرفع منطقة D بكرة؟
Tomorrow morning is possible. What do you need?
I need the original ground levels before we start cutting.
محتاج مناسيب الأرض الطبيعية قبل ما نبدأ الحفر.
OK. Do you want a grid survey?
Yes, a grid survey, please. The consultant will join us.
أيوه، رفع شبكي لو سمحت. الاستشاري هييجي معانا.
Please send me the data the same day.
ابعتلي البيانات في نفس اليوم لو سمحت.
I'll send the points file in the evening.
phrases: Can your team survey Zone D?
فريقك يقدر يعمل رفع لمنطقة D؟
read: Can your team survey Zone D tomorrow?
I need the original ground levels before we start cutting.
Yes, a grid survey, please.
The consultant will join us in the morning.
Please send me the data the same day.

tasks.q: Ask the survey team to measure the original ground.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من فريق المساحة يرفع الأرض الطبيعية.
tasks.model: Ali, can your team survey Zone D tomorrow morning? I need the original ground levels before we start cutting. The consultant will join us.

tasks.q: Ask when you will receive the survey data.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل البيانات هتوصلك إمتى.
tasks.model: When can you send me the survey data? I need it the same day, please, because I must prepare the quantities.

lessons.title: Asking the foreman about progress
lessons.scene: بتعدي على مراقب الحفريات تسأله وصلوا لفين النهاردة.
dialogue: Hello Ravi. How is the work today?
أهلًا يا رافي. الشغل عامل إيه النهاردة؟
Good. We finished the first layer in Zone C.
كويس. خلّصنا الطبقة الأولى في منطقة C.
Great. Is the second layer ready to start?
عظيم. الطبقة التانية جاهزة نبدأ فيها؟
Not yet. We are waiting for the water truck.
Why? Is the soil too dry?
Yes, it is very dry today. We need more water.
أيوه، ناشفة جدًا النهاردة. محتاجين مياه أكتر.
I understand. I will call the water supplier.
Thank you. We can start after lunch.
Good. I'll come back in the afternoon.
phrases: I'll come back in the afternoon
read: We finished the first layer in Zone C.
Is the second layer ready to start?
We are waiting for the water truck.
The soil is very dry today.
I will come back in the afternoon.

tasks.q: Ask the foreman about today's progress.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل المراقب عن تقدم الشغل النهاردة.
tasks.model: Hello Ravi, how is the work today? Did you finish the first layer? Is the second layer ready to start?

tasks.q: Explain why the work stopped and what you will do.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الشغل وقف ليه وهتعمل إيه.
tasks.model: The work stopped because the soil is too dry. We are waiting for the water truck. I will call the water supplier now.

lessons.title: Missing drawings
lessons.scene: مكالمة تليفون مع مسؤولة الوثائق عشان رسومات المناسيب الجديدة مش عندك.
dialogue: Hello Sarah, this is Hassan from the site.
أهلًا يا سارة، معاكي حسن من الموقع.
Hi Hassan. How can I help you?
أهلًا يا حسن. أقدر أساعدك إزاي؟
I don't have the latest grading drawings for Zone E.
مش عندي آخر رسومات التسوية لمنطقة E.
Really? They were issued last week.
بجد؟ دي اتصدرت الأسبوع اللي فات.
I only have the old revision.
Sorry about that. I'll email the new revision now.
آسفة على كده. هبعتلك المراجعة الجديدة بالإيميل دلوقتي.
Thank you. Can you also send a printed copy?
شكرًا. ممكن تبعتي نسخة مطبوعة كمان؟
Yes, I'll send it with the driver this afternoon.
أيوه، هبعتها مع السواق بعد الضهر.
That's great. Thanks for your help.
ده كويس جدًا. شكرًا على مساعدتك.
phrases: This is Hassan from the site
read: Hello Sarah, this is Hassan from the site.
I don't have the latest grading drawings.
I only have the old revision.
Can you also send a printed copy?
Thanks for your help this afternoon.

tasks.q: Call the office and ask for the latest drawings.
tasks.q_ar: كلّم المكتب واطلب آخر رسومات.
tasks.model: Hello, this is Hassan from the site. I don't have the latest grading drawings for Zone E. I only have the old revision. Can you email the new one, please?

tasks.q: Ask for a printed copy politely.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب نسخة مطبوعة بأدب.
tasks.model: Thank you. Could you also send a printed copy to the site, please? The foreman needs it this afternoon.

lessons.title: A failed compaction test
lessons.scene: فني المعمل بيبلغك إن اختبار الدمك للطبقة فشل.
dialogue: Hassan, the density test in Zone C failed.
يا حسن، اختبار الكثافة في منطقة C فشل.
The third layer, near the east side.
So we need to add water and compact again.
يعني محتاجين نضيف مياه وندمك تاني.
Yes. Then we can test it again.
OK. I'll tell the foreman now.
Please call me when the layer is ready.
كلّمني لما الطبقة تجهز لو سمحت.
read: The density test in Zone C failed.
The moisture was too low.
We need to add water and compact again.
Then we can test the layer again.
Please call me when the layer is ready.

tasks.q: Tell the foreman that the test failed and what to do.
tasks.q_ar: قول للمراقب إن الاختبار فشل والمطلوب إيه.
tasks.model: Ravi, the density test for the third layer failed because the moisture was too low. Please add water and compact the layer again. Then we will test it again.

tasks.q: Ask the lab technician about the failed test.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل فني المعمل عن الاختبار اللي فشل.
tasks.model: Which layer failed the test? What was the problem? When can you test it again?

lessons.title: Safety first
lessons.scene: مسؤول السلامة بيلاحظ عامل من غير خوذة، وإنت بتساعد.
dialogue: Hassan, that worker has no helmet.
يا حسن، العامل ده مش لابس خوذة.
You're right. I'll talk to him.
And his vest is not on either.
Excuse me, please wear your helmet and vest.
Thank you. Everyone must wear PPE on site.
شكرًا. لازم الكل يلبس معدات الوقاية في الموقع.
I'll remind the team at the morning meeting.
متفقين. مفيش معدات وقاية، مفيش شغل.
read: That worker has no helmet.
Please wear your helmet and vest.
Everyone must wear PPE on site.
I will remind the team at the morning meeting.
Safety comes first, no PPE, no work.

tasks.q: Politely ask a worker to wear his safety equipment.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من عامل بأدب يلبس معدات السلامة.
tasks.model: Excuse me, please wear your helmet and your vest. Everyone must wear PPE on site. Safety comes first.

tasks.q: Tell the team about safety at the morning meeting.
tasks.q_ar: كلّم الفريق عن السلامة في اجتماع الصبح.
tasks.model: Good morning everyone. Please remember, safety comes first. Wear your helmet and vest all the time. No PPE, no work.

lessons.title: The excavator stopped
lessons.scene: الحفار وقف فجأة، وإنت بتسأل الميكانيكي عن المشكلة والمدة.
dialogue: Joe, what's wrong with the excavator?
Yes, but I need a new hose from the store.
أيوه، بس محتاج خرطوم جديد من المخزن.
OK. Meanwhile we'll move the trucks to the other excavator.
تمام. في الوقت ده هننقل العربيات على الحفار التاني.
Good idea. I'll call you when it's ready.
Thanks. I'll write it in the daily report.
read: What is wrong with the excavator?
The hydraulic hose is broken.
How long will it take to fix it?
Meanwhile we will move the trucks.
I will write it in the daily report.

tasks.q: Ask the mechanic about the breakdown and the repair time.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل الميكانيكي عن العطل ومدة التصليح.
tasks.model: Joe, what's wrong with the excavator? Can you fix it today? How long will it take?

tasks.q: Explain to your manager how you will keep working.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح لمديرك هتكملوا الشغل إزاي.
tasks.model: The excavator has a broken hose. It will take about two hours. Meanwhile we moved the trucks to the other excavator, so the work continues.

lessons.title: Today's daily report
lessons.scene: آخر اليوم، مدير المشروع بيسألك إيه اللي اتعمل النهاردة.
dialogue: Hassan, what did we do today?
We cut in Zone B and filled in Zone C.
قطعنا في منطقة B وردمنا في منطقة C.
Yes, one excavator stopped for two hours.
Yes, the mechanic fixed it after lunch.
Two tests passed and one failed. We'll retest tomorrow.
اختبارين نجحوا وواحد فشل. هنعيد الاختبار بكرة.
OK. Please send the report before six.
تمام. ابعت التقرير قبل الساعة ستة لو سمحت.
read: We cut in Zone B and filled in Zone C.
One excavator stopped for two hours.
The mechanic fixed it after lunch.
Two tests passed and one failed.
Please send the report before six.

tasks.q: Give your manager a short daily report.
tasks.q_ar: ادي مديرك تقرير يومي قصير.
tasks.model: Today we cut in Zone B and filled in Zone C. One excavator stopped for two hours, but the mechanic fixed it. Two tests passed and one failed.

tasks.q: Explain what will happen tomorrow.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إيه اللي هيحصل بكرة.
tasks.model: Tomorrow we will retest the failed layer in the morning. Then we will continue filling in Zone C.

lessons.title: Arranging a joint measurement
lessons.scene: بتتفق مع الاستشاري على ميعاد للقياس المشترك قبل المستخلص.
dialogue: David, can we do a joint measurement this week?
يا ديفيد، ينفع نعمل قياس مشترك الأسبوع ده؟
For the cut in Zone B. It's finished.
OK. Is Thursday morning good for you?
Great. I'll bring the survey data and the drawings.
And please bring the previous measurement too.
وهات القياس السابق كمان لو سمحت.
Sure. See you on Thursday at nine.
read: Can we do a joint measurement this week?
The cut in Zone B is finished.
Thursday morning is fine for me.
I will bring the survey data and the drawings.
See you on Thursday at nine.

tasks.q: Ask the consultant for a joint measurement appointment.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من الاستشاري ميعاد لقياس مشترك.
tasks.model: David, the cut in Zone B is finished. Can we do a joint measurement this week? Is Thursday morning good for you?

tasks.q: Confirm the meeting and say what you will bring.
tasks.q_ar: أكّد الميعاد وقول هتجيب معاك إيه.
tasks.model: Thursday at nine is fine. I will bring the survey data, the drawings and the previous measurement. See you on Thursday.

lessons.title: Lunch break small talk
lessons.scene: وقت الغدا مع زميل جديد، كلام خفيف عن الشغل والحياة.
dialogue: Hi Hassan. Is this seat free?
أهلًا يا حسن. الكرسي ده فاضي؟
Yes, please sit down. How are you?
Fine, thanks. It's very hot today.
كويس، شكرًا. الجو حر جدًا النهاردة.
Yes, summer is hard on site.
How long have you worked here?
About six months. Before that I worked in Riyadh on another project.
حوالي ست شهور. قبل كده اشتغلت في الرياض في مشروع تاني.
Yes, the team is good and I learn a lot.
phrases: How long have you worked here?
read: Yes, please sit down here.
It is very hot today.
How long have you worked here?
Before that I worked on another project.
The team is good and I learn a lot.

tasks.q: Start a friendly chat with a new colleague at lunch.
tasks.q_ar: ابدأ كلام ودود مع زميل جديد في الغدا.
tasks.model: Hi, please sit down. How are you? It's very hot today, isn't it? How long have you worked here?

tasks.q: Talk about your work experience in two or three sentences.
tasks.q_ar: اتكلم عن خبرتك في جملتين أو تلاتة.
tasks.model: I have worked here for about six months. Before that I worked in Riyadh on other projects. I like the team and I learn a lot.

lessons.title: Where to put the stockpile
lessons.scene: المراقب بيسألك يحط ناتج الحفر المناسب للردم فين.
dialogue: Hassan, where should we put the good material?
يا حسن، نحط المادة الكويسة فين؟
Put it in the stockpile area near the north gate.
حطها في منطقة التشوين جنب البوابة الشمالية.
No, keep it away from the road. The trucks need space.
لأ، خليها بعيد عن الطريق. العربيات محتاجة مساحة.
OK. How high can the stockpile be?
تمام. الكومة ممكن تبقى عالية قد إيه؟
Keep it low and safe. The safety officer will check it.
خليها واطية وآمنة. مسؤول السلامة هيراجعها.
Put it in a separate pile. Don't mix them.
phrases: keep it away from the road
read: Put the good material in the stockpile area.
Keep it away from the road.
The trucks need space to turn.
Put the bad material in a separate pile.
Please don't mix the two materials.

tasks.q: Tell the foreman where to put the good material.
tasks.q_ar: قول للمراقب يحط المادة الكويسة فين.
tasks.model: Put the good material in the stockpile area near the north gate. Keep it away from the road because the trucks need space.

tasks.q: Explain why the materials must not be mixed.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه المواد ماتتخلطش.
tasks.model: Please put the bad material in a separate pile. Don't mix them, because we can only use the good material for the fill.

lessons.title: Ordering more water
lessons.scene: مكالمة مع مورد عربيات المياه عشان الدمك محتاج مياه أكتر.
dialogue: Hello Hamid, it's Hassan from the earthworks site.
أهلًا يا حامد، معاك حسن من موقع الحفريات.
Hello Hassan. What do you need?
We need two more water trucks today.
Today is difficult. Can it be tomorrow?
Sorry, we need them today. The soil is too dry.
آسف، محتاجينهم النهاردة. التربة ناشفة أوي.
OK, I can send one truck at noon and one at three.
تمام، أقدر أبعت عربية الضهر وواحدة الساعة تلاتة.
That's fine. Please ask the drivers to call me at the gate.
ماشي. خلّي السواقين يكلموني عند البوابة.
Sure. I'll send you their phone numbers.
phrases: Please ask the drivers to call me
read: We need two more water trucks today.
Sorry, we need them today.
The soil is too dry for compaction.
Please ask the drivers to call me at the gate.
Thank you very much for your help.

tasks.q: Call the supplier and ask for more water trucks today.
tasks.q_ar: كلّم المورد واطلب عربيات مياه زيادة النهاردة.
tasks.model: Hello Hamid, it's Hassan from the site. We need two more water trucks today, because the soil is too dry for compaction.

tasks.q: Politely refuse to wait until tomorrow.
tasks.q_ar: ارفض بأدب تستنى لبكرة.
tasks.model: Sorry, tomorrow is too late. We need them today, because the compaction will stop without water.

lessons.title: Dust on the haul road
lessons.scene: مسؤول السلامة بيشتكي من التراب الكتير على طريق النقل.
dialogue: Hassan, there is too much dust on the haul road.
يا حسن، فيه تراب كتير أوي على طريق النقل.
Yes, I saw it this morning. The trucks are fast.
أيوه، شفته الصبح. العربيات ماشية بسرعة.
The drivers can't see well. It's dangerous.
السواقين مش شايفين كويس. ده خطر.
I agree. We'll spray the road with water every hour.
موافقك. هنرش الطريق مياه كل ساعة.
Good. And please tell the drivers to slow down.
كويس. وقول للسواقين يهدّوا السرعة لو سمحت.
I'll ask the foreman to remind them.
Thank you. I'll check again in the afternoon.
OK. Tell me if it's still dusty.
تمام. قولي لو لسه فيه تراب.
hard: SPRAY — سْپْرِي (من غير ألف في الأول)
read: There is too much dust on the haul road.
The drivers cannot see well.
We will spray the road with water every hour.
Please tell the drivers to slow down.
Tell me if it is still dusty.

tasks.q: Agree with the safety officer and say what you will do.
tasks.q_ar: وافق مسؤول السلامة وقول هتعمل إيه.
tasks.model: I agree, the dust is dangerous. We will spray the haul road with water every hour, and I will ask the drivers to slow down.

tasks.q: Ask the foreman to talk to the drivers.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من المراقب يكلم السواقين.
tasks.model: Ravi, please remind the drivers to slow down on the haul road. There is too much dust and they can't see well.

lessons.title: Cut and fill in simple words
lessons.scene: مهندس متدرب جديد بيسألك يعني إيه قطع وردم.
dialogue: Hassan, what does cut and fill mean?
يا حسن، يعني إيه قطع وردم؟
Cut means we remove soil from high areas.
القطع يعني بنشيل تربة من الأماكن العالية.
Fill means we put soil in low areas.
الردم يعني بنحط تربة في الأماكن الواطية.
Where does the fill material come from?
Usually from the cut. We use the good material again.
غالبًا من القطع. بنستخدم المادة الكويسة تاني.
Exactly. A good balance saves time and money.
بالظبط. الموازنة الكويسة بتوفر وقت وفلوس.
read: Cut means we remove soil from high areas.
Fill means we put soil in low areas.
Usually the fill material comes from the cut.
We use the good material again.
A good balance saves time and money.

tasks.q: Explain cut and fill to a new trainee.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح القطع والردم لمتدرب جديد.
tasks.model: Cut means we remove soil from the high areas. Fill means we put soil in the low areas. Usually we use the cut material for the fill.

tasks.q: Explain why balancing cut and fill is important.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه موازنة القطع والردم مهمة.
tasks.model: If we balance cut and fill, we don't need to buy or remove a lot of soil. A good balance saves time and money.

lessons.title: Checking levels with the surveyor
lessons.scene: إنت والمساح بتراجعوا المناسيب بعد طبقة ردم.
dialogue: Ali, did you check the levels in Zone C?
يا علي، راجعت المناسيب في منطقة C؟
Most points? What about the others?
Three points are a little high.
About five centimetres above the design level.
حوالي خمسة سنتي فوق منسوب التصميم.
Then we need to trim those areas.
I'll mark them with red pegs.
Good. I'll tell the grader operator.
read: Did you check the levels in Zone C?
Most points are OK in Zone C.
Three points are a little high.
We need to trim those areas.
I will tell the grader operator.

tasks.q: Ask the surveyor about the level check results.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل المساح عن نتيجة مراجعة المناسيب.
tasks.model: Ali, did you check the levels? Are all the points OK? Which points are high or low?

tasks.q: Tell the grader operator what to do.
tasks.q_ar: قول لسواق الجريدر يعمل إيه.
tasks.model: Some points are a little high. Please trim the areas with the red pegs to the design level.

lessons.title: Asking approval for a layer
lessons.scene: بتطلب من الاستشاري يعاين الطبقة ويعتمدها عشان تكملوا.
dialogue: David, the fourth layer in Zone C is ready.
يا ديفيد، الطبقة الرابعة في منطقة C جاهزة.
Did it pass the density tests?
Yes, all tests passed this morning.
The surveyor checked them. They are within tolerance.
Good. Please send me the request for inspection.
كويس. ابعتلي طلب المعاينة لو سمحت.
I sent it at ten o'clock.
OK. I'll come to inspect at one.
Thank you. We'll wait for your approval before the next layer.
شكرًا. هنستنى اعتمادك قبل الطبقة اللي بعدها.
read: The fourth layer in Zone C is ready.
All tests passed this morning.
The levels are within tolerance.
Please check the request for inspection.
We will wait for your approval.

tasks.q: Ask the consultant to inspect and approve a layer.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من الاستشاري يعاين ويعتمد طبقة.
tasks.model: David, the fourth layer is ready. All density tests passed and the levels are within tolerance. Can you come to inspect it today?

tasks.q: Explain that you will not start the next layer before approval.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح إنك مش هتبدأ الطبقة اللي بعدها قبل الاعتماد.
tasks.model: We will not start the next layer before your approval. We will wait for your inspection.

lessons.title: A sandstorm delay
lessons.scene: عاصفة رملية وقفت الشغل، وبتبلغ مدير المشروع.
dialogue: Khaled, we stopped work at eleven because of the sandstorm.
يا خالد، وقفنا الشغل الساعة حداشر بسبب العاصفة الرملية.
Yes, everyone is safe. The workers are in the rest area.
أيوه، الكل بخير. العمال في منطقة الاستراحة.
Good. How long will it last?
The weather report says until four o'clock.
النشرة الجوية بتقول لحد الساعة أربعة.
Then we lose half a day.
Yes. I'll record it in the daily report with photos.
أيوه. هسجّلها في التقرير اليومي بالصور.
Good. We may need it for an extension of time.
I understand. I'll keep all the records.
read: We stopped work because of the sandstorm.
Everyone is safe in the rest area.
The weather report says until four o'clock.
I will record it in the daily report.
I will keep all the records and photos.

tasks.q: Report a weather stoppage to your manager.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ مديرك بتوقف الشغل بسبب الجو.
tasks.model: We stopped work at eleven because of a sandstorm. Everyone is safe. The weather report says it will last until four o'clock.

tasks.q: Explain why you keep records of delays.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه بتحتفظ بسجلات التأخير.
tasks.model: I record every stoppage in the daily report with photos. We may need these records for an extension of time.

lessons.title: The subcontractor is late
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن بدأ متأخر النهاردة، وإنت بتسأله ليه.
dialogue: Faisal, your trucks started at nine today.
يا فيصل، عربياتك بدأت الساعة تسعة النهاردة.
Yes, sorry. We had a problem at the camp.
أيوه، آسف. كان عندنا مشكلة في السكن.
The start time is seven. We lost two hours.
I know. It won't happen again.
Please call me next time if there is a problem.
كلّمني المرة الجاية لو فيه مشكلة.
Thank you. Can you work late today to catch up?
شكرًا. تقدروا تشتغلوا لحد متأخر النهاردة عشان تعوّضوا؟
Yes, we can work until seven.
Good. I'll inform the project manager.
read: Your trucks started at nine today.
The start time is seven o'clock.
Please call me next time if there is a problem.
Can you work late today to catch up?
I will inform the project manager.

tasks.q: Tell the subcontractor that he started late, politely but clearly.
tasks.q_ar: قول لمقاول الباطن إنه بدأ متأخر بأدب ووضوح.
tasks.model: Faisal, your trucks started at nine today, but the start time is seven. We lost two hours. Please call me next time if there is a problem.

tasks.q: Ask him to recover the lost time.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب منه يعوض الوقت الضايع.
tasks.model: Can your team work late today to catch up? We need to finish the fill in Zone C this week.

lessons.title: Following up the payment application
lessons.scene: بتسأل مهندسة الكميات عند الاستشاري عن مراجعة المستخلص.
dialogue: Hello Nadia. Did you receive our payment application?
أهلًا يا نادية. وصلك المستخلص بتاعنا؟
Yes, we received it on Sunday.
When do you think you can finish the review?
Maybe next Tuesday. I have some questions.
يمكن الثلاثاء الجاي. عندي شوية أسئلة.
I need the survey data for the fill quantities.
I'll send it to you today.
Thank you. That will help a lot.
You're welcome. Please call me if you need anything else.
العفو. كلّميني لو احتجتي أي حاجة تانية.
phrases: When can you finish the review?
read: Did you receive our payment application?
When can you finish the review?
I will send you the survey data today.
That will help a lot.
Please call me if you need anything else.

tasks.q: Ask the consultant's QS about the review of your payment application.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل كميات الاستشاري عن مراجعة المستخلص.
tasks.model: Hello Nadia, did you receive our payment application? When do you think you can finish the review? Do you need any information from us?

tasks.q: Offer to send supporting documents.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض تبعت المستندات الداعمة.
tasks.model: I can send you the survey data and the measurement sheets today. Please call me if you need anything else.

lessons.title: Extra fill is needed
lessons.scene: مهندس الموقع بيقولك المنسوب الجديد محتاج ردم زيادة عن المخطط.
dialogue: Hassan, the new drawing raises the level in Zone F.
يا حسن، الرسمة الجديدة رفعت المنسوب في منطقة F.
So we need more fill than before.
يعني محتاجين ردم أكتر من الأول.
This is a change. We need a written instruction.
The consultant will send it this week.
Good. Until then, I'll keep a record of the extra quantities.
كويس. لحد ما توصل، هسجّل الكميات الزيادة.
Should we start the work now?
Let's ask the project manager first.
read: The new drawing raises the level in Zone F.
We need more fill than before.
This is a change, so we need a written instruction.
I will keep a record of the extra quantities.
Let's ask the project manager first.

tasks.q: Explain that the new level is a change to the contract work.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إن المنسوب الجديد تغيير في الشغل.
tasks.model: The new drawing raises the level, so we need more fill than before. This is a change. We need a written instruction from the consultant.

tasks.q: Say what you will do until the instruction arrives.
tasks.q_ar: قول هتعمل إيه لحد ما التعليمات توصل.
tasks.model: Until the instruction arrives, I will keep a record of the extra quantities with survey data, and I will ask the project manager before we start.

lessons.title: Please put it in writing
lessons.scene: الاستشاري بيدّي تعليمات شفوية، وإنت بتطلبها مكتوبة بأدب.
dialogue: Hassan, please move the stockpile to the south side.
يا حسن، انقل الكومة للجهة الجنوبية لو سمحت.
OK. Is this an instruction from you?
Yes, we need the north area free.
Could you please send it in writing?
Yes, it costs extra trucks and time. We need it for our records.
أيوه، بتكلّف عربيات ووقت زيادة. محتاجينها لسجلاتنا.
I understand. I'll send a site instruction today.
Thank you, David. We'll start when we receive it.
شكرًا يا ديفيد. هنبدأ لما توصلنا.
phrases: Could you please send it in writing?
read: Is this an instruction from you?
Could you please send it in writing?
It costs extra trucks and time.
We need it for our records.
We will start when we receive it.

tasks.q: Politely ask the consultant to confirm an instruction in writing.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من الاستشاري بأدب يأكد التعليمات كتابة.
tasks.model: Could you please send this instruction in writing? It costs extra trucks and time, so we need it for our records.

tasks.q: Explain when you will start the work.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح هتبدأ الشغل إمتى.
tasks.model: We will start moving the stockpile as soon as we receive the site instruction.

lessons.title: A short update in the weekly meeting
lessons.scene: في الاجتماع الأسبوعي، المدير بيطلب منك تحديث سريع.
dialogue: Hassan, can you give us a quick update?
يا حسن، تقدر تدّينا تحديث سريع؟
Sure. This week we finished the cut in Zone B.
أكيد. الأسبوع ده خلّصنا القطع في منطقة B.
The fill in Zone C is about half done.
الردم في منطقة C حوالي النص خلص.
Two issues. The water supply and one excavator breakdown.
Yes, both are solved now. Next week we'll finish Zone C.
أيوه، الاتنين اتحلّوا. الأسبوع الجاي هنخلّص منطقة C.
Thank you, Hassan. Clear and short.
read: This week we finished the cut in Zone B.
The fill in Zone C is about half done.
We had two issues this week.
Both issues are solved now.
Next week we will finish Zone C.

tasks.q: Give a short weekly update in the meeting.
tasks.q_ar: ادي تحديث أسبوعي قصير في الاجتماع.
tasks.model: This week we finished the cut in Zone B. The fill in Zone C is about half done. Next week we will finish Zone C.

tasks.q: Mention the problems and say they are solved.
tasks.q_ar: اذكر المشاكل وقول إنها اتحلت.
tasks.model: We had two issues, the water supply and an excavator breakdown. Both are solved now.

lessons.title: Calling about a fuel delivery
lessons.scene: الديزل اتأخر والمعدات هتقف، وإنت بتكلّم المورد.
dialogue: Hello Yusuf, the fuel truck didn't come this morning.
أهلًا يا يوسف، عربية الوقود ماجتش الصبح.
Sorry, the driver had a problem with the truck.
آسف، السواق كان عنده مشكلة في العربية.
Our machines will stop at midday without fuel.
المعدات بتاعتنا هتقف الضهر من غير وقود.
I understand. I'll send another truck now.
OK. Please send the delivery note with the driver.
تمام. ابعت إذن التسليم مع السواق لو سمحت.
No problem. Thank you for the quick help.
مفيش مشكلة. شكرًا على المساعدة السريعة.
read: The fuel truck did not come this morning.
Our machines will stop at midday without fuel.
When will the truck arrive?
Please send the delivery note with the driver.
Thank you for the quick help.

tasks.q: Call the supplier about a late fuel delivery.
tasks.q_ar: كلّم المورد عن تأخير الوقود.
tasks.model: Hello Yusuf, the fuel truck didn't come this morning. Our machines will stop at midday without fuel. When can you send it?

tasks.q: Ask for the delivery note and thank him.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب إذن التسليم واشكره.
tasks.model: Please send the delivery note with the driver. Thank you for the quick help.

lessons.title: Welcoming a new worker
lessons.scene: عامل جديد أول يوم، وإنت بتشرحله الأساسيات.
dialogue: Welcome, Bilal. Is this your first day?
أهلًا يا بلال. ده أول يوم ليك؟
Yes, sir. I'm a little nervous.
أيوه يا فندم. أنا متوتر شوية.
Don't worry. First, always wear your PPE.
ماتقلقش. أول حاجة، البس معدات الوقاية دايمًا.
OK. Where is the rest area?
It's next to the site office, under the big shade.
جنب مكتب الموقع، تحت المظلة الكبيرة.
Ravi is your supervisor. Ask him if you have any questions.
رافي هو المشرف بتاعك. اسأله لو عندك أي أسئلة.
Thank you. What time do we start?
We start at seven and finish at five.
read: Welcome, is this your first day?
Don't worry, always wear your PPE.
The rest area is next to the site office.
Ask your supervisor if you have any questions.
We start at seven and finish at five.

tasks.q: Welcome a new worker and explain the basic rules.
tasks.q_ar: رحّب بعامل جديد واشرحله القواعد الأساسية.
tasks.model: Welcome to the site. Always wear your PPE. The rest area is next to the site office. We start at seven and finish at five.

tasks.q: Tell him who to ask for help.
tasks.q_ar: قوله يسأل مين لو احتاج مساعدة.
tasks.model: Your supervisor is Ravi. If you have any questions, ask him. You can also call me.

lessons.title: Checking delivery tickets
lessons.scene: بتراجع مع مسؤول البوابة تذاكر توريد الردم المستورد.
dialogue: Tom, can I see today's delivery tickets?
يا توم، ممكن أشوف تذاكر التوريد بتاعة النهاردة؟
Here they are. Forty tickets so far.
اتفضل أهم. أربعين تذكرة لحد دلوقتي.
This ticket has no truck number.
Oh, the driver forgot to write it.
And this one has no signature.
We can't pay without complete tickets.
مانقدرش ندفع من غير تذاكر كاملة.
I understand. I'll check every ticket at the gate.
فاهم. هراجع كل تذكرة عند البوابة.
Thank you. Accurate tickets mean accurate payments.
شكرًا. تذاكر دقيقة يعني مدفوعات دقيقة.
read: Can I see today's delivery tickets?
This ticket has no truck number.
This one has no signature.
We cannot pay without complete tickets.
Accurate tickets mean accurate payments.

tasks.q: Point out problems in the delivery tickets.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح المشاكل في تذاكر التوريد.
tasks.model: This ticket has no truck number, and this one has no signature. We can't pay without complete tickets.

tasks.q: Ask the gate checker to check every ticket.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من مسؤول البوابة يراجع كل تذكرة.
tasks.model: Please check every ticket at the gate. Make sure it has the truck number, the time and the signature.

lessons.title: Reading the drawing
lessons.scene: المتدرب مش فاهم الخطوط والأرقام في رسمة التسوية.
dialogue: Hassan, what are these lines on the drawing?
يا حسن، إيه الخطوط دي اللي على الرسمة؟
They are contour lines. They show the ground levels.
دي خطوط كنتور. بتوضّح مناسيب الأرض.
They are the finished levels after grading.
How do I know where to cut?
Compare the existing level with the finished level.
If the existing level is higher, we cut?
Exactly. And if it's lower, we fill.
read: These are contour lines on the drawing.
They show the ground levels.
These numbers are the finished levels.
Compare the existing level with the finished level.
If it is higher we cut, and if it is lower we fill.

tasks.q: Explain contour lines and levels to a trainee.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح خطوط الكنتور والمناسيب لمتدرب.
tasks.model: These are contour lines. They show the ground levels. The numbers are the finished levels after grading.

tasks.q: Explain how to decide between cut and fill.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إزاي تقرر قطع ولا ردم.
tasks.model: Compare the existing level with the finished level. If the existing level is higher, we cut. If it is lower, we fill.

lessons.title: Rejecting bad material
lessons.scene: لقيت صخور كبيرة في مادة الردم، وبتطلب من مقاول الباطن يشيلها.
dialogue: Faisal, look at this material. There are big rocks in it.
يا فيصل، بص على المادة دي. فيها صخور كبيرة.
They are bigger than the specification allows.
So what do you want us to do?
Please remove the big rocks before you spread the layer.
شيل الصخور الكبيرة قبل ما تفرد الطبقة لو سمحت.
I know, but the consultant will reject the layer.
OK. I'll put two workers on it.
read: There are big rocks in this material.
They are bigger than the specification allows.
Please remove the big rocks before you spread the layer.
The consultant will reject the layer.
Thank you, quality comes first.

tasks.q: Tell the subcontractor that the material is not acceptable.
tasks.q_ar: قول لمقاول الباطن إن المادة مش مقبولة.
tasks.model: Look at this material. There are big rocks, bigger than the specification allows. The consultant will reject the layer.

tasks.q: Ask him to fix the problem.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب منه يصلح المشكلة.
tasks.model: Please remove the big rocks before you spread the layer. I know it will slow you down, but quality comes first.

lessons.title: Asking for clarification
lessons.scene: الاستشارية بتتكلم بسرعة في مكالمة، وإنت محتاج توضيح.
dialogue: We deducted part of item five because of the missing records.
خصمنا جزء من البند خمسة بسبب السجلات الناقصة.
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
آسف، ممكن تعيدي الكلام أبطأ شوية؟
Of course. We deducted part of item five.
طبعًا. خصمنا جزء من البند خمسة.
The density test reports for two layers.
I see. So if I send the reports, will you add it back?
فهمت. يعني لو بعت التقارير، هترجّعوه؟
Thank you. Let me repeat: I send the reports, and you review item five again.
شكرًا. خليني أعيد: أنا أبعت التقارير، وإنتي تراجعي البند خمسة تاني.
read: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
Which records are missing for item five?
The density test reports are missing.
Let me repeat to make sure.
You will review item five again.

tasks.q: Ask someone to repeat and explain.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من حد يعيد ويوضح.
tasks.model: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly? Which records are missing exactly?

tasks.q: Repeat the agreement to confirm you understood.
tasks.q_ar: أعد الاتفاق عشان تتأكد إنك فهمت.
tasks.model: Let me repeat to make sure. I will send the density reports today, and you will review item five again.

lessons.title: Night shift handover
lessons.scene: نهاية اليوم، بتسلّم مهندس وردية الليل المطلوب منه.
dialogue: Ahmed, here is the plan for tonight.
Continue the fill in Zone C, layers five and six.
كمّل الردم في منطقة C، الطبقتين خمسة وستة.
Yes, the lighting tower near the gate is broken. Use the small one.
أيوه، برج الإنارة اللي جنب البوابة عطلان. استخدم الصغير.
Got it. And the water truck?
It comes at nine. Please call me only for emergencies.
بتيجي الساعة تسعة. كلّمني في الطوارئ بس لو سمحت.
read: Here is the plan for tonight.
Continue the fill in Zone C.
The lighting tower near the gate is broken.
The water truck comes at nine.
Please call me only for emergencies.

tasks.q: Hand over the work plan to the night shift engineer.
tasks.q_ar: سلّم خطة الشغل لمهندس الليل.
tasks.model: Here is the plan for tonight. Continue the fill in Zone C with six trucks and two rollers. The water truck comes at nine.

tasks.q: Warn him about a problem on site.
tasks.q_ar: نبّهه على مشكلة في الموقع.
tasks.model: Be careful, the lighting tower near the gate is broken. Please use the small tower. Call me only for emergencies.

lessons.title: Measuring a drainage trench
lessons.scene: بتقيسوا خندق تصريف مؤقت اتحفر بتعليمات الاستشاري.
dialogue: Ali, we need to measure the drainage trench today.
يا علي، محتاجين نقيس خندق التصريف النهاردة.
Yes, from the road to the pond.
I'll take a section every twenty metres.
Good. Please measure the depth and the width.
كويس. قيس العمق والعرض لو سمحت.
Should I include the side slopes?
Yes, include the slopes. We need the real volume.
أيوه، دخّل الميول. محتاجين الحجم الحقيقي.
OK. I'll send you the sections tomorrow.
Thanks. This trench is extra work, so the records are important.
شكرًا. الخندق ده شغل إضافي، فالسجلات مهمة.
read: We need to measure the drainage trench today.
Please measure the depth and the width.
Include the side slopes in the sections.
We need the real volume.
This trench is extra work, so the records are important.

tasks.q: Tell the surveyor how to measure the trench.
tasks.q_ar: قول للمساح يقيس الخندق إزاي.
tasks.model: Please measure the trench from the road to the pond. Take a section every twenty metres and include the depth, width and side slopes.

tasks.q: Explain why good records are important for extra work.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه السجلات الكويسة مهمة للشغل الإضافي.
tasks.model: This trench is extra work. We need accurate records and sections, because we will ask for payment for it.

lessons.title: Why is production low?
lessons.scene: المدير لاحظ إن الإنتاج قليل الأسبوع ده وبيسألك عن السبب.
dialogue: Hassan, production is low this week. Why?
يا حسن، الإنتاج قليل الأسبوع ده. ليه؟
First, the haul road is long because of the new route.
أولًا، طريق النقل طويل بسبب المسار الجديد.
Second, two trucks are in the workshop.
Third, the water supply was late twice.
Two more trucks for next week, and a second water supplier.
عربيتين زيادة للأسبوع الجاي، ومورد مياه تاني.
read: Production is low this week.
There are three reasons for this.
First, the haul road is long.
Second, two trucks are in the workshop.
I suggest two more trucks for next week.

tasks.q: Explain the reasons for low production.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح أسباب الإنتاج القليل.
tasks.model: There are three reasons. First, the haul road is long. Second, two trucks are in the workshop. Third, the water supply was late.

tasks.q: Suggest a solution to your manager.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح حل لمديرك.
tasks.model: I suggest two more trucks for next week and a second water supplier. Then production will go up.

lessons.title: Closing a meeting
lessons.scene: آخر الاجتماع، بتلخّص الاتفاقات وتشكر الحاضرين.
dialogue: Before we finish, let me summarize.
First, the joint measurement is on Thursday.
Second, you'll send the site instruction for the stockpile.
ثانيًا، إنت هتبعت تعليمات الموقع بخصوص الكومة.
Third, we'll send the test reports tomorrow.
ثالثًا، إحنا هنبعت تقارير الاختبارات بكرة.
Thank you all for your time. See you next week.
شكرًا لكم كلكم على وقتكم. نشوفكم الأسبوع الجاي.
phrases: Thank you all for your time
read: Before we finish, let me summarize.
The joint measurement is on Thursday.
You will send the site instruction today.
We will send the test reports tomorrow.
Thank you all for your time.

tasks.q: Summarize three agreements at the end of a meeting.
tasks.q_ar: لخّص تلات اتفاقات في آخر الاجتماع.
tasks.model: Let me summarize. First, the joint measurement is on Thursday. Second, you will send the site instruction. Third, we will send the test reports.

tasks.q: Close the meeting politely.
tasks.q_ar: اختم الاجتماع بأدب.
tasks.model: Thank you all for your time. I will send the minutes today. See you next week.

lessons.title: Describing your job in an interview
lessons.scene: مقابلة شغل بسيطة، بتسألك عن شغلك الحالي.
dialogue: Tell me about your current job.
I'm a site quantity surveyor on a large earthworks project.
أنا مهندس كميات موقع في مشروع حفريات كبير.
I measure the work, check quantities and prepare payment applications.
بقيس الشغل وبراجع الكميات وبجهّز المستخلصات.
Do you work with a team?
Yes, with surveyors, engineers and subcontractors.
أيوه، مع المساحين والمهندسين ومقاولي الباطن.
I'm accurate and I know survey software well.
أنا دقيق وبعرف برامج المساحة كويس.
Thank you, Hassan. That's very clear.
شكرًا يا حسن. ده واضح جدًا.
read: I am a site quantity surveyor on a large project.
I measure the work and check quantities.
I prepare the payment applications.
I work with surveyors and subcontractors.
I am accurate and I know survey software well.

tasks.q: Describe your current job in an interview.
tasks.q_ar: اوصف شغلك الحالي في مقابلة.
tasks.model: I'm a site quantity surveyor on a large earthworks project. I measure the work, check the quantities and prepare the payment applications.

tasks.q: Talk about your strengths.
tasks.q_ar: اتكلم عن نقاط قوتك.
tasks.model: My strengths are accuracy and survey skills. I know Civil 3D and survey software well, and I work well with the site team.

lessons.title: A full day on site (review)
lessons.scene: مراجعة للمستوى: المدير بيسألك عن يومك من أوله لآخره.
dialogue: Hassan, tell me about your day.
In the morning I checked the trucks at the gate.
Then I checked the levels with the surveyor in Zone C.
بعدين راجعت المناسيب مع المساح في منطقة C.
One density test failed, but the retest passed after lunch.
اختبار كثافة واحد فشل، بس الإعادة نجحت بعد الغدا.
We agreed on the joint measurement for Thursday.
اتفقنا على القياس المشترك يوم الخميس.
Excellent. What's the plan for tomorrow?
Tomorrow we'll start the cut in Zone D after the survey.
بكرة هنبدأ القطع في منطقة D بعد الرفع المساحي.
read: In the morning I checked the trucks at the gate.
Then I checked the levels with the surveyor.
One density test failed, but the retest passed.
We agreed on the joint measurement for Thursday.
Tomorrow we will start the cut in Zone D.

tasks.q: Describe your working day from morning to evening.
tasks.q_ar: اوصف يوم شغلك من الصبح للمسا.
tasks.model: In the morning I checked the trucks at the gate. Then I checked the levels with the surveyor. In the afternoon I prepared the daily report.

tasks.q: Explain the plan for tomorrow.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح خطة بكرة.
tasks.model: Tomorrow we will survey Zone D in the morning. After the survey we will start the cut, and we will continue the fill in Zone C.

lessons.title: Explaining a variation
lessons.scene: بتشرح للاستشاري ليه رفع المنسوب في منطقة F يعتبر تغيير مش شغل أصلي.
dialogue: David, I'd like to talk about the new levels in Zone F.
ديفيد، حابب نتكلم عن المناسيب الجديدة في منطقة F.
Sure. The revised drawing was issued last week.
أكيد. الرسمة المعدّلة اتصدرت الأسبوع اللي فات.
Yes, and it raises the finished level across the whole zone.
أيوه، وهي بترفع المنسوب النهائي في المنطقة كلها.
Is that a big change for you?
It is. We need a lot more fill than the original design.
أيوه. محتاجين ردم أكتر بكتير من التصميم الأصلي.
But the fill item is already in the bill of quantities.
بس بند الردم موجود أصلًا في جدول الكميات.
That's true, but the extra quantity comes from a design change, not from our mistake.
صحيح، بس الكمية الزيادة جاية من تغيير في التصميم، مش من غلطة عندنا.
I see your point. What do you need from us?
فاهم وجهة نظرك. محتاجين مننا إيه؟
A formal instruction, so we can treat it as a variation.
تعليمات رسمية، عشان نتعامل معاها كأمر تغيير.
OK. Send me your quantities with the survey sections.
تمام. ابعتلي الكميات بتاعتك مع القطاعات المساحية.
I'll send them by Thursday, together with the drawing comparison.
هبعتها قبل الخميس، ومعاها مقارنة الرسومات.
phrases: a design change, not our mistake
تغيير في التصميم مش غلطة مننا
read: The revised drawing raises the finished level across the whole zone.
The extra quantity comes from a design change, not from our mistake.
We need a formal instruction, so we can treat it as a variation.
Send me your quantities with the survey sections.
I will send them by Thursday with the drawing comparison.

tasks.q: Explain to the consultant why the extra fill is a variation.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح للاستشاري ليه الردم الزيادة أمر تغيير.
tasks.model: The revised drawing raises the finished level in Zone F. We need much more fill than the original design. This extra quantity comes from a design change, not from our mistake, so it should be treated as a variation.

tasks.q: Ask for a formal instruction and say what you will submit.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب تعليمات رسمية وقول هتقدم إيه.
tasks.model: Could you please issue a formal instruction for this change? I will send you the quantities, the survey sections and a comparison between the old and new drawings by Thursday.

lessons.title: Disagreeing about a quantity
lessons.scene: الاستشارية قاست كمية قطع أقل من قياسك، وإنت بتعترض بأدب.
dialogue: Hassan, our measurement for the cut in Zone B is lower than yours.
حسن، قياسنا للقطع في منطقة B أقل من قياسكم.
I noticed that. Can we compare the two calculations?
Of course. We used the latest survey of the finished surface.
طبعًا. إحنا استخدمنا آخر رفع للسطح النهائي.
So did we. I think the difference is in the original ground.
وإحنا كمان. أعتقد الفرق في الأرض الطبيعية.
We used the original ground from the tender drawings.
إحنا استخدمنا الأرض الطبيعية من رسومات المناقصة.
That's the problem. We have a joint survey of the original ground, signed by your engineer.
هي دي المشكلة. عندنا رفع مشترك للأرض الطبيعية، موقّع من مهندسكم.
Really? I didn't see it in the submission.
It's in appendix three. I can send you a copy now.
موجود في الملحق تلاتة. أقدر أبعتلك نسخة دلوقتي.
Please do. If it's signed, we'll use it.
ابعتها لو سمحت. لو موقّع، هنستخدمه.
Thank you. I'm sure the numbers will match after that.
شكرًا. متأكد إن الأرقام هتتطابق بعدها.
phrases: Can we compare the two calculations?
I think the difference is in
read: Our measurement for the cut is lower than yours.
Can we compare the two calculations?
I think the difference is in the original ground.
We have a joint survey signed by your engineer.
I am sure the numbers will match after that.

tasks.q: Politely disagree with the consultant's measurement.
tasks.q_ar: اعترض بأدب على قياس الاستشاري.
tasks.model: I noticed that your measurement is lower than ours. I think the difference is in the original ground. We have a joint survey signed by your engineer, so I suggest we use it.

tasks.q: Suggest a way to solve the disagreement.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح طريقة تحل الخلاف.
tasks.model: Can we compare the two calculations together? I will send you the signed joint survey now, and then we can check the numbers again.

lessons.title: Chasing an unpaid payment
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن بيشتكي إن مستحقاته متأخرة، وإنت بتتابع مع مدير المشروع.
dialogue: Khaled, do you have a minute? It's about the subcontractor's payment.
خالد، عندك دقيقة؟ الموضوع عن دفعة مقاول الباطن.
The haulage subcontractor. Their invoice for last month is still unpaid.
مقاول النقل. فاتورتهم للشهر اللي فات لسه ماتدفعتش.
I thought finance paid it last week.
كنت فاكر المالية دفعتها الأسبوع اللي فات.
No, it's still waiting for your approval in the system.
لأ، لسه مستنية اعتمادك على السيستم.
Oh, I missed that. Is everything checked?
Yes, I checked the quantities against the delivery tickets.
أيوه، راجعت الكميات على تذاكر التوريد.
Thank you. They said they may slow down if the payment is late.
شكرًا. قالوا ممكن يبطّأوا لو الدفعة اتأخرت.
We can't afford that. Tell them it will be paid this week.
مانقدرش نتحمل ده. قولهم هتتدفع الأسبوع ده.
read: Their invoice for last month is still unpaid.
It is still waiting for your approval in the system.
I checked the quantities against the delivery tickets.
They may slow down if the payment is late.
Tell them it will be paid this week.

tasks.q: Remind your manager about a late subcontractor payment.
tasks.q_ar: فكّر مديرك بدفعة مقاول باطن متأخرة.
tasks.model: Do you have a minute? The haulage subcontractor's invoice for last month is still unpaid. It's waiting for your approval in the system. I already checked the quantities.

tasks.q: Explain the risk if the payment stays late.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الخطر لو الدفعة فضلت متأخرة.
tasks.model: If the payment is late, they may slow down or reduce the trucks. That will affect our production, so it's better to approve it this week.

lessons.title: A call with an American consultant
lessons.scene: مكالمة مع استشاري تصميم بلكنة أمريكية عن ميول التصريف.
dialogue: Hey Hassan, this is Brian from the design team. Got a minute?
أهلًا حسن، معاك برايان من فريق التصميم. معاك دقيقة؟
We're reviewing the grading near the east boundary. The drainage slope looks too flat.
بنراجع التسوية جنب الحد الشرقي. ميل التصريف شكله ضعيف أوي.
We built it exactly to the drawing.
I know, it's on our side. We might revise the levels a bit.
عارف، المشكلة عندنا. ممكن نعدّل المناسيب شوية.
OK. Should we stop work in that area until you decide?
تمام. نوقف الشغل في المنطقة دي لحد ما تقرروا؟
Yeah, that would be smart. Just hold the final layer.
أيوه، ده هيبقى تصرف ذكي. بس أجّلوا الطبقة الأخيرة.
Understood. When can we expect the revised drawing?
Could you send us an email to confirm the hold, please?
ممكن تبعتلنا إيميل يأكد التأجيل لو سمحت؟
Sure thing. I'll send it right after this call.
أكيد. هبعته على طول بعد المكالمة.
read: The drainage slope looks too flat near the boundary.
We built it exactly to the drawing.
Should we stop work in that area until you decide?
When can we expect the revised drawing?
Could you send us an email to confirm the hold?

tasks.q: Respond to a designer who wants to change levels after you built them.
tasks.q_ar: رد على مصمم عايز يغيّر مناسيب بعد ما نفذتها.
tasks.model: We built it exactly to the drawing. If you want to revise the levels, should we stop the work in that area until you decide? When can we expect the revised drawing?

tasks.q: Ask for written confirmation of a verbal instruction.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب تأكيد كتابي لتعليمات شفوية.
tasks.model: Could you please send us an email to confirm that we should hold the final layer? We need it for our records, because the hold may affect our programme.

lessons.title: Reporting a delay and its cause
lessons.scene: المدير بيسأل ليه منطقة D متأخرة عن البرنامج، وإنت بتشرح بالتفصيل.
dialogue: Zone D is behind schedule. What happened?
منطقة D متأخرة عن البرنامج. إيه اللي حصل؟
The main cause is the late access. We got the area two weeks after the planned date.
السبب الأساسي إن تسليم الموقع اتأخر. استلمنا المنطقة بعد الميعاد المخطط بأسبوعين.
Another contractor was still removing their site offices.
مقاول تاني كان لسه بيشيل مكاتب الموقع بتاعته.
Do we have records of that?
Yes. Photos, daily reports and two letters to the consultant.
أيوه. صور وتقارير يومية وجوابين للاستشاري.
Good. Is there any delay from our side?
كويس. فيه أي تأخير من ناحيتنا؟
A small one. One excavator broke down for two days.
Be honest about that in the report.
خليك صريح في ده في التقرير.
I will. I'll separate our delay from the access delay.
أكيد. هفصل تأخيرنا عن تأخير التسليم.
read: Zone D is behind schedule because of late access.
We got the area two weeks after the planned date.
Another contractor was still removing their site offices.
We have photos, daily reports and two letters.
I will separate our delay from the access delay.

tasks.q: Explain the main cause of a delay with evidence.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح السبب الأساسي للتأخير ومعاه الدليل.
tasks.model: Zone D is behind schedule mainly because of late access. We received the area two weeks late, because another contractor was still removing their offices. We have photos, daily reports and letters.

tasks.q: Be honest about a delay caused by your own team.
tasks.q_ar: كن صريح عن تأخير سببه فريقك.
tasks.model: There was also a small delay from our side. One excavator broke down for two days. I will show it separately in the report, so the access delay is clear.

lessons.title: Giving notice of a delay event
lessons.scene: بتبلّغ الاستشارية إنكم بعتوا إخطار رسمي بحدث تأخير.
dialogue: Nadia, I want to let you know that we sent a notice this morning.
نادية، حابب أبلغك إننا بعتنا إخطار الصبح.
About the late handover of Zone D. It may affect the completion date.
عن تأخير تسليم منطقة D. ممكن يأثر على تاريخ الإنجاز.
OK. Did you send it to the engineer's office?
Yes, by letter and by email, as the contract requires.
أيوه، بجواب وبإيميل، زي ما العقد بيطلب.
Will you claim time or money?
For now, it's only a notice. The detailed claim will follow with the full records.
لحد دلوقتي ده إخطار بس. المطالبة التفصيلية هتيجي بعدين بالسجلات الكاملة.
Please make sure the records are contemporary.
اتأكد إن السجلات معاصرة للحدث لو سمحت.
They are. We record the situation every day with photos and signed sheets.
هي كده. بنسجّل الوضع كل يوم بصور وكشوف موقّعة.
phrases: I want to let you know
It may affect the completion date
read: We sent a notice this morning about the late handover.
It may affect the completion date.
We sent it by letter and by email, as the contract requires.
The detailed claim will follow with the full records.
We record the situation every day with photos.

tasks.q: Inform the consultant that you sent a notice and why.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ الاستشاري إنك بعت إخطار وليه.
tasks.model: I want to let you know that we sent a notice this morning about the late handover of Zone D. It may affect the completion date, so we sent it by letter and email as the contract requires.

tasks.q: Explain how you keep records to support a future claim.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح بتحتفظ بالسجلات إزاي عشان تدعم مطالبة بعدين.
tasks.model: We keep contemporary records every day: photos, daily reports and signed sheets. The detailed claim will follow later with all these records.

lessons.title: Negotiating a haulage rate
lessons.scene: مورد النقل عايز يزوّد السعر بسبب طول المسافة، وإنت بتتفاوض.
dialogue: Hassan, the new haul route is longer. We need a higher rate.
حسن، مسار النقل الجديد أطول. محتاجين سعر أعلى.
I understand the route is longer. How much longer is it?
فاهم إن المسار أطول. أطول بقد إيه؟
Then a thirty percent increase seems too much, because your loading time is the same.
يبقى زيادة تلاتين في المية كتير، لأن وقت التحميل عندك زي ما هو.
That's true, but fuel costs more.
What if we agree on a smaller increase, only for the trips on the new route?
إيه رأيك نتفق على زيادة أقل، للنقلات اللي على المسار الجديد بس؟
And the old route stays at the old rate?
والمسار القديم يفضل على السعر القديم؟
Exactly. And we'll measure the distance together to be fair.
بالظبط. وهنقيس المسافة مع بعض عشان نبقى عادلين.
That sounds reasonable. Send me the proposal.
I'll send it today, but it needs the project manager's approval.
هبعته النهاردة، بس محتاج اعتماد مدير المشروع.
read: I understand the route is longer.
A thirty percent increase seems too much.
What if we agree on a smaller increase?
We will measure the distance together to be fair.
It needs the project manager's approval.

tasks.q: Negotiate a supplier's request for a higher rate.
tasks.q_ar: فاوض مورد طالب سعر أعلى.
tasks.model: I understand the new route is longer, but a thirty percent increase seems too much, because your loading time is the same. What if we agree on a smaller increase only for the trips on the new route?

tasks.q: Propose how to make the agreement fair and what approval is needed.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح إزاي الاتفاق يبقى عادل ومحتاج اعتماد مين.
tasks.model: To be fair, we can measure the distance together. I will send you the proposal today, but it needs the project manager's approval before we sign.

lessons.title: Instructing the foreman on sequence
lessons.scene: بتشرح للمراقب ترتيب الشغل في منطقة جديدة عشان مايحصلش إعادة.
dialogue: Ravi, before you start in Zone G, let's agree on the sequence.
رافي، قبل ما تبدأ في منطقة G، خلينا نتفق على الترتيب.
OK. Normally we start from the low side.
تمام. عادةً بنبدأ من الناحية الواطية.
Not this time. First, the surveyors stake out the boundary.
المرة دي لأ. الأول المساحين يحددوا الحدود.
Yes, and keep it in a separate stockpile. We'll reuse it for landscaping.
أيوه، وخليها في كومة لوحدها. هنستخدمها تاني في التشجير.
After that, the survey of the stripped surface, then the cut.
بعد كده رفع مساحي للسطح بعد الكشط، وبعدين القطع.
Because we get paid for stripping and cut separately. We need both surfaces.
لأننا بناخد فلوس الكشط والقطع لوحدهم. محتاجين السطحين.
Got it. I'll explain it to the operators.
read: Before you start, let's agree on the sequence.
First, the surveyors stake out the boundary.
Keep the topsoil in a separate stockpile.
We need a survey of the stripped surface before the cut.
We get paid for stripping and cut separately.

tasks.q: Explain the correct work sequence to the foreman.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح للمراقب ترتيب الشغل الصح.
tasks.model: First the surveyors stake out the boundary. Then we strip the topsoil and keep it in a separate stockpile. After that we survey the stripped surface, and then we start the cut.

tasks.q: Explain why the extra survey matters for payment.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه الرفع الإضافي مهم للدفع.
tasks.model: We get paid for stripping and cut separately. Without a survey of the stripped surface, we cannot prove the two quantities, and we may lose money.

lessons.title: Low productivity from a subcontractor
lessons.scene: إنتاج مقاول الباطن أقل من المتفق عليه، وإنت بتتكلم معاه بوضوح واحترام.
dialogue: Faisal, I need to talk to you about your production this week.
فيصل، محتاج أتكلم معاك عن الإنتاج بتاعكم الأسبوع ده.
Your trucks are doing fewer trips than we agreed.
عربياتك بتعمل نقلات أقل من اللي اتفقنا عليه.
The loading area is crowded. My drivers wait a long time.
منطقة التحميل زحمة. السواقين بتوعي بيستنوا كتير.
That's a fair point. How long do they usually wait?
ده كلام منطقي. بيستنوا عادةً قد إيه؟
OK. I'll ask the foreman to add a second loading point.
تمام. هطلب من المراقب يضيف نقطة تحميل تانية.
But I also need two more trucks from you next week.
بس أنا محتاج منك كمان عربيتين زيادة الأسبوع الجاي.
I'll try my best. I'll confirm tomorrow.
هعمل اللي أقدر عليه. هأكدلك بكرة.
phrases: I need to talk to you about
نقلات أقل من اللي اتفقنا عليه
read: Your trucks are doing fewer trips than we agreed.
The loading area is crowded and drivers wait.
That is a fair point, how long do they wait?
I will ask the foreman to add a second loading point.
I also need two more trucks from you next week.

tasks.q: Tell a subcontractor his production is too low, respectfully.
tasks.q_ar: قول لمقاول باطن إن إنتاجه قليل باحترام.
tasks.model: I need to talk to you about your production. Your trucks are doing fewer trips than we agreed. What is the reason?

tasks.q: Offer a solution and ask for something in return.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح حل واطلب حاجة في المقابل.
tasks.model: That's a fair point. I will ask the foreman to add a second loading point, so your drivers wait less. In return, I need two more trucks from you next week.

lessons.title: Explaining a stockpile volume
lessons.scene: المتدرب بيسأل إزاي بتحسبوا حجم الكومة من الرفع المساحي.
dialogue: Hassan, how do you calculate the volume of a stockpile?
First, we need two surfaces: the ground under the pile and the top of the pile.
الأول محتاجين سطحين: الأرض اللي تحت الكومة وسطح الكومة.
How do you get the ground under it?
We survey the area before we start piling. That's very important.
بنرفع المنطقة قبل ما نبدأ نشوّن. ده مهم جدًا.
The surveyors take points all over the pile, especially at the edges and the top.
المساحين بياخدوا نقط على الكومة كلها، خصوصًا عند الأطراف وفوق.
Then the software compares the two surfaces?
Exactly. Civil 3D builds both surfaces and calculates the volume between them.
بالظبط. سيفيل ثري دي بيعمل السطحين ويحسب الحجم اللي بينهم.
What if we didn't survey the ground first?
Then we must estimate it, and the consultant may not accept the result.
يبقى لازم نقدّرها، والاستشاري ممكن مايقبلش النتيجة.
read: We need two surfaces to calculate the volume.
We survey the area before we start piling.
The surveyors take points especially at the edges.
The software calculates the volume between the two surfaces.
The consultant may not accept an estimated result.

tasks.q: Explain how a stockpile volume is calculated.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إزاي بيتحسب حجم كومة المخزون.
tasks.model: We need two surfaces: the ground under the pile and the top of the pile. We survey the ground before piling, then survey the top. The software calculates the volume between the two surfaces.

tasks.q: Explain why the ground survey must be done first.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه رفع الأرض لازم يتعمل الأول.
tasks.model: If we don't survey the ground before piling, we have to estimate it later. An estimate is weak evidence, and the consultant may not accept the result.

lessons.title: Weekly progress with reasons
lessons.scene: في الاجتماع الأسبوعي، بتعرض التقدم ومقارنته بالخطة وأسباب الفرق.
dialogue: Hassan, where are we compared to the plan?
Overall, we are slightly behind, about three days.
بشكل عام متأخرين شوية، حوالي تلات أيام.
The cut is on track. The fill is behind because of the water shortage.
القطع ماشي حسب الخطة. الردم متأخر بسبب نقص المياه.
Is the water problem solved now?
Partly. The second supplier started on Monday.
جزئيًا. المورد التاني بدأ يوم الاتنين.
Can we recover the three days?
Yes, if we work two extra hours a day for two weeks.
أيوه، لو اشتغلنا ساعتين زيادة في اليوم لمدة أسبوعين.
It's mainly overtime and fuel. I'll prepare an estimate for you.
أغلبها ساعات إضافية ووقود. هجهزلك تقدير.
read: Overall, we are slightly behind, about three days.
The cut is on track, but the fill is behind.
The second supplier started on Monday.
We can recover if we work two extra hours a day.
I will prepare a cost estimate for you.

tasks.q: Report progress compared to the plan, with reasons.
tasks.q_ar: قدّم التقدم مقارنةً بالخطة مع الأسباب.
tasks.model: Overall we are slightly behind, about three days. The cut is on track, but the fill is behind because of the water shortage. The second supplier started on Monday, so the problem is partly solved.

tasks.q: Propose a recovery plan and mention its cost.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح خطة تعويض واذكر تكلفتها.
tasks.model: We can recover the three days if we work two extra hours a day for two weeks. The cost is mainly overtime and fuel. I will prepare an estimate.

lessons.title: Reporting a near miss
lessons.scene: كان فيه موقف خطر قريب من حادثة بين لودر وعامل، وإنت بتبلّغ مسؤول السلامة.
dialogue: Sam, I need to report a near miss in Zone C.
سام، محتاج أبلّغ عن حادثة وشيكة في منطقة C.
A loader reversed and almost hit a worker.
لودر رجع لورا وكان هيخبط عامل.
Yes, he's fine. Nobody was hurt.
Why didn't the operator see him?
The reversing alarm wasn't working, and there was no banksman.
إنذار الرجوع كان عطلان، ومكانش فيه مُرشد.
That's serious. Stop that loader until the alarm is fixed.
ده خطير. وقّف اللودر ده لحد ما الإنذار يتصلح.
Already done. And I asked for a banksman for every reversing machine.
حصل بالفعل. وطلبت مرشد لكل معدة بترجع لورا.
Good. Please write the report today, with photos and witness names.
كويس. اكتب التقرير النهاردة، بالصور وأسماء الشهود.
read: I need to report a near miss in Zone C.
A loader reversed and almost hit a worker.
Nobody was hurt, the worker is fine.
The reversing alarm was not working.
I asked for a banksman for every reversing machine.

tasks.q: Report a near miss clearly: what, where, and the result.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ عن حادثة وشيكة بوضوح: إيه، وفين، والنتيجة.
tasks.model: I need to report a near miss in Zone C. A loader reversed and almost hit a worker. Nobody was hurt. The reversing alarm was not working.

tasks.q: Explain the actions you took to prevent it happening again.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الإجراءات اللي عملتها عشان ماتتكررش.
tasks.model: We stopped the loader until the alarm is fixed. I also asked for a banksman for every reversing machine, and I will write the report today with photos.

lessons.title: Requesting missing survey data
lessons.scene: مساح الاستشاري مابعتش بيانات الرفع المشترك، وإنت محتاجها للمستخلص.
dialogue: Peter, I'm still waiting for the joint survey data from last Tuesday.
بيتر، أنا لسه مستني بيانات الرفع المشترك من التلات اللي فات.
Sorry, Hassan. We've been very busy with the other packages.
آسف يا حسن. كنا مشغولين جدًا مع الحزم التانية.
I understand, but I need it to close the monthly measurement.
فاهم، بس محتاجها عشان أقفل القياس الشهري.
The payment application must be submitted on the twenty-fifth.
المستخلص لازم يتقدم يوم خمسة وعشرين.
I can send the raw points today, but the report will take longer.
أقدر أبعت النقط الخام النهاردة، بس التقرير هياخد وقت أطول.
The raw points are enough for now, as long as they are signed later.
النقط الخام كفاية دلوقتي، طالما هتتوقع بعدين.
Fine. I'll send the file and the signed copy next week.
تمام. هبعت الملف والنسخة الموقعة الأسبوع الجاي.
Perfect. Please copy Nadia on the email.
ممتاز. حط نادية نسخة في الإيميل لو سمحت.
phrases: Please copy Nadia on the email
read: I am still waiting for the joint survey data.
I need it to close the monthly measurement.
The payment application must be submitted on the twenty-fifth.
The raw points are enough, as long as they are signed later.
Please copy Nadia on the email.

tasks.q: Politely chase a colleague for missing data and explain your deadline.
tasks.q_ar: تابع زميل بأدب على بيانات ناقصة ووضح آخر ميعاد.
tasks.model: I'm still waiting for the joint survey data from last Tuesday. I need it to close the monthly measurement, because the payment application must be submitted on the twenty-fifth.

tasks.q: Accept a partial solution with a condition.
tasks.q_ar: اقبل حل جزئي بشرط.
tasks.model: The raw points are enough for now, as long as you send the signed copy later. Please copy Nadia on the email, so the consultant has the same data.

lessons.title: Drawing versus bill of quantities
lessons.scene: لقيت تعارض بين الرسمة وجدول الكميات في سُمك الطبقة، وبتطلب توضيح.
dialogue: David, I found a conflict between the drawing and the bill of quantities.
ديفيد، لقيت تعارض بين الرسمة وجدول الكميات.
The drawing shows a sub-base layer under the road, but there's no item for it in the bill.
الرسمة فيها طبقة أساس مساعد تحت الطريق، بس مفيش بند ليها في الجدول.
Maybe it's included in another item.
I checked the item descriptions. None of them mentions the sub-base.
راجعت وصف البنود. ولا واحد فيهم بيذكر الأساس المساعد.
Then we need a clarification from the designer.
Yes. Should we wait, or build it as shown on the drawing?
أيوه. نستنى، ولا ننفذها زي ما هي في الرسمة؟
Build it as shown, but don't start before you get my written confirmation.
نفذوها زي ما هي، بس ماتبدأوش قبل ما يوصلكم تأكيدي المكتوب.
Understood. I'll send a formal request for information today.
مفهوم. هبعت طلب معلومات رسمي النهاردة.
Good. Reference the drawing number and the bill section.
كويس. اذكر رقم الرسمة وقسم الجدول.
read: I found a conflict between the drawing and the bill of quantities.
There is no item for the sub-base in the bill.
None of the item descriptions mentions it.
Should we wait, or build it as shown on the drawing?
I will send a formal request for information today.

tasks.q: Report a conflict between two contract documents.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ عن تعارض بين مستندين في العقد.
tasks.model: I found a conflict between the drawing and the bill of quantities. The drawing shows a sub-base layer, but there is no item for it in the bill, and none of the descriptions mentions it.

tasks.q: Ask how to proceed and say you will put it in writing.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل تتصرفوا إزاي وقول هتكتبها رسمي.
tasks.model: Should we wait or build it as shown on the drawing? Either way, I will send a formal request for information today with the drawing number and the bill section.

lessons.title: Asking approval for night work
lessons.scene: بتطلب من الاستشاري يوافق على شغل بالليل عشان تعوضوا تأخير الحر.
dialogue: David, we'd like to start night shifts in Zone C next week.
ديفيد، حابين نبدأ ورديات ليلية في منطقة C الأسبوع الجاي.
It's too hot at midday, so production drops. At night we can work safely and faster.
الجو حر جدًا الضهر، فالإنتاج بيقل. بالليل نقدر نشتغل بأمان وأسرع.
We'll have six lighting towers and a full night team, including a surveyor.
هيبقى عندنا ست أبراج إنارة وفريق ليلي كامل، بما فيهم مساح.
My inspectors work only during the day.
We'll test the layers in the morning before you inspect them.
هنختبر الطبقات الصبح قبل ما تعاينوها.
Send me a method statement for the night work.
I'll send it tomorrow, with the safety plan.
OK. I'll review it and reply within two days.
read: We would like to start night shifts next week.
It is too hot at midday, so production drops.
We will have six lighting towers and a full night team.
We will test the layers in the morning before you inspect them.
I will send the method statement with the safety plan.

tasks.q: Ask the consultant to approve night work and give reasons.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من الاستشاري يوافق على شغل ليلي ووضح الأسباب.
tasks.model: We would like to start night shifts next week. It's too hot at midday, so production drops. At night we can work safely and faster.

tasks.q: Answer concerns about lighting, supervision and inspection.
tasks.q_ar: رد على المخاوف بخصوص الإنارة والإشراف والمعاينة.
tasks.model: We will have six lighting towers and a full night team, including a surveyor. We will test the layers in the morning before your inspectors check them, and I'll send a method statement.

lessons.title: Coordinating with the utilities team
lessons.scene: فريق المرافق عايز يحفر خندق في منطقة إنتو خلصتوا ردمها، وإنت بتنسق.
dialogue: Hassan, we need to dig a trench across Zone C for the water line.
حسن، محتاجين نحفر خندق بعرض منطقة C لخط المياه.
Zone C is already filled and approved. When do you plan to dig?
منطقة C اتردمت واتعتمدت خلاص. ناويين تحفروا إمتى؟
OK, but we need to agree on who reinstates the fill after you finish.
تمام، بس لازم نتفق مين هيرجّع الردم بعد ما تخلصوا.
Normally we backfill the trench ourselves.
Then it must meet the same compaction standard as our layers.
يبقى لازم يحقق نفس معيار الدمك بتاع طبقاتنا.
Of course. We'll test every layer.
And please share your trench route, so we survey the area before you start.
وابعتلي مسار الخندق لو سمحت، عشان نرفع المنطقة قبل ما تبدأوا.
Why do you need a survey?
To record the condition before your work. It protects both teams.
عشان نسجّل الحالة قبل شغلكم. ده بيحمي الفريقين.
read: Zone C is already filled and approved.
We need to agree on who reinstates the fill.
It must meet the same compaction standard as our layers.
Please share your trench route before you start.
The survey records the condition before your work.

tasks.q: Agree with another team on responsibility for reinstatement.
tasks.q_ar: اتفق مع فريق تاني على مسؤولية إعادة الردم.
tasks.model: Zone C is already filled and approved. Before you dig, we need to agree on who reinstates the fill. If you backfill it, it must meet the same compaction standard as our layers.

tasks.q: Explain why you want a survey before their work.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه عايز رفع قبل شغلهم.
tasks.model: Please share your trench route, so we can survey the area before you start. The survey records the condition before your work, and it protects both teams if there is a problem later.

lessons.title: Haul road maintenance
lessons.scene: طريق النقل اتبهدل والعربيات بتتعطل، وبتتفق مع مقاول الباطن على الصيانة.
dialogue: Hassan, the haul road is full of holes. Two of my trucks have broken springs.
حسن، طريق النقل مليان حفر. عربيتين عندي السوست بتاعتهم اتكسرت.
I saw it. The grader didn't work on the road this week.
شفته. الجريدر مااشتغلش على الطريق الأسبوع ده.
Who is responsible for maintaining it?
According to your subcontract, we maintain the main haul road, and you maintain the access ramps.
حسب عقد الباطن بتاعك، إحنا بنصون طريق النقل الرئيسي، وإنتو بتصونوا المطالع.
OK, so the main road is your job.
Yes. I'll make sure the grader works on it every morning.
أيوه. هتأكد إن الجريدر يشتغل عليه كل يوم الصبح.
And the water truck? There's a lot of dust too.
وعربية المياه؟ فيه تراب كتير كمان.
The water truck will spray it twice a day.
عربية المياه هترشه مرتين في اليوم.
Send me photos and a report. I'll discuss it with the project manager, but I can't promise anything.
ابعتلي صور وتقرير. هتكلم مع مدير المشروع، بس مقدرش أوعدك بحاجة.
read: The haul road is full of holes.
Who is responsible for maintaining the road?
According to your subcontract, we maintain the main haul road.
The water truck will spray it twice a day.
I will discuss it, but I cannot promise anything.

tasks.q: Explain who is responsible for what, based on the contract.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح مين مسؤول عن إيه حسب العقد.
tasks.model: According to your subcontract, we maintain the main haul road and you maintain the access ramps. So I will make sure the grader works on the main road every morning.

tasks.q: Respond to a claim for damage without making a promise.
tasks.q_ar: رد على طلب تعويض عن ضرر من غير ما توعد.
tasks.model: Please send me photos and a short report about the broken springs. I will discuss it with the project manager, but I can't promise anything now.

lessons.title: Discussing the compaction method
lessons.scene: نتايج الاختبارات متذبذبة، وبتناقش مع فني المعمل طريقة الدمك.
dialogue: Peter, the test results in Zone C go up and down a lot. Why?
بيتر، نتايج الاختبارات في منطقة C بتطلع وتنزل كتير. ليه؟
I think the layers are too thick in some places.
أعتقد الطبقات تخينة زيادة في بعض الأماكن.
The method statement says a maximum of thirty centimetres.
طريقة التنفيذ بتقول ماكس تلاتين سنتي.
Yes, but I measured more in some spots.
أيوه، بس أنا قست أكتر في بعض الأماكن.
Then the roller can't compact the bottom of the layer properly.
يبقى الهراس مش هيقدر يدمك قاع الطبقة كويس.
Exactly. Also, the number of passes isn't always the same.
بالظبط. كمان عدد المرات مش دايمًا ثابت.
OK. I'll ask the foreman to use level pegs for the layer thickness.
تمام. هطلب من المراقب يستخدم أوتاد منسوب لسُمك الطبقة.
And a simple pass counter for the roller operator.
Good idea. Let's do a trial area tomorrow and test it.
فكرة كويسة. خلينا نعمل منطقة تجربة بكرة ونختبرها.
phrases: go up and down a lot
read: The test results in Zone C go up and down a lot.
The layers are too thick in some places.
The roller cannot compact the bottom of the layer properly.
Use level pegs to control the layer thickness.
Let's do a trial area tomorrow and test it.

tasks.q: Discuss the reasons for inconsistent test results.
tasks.q_ar: ناقش أسباب نتايج الاختبارات المتذبذبة.
tasks.model: The test results go up and down a lot. I think the layers are too thick in some places, so the roller can't compact the bottom properly. Also, the number of passes is not always the same.

tasks.q: Propose practical actions to fix the problem.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح إجراءات عملية لحل المشكلة.
tasks.model: The foreman will use level pegs to control the layer thickness, and the roller operator will count the passes. Let's do a trial area tomorrow and test it.

lessons.title: Defending a rejected item
lessons.scene: الاستشارية رفضت بند نقل المخلفات في المستخلص، وإنت بتدافع عنه بأدلة.
dialogue: We rejected the item for removing unsuitable material.
رفضنا بند إزالة المواد غير الصالحة.
Can you tell me the reason, please?
We don't see any approval for the quantity.
The engineer inspected the area and agreed the material was unsuitable.
المهندس عاين المنطقة ووافق إن المادة غير صالحة.
Do you have that in writing?
Yes. Here's the inspection request, signed on the twelfth, with his comment.
أيوه. ده طلب المعاينة، موقّع يوم اتناشر، وعليه تعليقه.
OK, that confirms the material. What about the quantity?
It's based on a joint survey before and after the removal. Both surveys are attached.
مبنية على رفع مشترك قبل وبعد الإزالة. الرفعين مرفقين.
I missed those attachments. I'll review the item again.
فاتتني المرفقات دي. هراجع البند تاني.
Thank you. Could we close it before the end of the week?
شكرًا. ممكن نقفله قبل آخر الأسبوع؟
phrases: Can you tell me the reason?
Do you have that in writing?
read: Can you tell me the reason, please?
The engineer inspected the area and agreed the material was unsuitable.
Here is the inspection request with his comment.
The quantity is based on a joint survey before and after.
Could we close it before the end of the week?

tasks.q: Ask for the reason an item was rejected, and give your evidence.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل عن سبب رفض بند، وقدّم دليلك.
tasks.model: Can you tell me the reason, please? The engineer inspected the area and agreed the material was unsuitable. Here is the signed inspection request with his comment.

tasks.q: Explain how the quantity was measured and ask to close the item.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الكمية اتقاست إزاي واطلب قفل البند.
tasks.model: The quantity is based on a joint survey before and after the removal, and both surveys are attached. Could we close this item before the end of the week?

lessons.title: Planning the testing schedule
lessons.scene: بتنسق مع المعمل جدول الاختبارات للأسبوع الجاي عشان ماحدش يستنى.
dialogue: Peter, let's plan next week's tests, so the teams don't wait.
بيتر، خلينا نخطط اختبارات الأسبوع الجاي عشان الفرق ماتستناش.
Good idea. How many layers do you expect?
About two layers a day in Zone C, and one in Zone F.
حوالي طبقتين في اليوم في منطقة C، وواحدة في منطقة F.
That's a lot for one technician.
Can you bring a second technician for the week?
تقدر تجيب فني تاني للأسبوع ده؟
