Maybe, but I need a request from your manager.
ممكن، بس محتاج طلب من مديرك.
I'll ask him today. Also, can we fix test times? Nine and two o'clock?
هطلب منه النهاردة. وكمان، نثبّت مواعيد الاختبار؟ تسعة واتنين؟
Fixed times are better for me too.
المواعيد الثابتة أحسن ليا أنا كمان.
Great. I'll share the plan with the foreman and the consultant.
عظيم. هشارك الخطة مع المراقب والاستشاري.
Please send me the list of locations every evening.
ابعتلي قايمة الأماكن كل يوم بالليل لو سمحت.
read: Let's plan next week's tests, so the teams don't wait.
We expect about two layers a day in Zone C.
Can you bring a second technician for the week?
Fixed test times are better for everyone.
Please send me the list of locations every evening.

tasks.q: Plan the testing schedule with the lab.
tasks.q_ar: خطط جدول الاختبارات مع المعمل.
tasks.model: Let's plan next week's tests, so the teams don't wait. We expect about two layers a day in Zone C and one in Zone F. Can we fix the test times at nine and two o'clock?

tasks.q: Ask for extra resources and explain why.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب موارد زيادة ووضح ليه.
tasks.model: That's a lot of tests for one technician. Can you bring a second technician for next week? I will ask my manager to send you a formal request today.

lessons.title: Requesting a meeting with the client
lessons.scene: بتكلّم مساعدة ممثل المالك عشان تحدد اجتماع عن المناطق المتأخر تسليمها.
dialogue: Good morning, Laura. I'd like to arrange a meeting with Mr. Grant.
صباح الخير يا لورا. حابب أرتب اجتماع مع مستر جرانت.
Good morning. What is it about?
It's about the zones we haven't received yet. They are affecting our programme.
عن المناطق اللي لسه مااستلمناهاش. بتأثر على برنامجنا.
I see. How long do you need?
About thirty minutes. Our project manager will join.
حوالي نص ساعة. مدير مشروعنا هيحضر.
He's available on Sunday at ten or Monday at one.
هو فاضي الأحد الساعة عشرة أو الاتنين الساعة واحدة.
Sunday at ten works for us.
Fine. Can you send an agenda before the meeting?
تمام. تقدر تبعت جدول أعمال قبل الاجتماع؟
Of course. I'll send it tomorrow with a short status of each zone.
طبعًا. هبعته بكرة ومعاه حالة مختصرة لكل منطقة.
Thank you. I'll send you a calendar invitation.
phrases: I'd like to arrange a meeting
read: I would like to arrange a meeting with Mr. Grant.
It is about the zones we have not received yet.
They are affecting our programme.
Sunday at ten works for us.
I will send the agenda tomorrow with a short status.

tasks.q: Request a meeting and explain the topic.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب اجتماع ووضح الموضوع.
tasks.model: Good morning. I'd like to arrange a meeting with the employer's representative. It's about the zones we haven't received yet, because they are affecting our programme. We need about thirty minutes.

tasks.q: Confirm a time and offer to send an agenda.
tasks.q_ar: أكّد ميعاد واعرض تبعت جدول أعمال.
tasks.model: Sunday at ten works for us. I will send the agenda tomorrow, with a short status of each zone, so the meeting is focused.

lessons.title: Cost impact of a design change
lessons.scene: مدير المشروع عايز يعرف التغيير في منطقة F هيكلّف قد إيه وليه.
dialogue: Hassan, what's the cost impact of the new levels in Zone F?
حسن، إيه أثر المناسيب الجديدة في منطقة F على التكلفة؟
There are three parts: extra fill, longer haulage and more testing.
فيه تلات أجزاء: ردم زيادة، ونقل لمسافة أطول، واختبارات أكتر.
The extra fill. We don't have enough suitable material on site.
الردم الزيادة. مش عندنا مادة صالحة كفاية في الموقع.
So we need to import material?
يعني محتاجين نجيب مادة من بره؟
Yes, from a borrow pit. That adds haulage cost as well.
أيوه، من محجر. ده بيزوّد تكلفة النقل كمان.
Can we use the bill rates?
For the fill, yes. For imported material, there's no rate, so we'll propose a new one.
للردم أيوه. للمادة المستوردة مفيش سعر، فهنقترح سعر جديد.
Prepare the build-up carefully. The consultant will check every line.
جهّز تحليل السعر بعناية. الاستشاري هيراجع كل سطر.
I will, with supplier quotations and our actual costs.
أكيد، بعروض أسعار الموردين وتكاليفنا الفعلية.
read: There are three parts: extra fill, longer haulage and more testing.
We do not have enough suitable material on site.
We need to import material from a borrow pit.
For imported material there is no rate, so we will propose one.
I will prepare it with supplier quotations and actual costs.

tasks.q: Explain the parts of a cost impact.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح أجزاء الأثر على التكلفة.
tasks.model: The cost impact has three parts: extra fill, longer haulage and more testing. The biggest is the extra fill, because we don't have enough suitable material on site and must import it.

tasks.q: Explain how you will price an item that has no rate.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح هتسعّر بند مالوش سعر إزاي.
tasks.model: The bill rate covers the fill, but there is no rate for imported material. We will propose a new rate with a build-up, supported by supplier quotations and our actual costs.

lessons.title: Correcting the daily report
lessons.scene: المدير لقى أخطاء في التقرير اليومي، وإنت بتعترف وبتصحح.
dialogue: Hassan, there are some mistakes in yesterday's daily report.
حسن، فيه شوية أخطاء في التقرير اليومي بتاع امبارح.
The number of trucks is different from the gate records.
عدد العربيات مختلف عن سجلات البوابة.
You're right, I used the morning count only. That's my mistake.
عندك حق، استخدمت عدّ الصبح بس. دي غلطتي.
And the equipment list shows the excavator as working.
وقايمة المعدات كاتبة إن الحفار شغال.
It was broken for half the day. I'll correct both and resend it.
كان عطلان نص اليوم. هصحح الاتنين وأبعته تاني.
These reports go to the consultant. They must be accurate.
التقارير دي بتروح للاستشاري. لازم تبقى دقيقة.
I understand. From now on, I'll check the gate sheet before I send it.
فاهم. من هنا ورايح، هراجع كشف البوابة قبل ما أبعته.
Good. Mistakes happen, but we can't repeat them.
كويس. الأخطاء بتحصل، بس مانقدرش نكررها.
Agreed. You'll have the corrected version in an hour.
متفقين. هتوصلك النسخة المصححة خلال ساعة.
phrases: I'll correct both and resend it
read: The number of trucks is different from the gate records.
You are right, that is my mistake.
I will correct both and resend the report.
From now on, I will check the gate sheet first.
You will have the corrected version in an hour.

tasks.q: Accept a mistake professionally and fix it.
tasks.q_ar: اعترف بغلطة باحتراف وصلّحها.
tasks.model: You're right, that's my mistake. I used the morning count only. I will correct the truck numbers and the equipment status, and resend the report within an hour.

tasks.q: Explain how you will prevent the same mistake.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح هتمنع نفس الغلطة إزاي.
tasks.model: From now on, I will check the gate sheet and the equipment log before I send the daily report, so the numbers are always accurate.

lessons.title: Original ground dispute with the surveyor
lessons.title_ar: خلاف على الأرض الطبيعية مع المساح
lessons.scene: المساح بتاعك شايف إن بيانات الأرض الطبيعية القديمة فيها غلط، وبتناقشوا هتعملوا إيه.
dialogue: Hassan, I think the original ground data in Zone H is wrong.
حسن، أعتقد بيانات الأرض الطبيعية في منطقة H غلط.
Some points are half a metre lower than the area around them.
بعض النقط أوطى بنص متر من المنطقة اللي حواليها.
Could it be a real hole or a pit?
I visited the area. It's flat. No holes.
Then we must raise it now, before any work starts there.
يبقى لازم نثيرها دلوقتي، قبل أي شغل يبدأ هناك.
Should we re-survey the whole zone?
Yes, jointly with the consultant's surveyor, and we'll compare both sets.
أيوه، بالاشتراك مع مساح الاستشاري، وهنقارن المجموعتين.
The consultant may ask why we didn't see it before.
الاستشاري ممكن يسأل ليه ماشفناهوش قبل كده.
That's fine. It's better to correct it now than to argue about it in the final account.
مفيش مشكلة. أحسن نصححها دلوقتي بدل ما نتخانق عليها في الحساب الختامي.
read: I think the original ground data in Zone H is wrong.
Some points are half a metre lower than the area around them.
We must raise it now, before any work starts.
We will re-survey jointly with the consultant's surveyor.
It is better to correct it now than to argue later.

tasks.q: Discuss suspected errors in survey data.
tasks.q_ar: ناقش أخطاء مشكوك فيها في بيانات المساحة.
tasks.model: What makes you think the data is wrong? If some points are half a metre lower and the area is flat, it's probably an error. We must raise it now, before any work starts.

tasks.q: Propose how to correct the data properly.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح إزاي تصحح البيانات صح.
tasks.model: Let's re-survey the whole zone jointly with the consultant's surveyor and compare both sets. It's better to correct it now than to argue about it in the final account.

lessons.title: Who pays for over-excavation?
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن حفر أوطى من المنسوب المطلوب وعايز يتحاسب على الكمية الزيادة.
dialogue: Hassan, we excavated about twenty centimetres deeper in Zone B. Please include it in our payment.
حسن، حفرنا أعمق بحوالي عشرين سنتي في منطقة B. حطها في دفعتنا لو سمحت.
Why did you go deeper? Was there an instruction?
حفرتوا أعمق ليه؟ كان فيه تعليمات؟
No, the operator made a mistake with the levels.
Then I'm afraid we can't pay for it. Over-excavation without instruction is at your cost.
يبقى للأسف مش هنقدر ندفعها. الحفر الزيادة من غير تعليمات على حسابكم.
But we moved the material. It cost us fuel and time.
بس إحنا نقلنا المادة. كلّفتنا وقود ووقت.
I understand, but there's another problem. We also have to fill it back with approved material.
فاهم، بس فيه مشكلة تانية. لازم كمان نردمها تاني بمادة معتمدة.
According to the subcontract, the subcontractor does, because the cause was your mistake.
حسب عقد الباطن، مقاول الباطن هو اللي يدفع، لأن السبب غلطتكم.
I know. To avoid it next time, let's check levels with the surveyor every few hours.
عارف. عشان نتجنبها المرة الجاية، خلينا نراجع المناسيب مع المساح كل كام ساعة.
read: Was there an instruction to excavate deeper?
Over-excavation without instruction is at your cost.
We also have to fill it back with approved material.
According to the subcontract, the subcontractor pays.
Let's check levels with the surveyor every few hours.

tasks.q: Refuse to pay for over-excavation, politely and with reasons.
tasks.q_ar: ارفض تدفع الحفر الزيادة بأدب ومع الأسباب.
tasks.model: I'm afraid we can't pay for it. Over-excavation without an instruction is at your cost, and according to the subcontract, you also pay to fill it back with approved material.

tasks.q: Suggest how to avoid the problem in the future.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح إزاي نتجنب المشكلة بعد كده.
tasks.model: To avoid this next time, let's check the levels with the surveyor every few hours, and the operators should work with level pegs near the final level.

lessons.title: Extending equipment hire
lessons.scene: محتاج تمدد إيجار هراس شهر كمان وتتفاوض على السعر.
dialogue: Hamid, we'd like to extend the roller hire for one more month.
حامد، حابين نمدد إيجار الهراس شهر كمان.
No problem. The rate stays the same.
مفيش مشكلة. السعر زي ما هو.
Actually, I was hoping for a better rate, since it's a longer hire.
الحقيقة كنت متمني سعر أحسن، لأن الإيجار بقى أطول.
What did you have in mind?
Ten percent less, starting from the extension.
عشرة في المية أقل، من أول التمديد.
Ten is too much. I can do five.
Can you meet me halfway, at seven and a half, with the operator included?
ممكن نتقابل في النص، سبعة ونص، والسواق معاه؟
The operator is already included. Seven and a half is OK.
السواق معاه أصلًا. سبعة ونص ماشي.
Great, we have a deal. Please send the revised quotation.
عظيم، اتفقنا. ابعت عرض السعر المعدّل لو سمحت.
I'll send it today, and please send a purchase order.
هبعته النهاردة، وابعتلي أمر شراء لو سمحت.
phrases: What did you have in mind?
read: We would like to extend the roller hire for one more month.
I was hoping for a better rate.
Can you meet me halfway?
Great, we have a deal.
Please send the revised quotation today.

tasks.q: Ask for a better rate on an extended hire.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب سعر أحسن على تمديد إيجار.
tasks.model: We'd like to extend the roller hire for one more month. Since it's a longer hire, I was hoping for a better rate, maybe ten percent less.

tasks.q: Reach a compromise and close the deal.
tasks.q_ar: اوصل لحل وسط واقفل الاتفاق.
tasks.model: Can you meet me halfway at seven and a half percent? If that's OK, we have a deal. Please send the revised quotation and I'll arrange the purchase order.

lessons.title: Showing a new QS the workflow
lessons.title_ar: شرح طريقة الشغل لمهندس كميات جديد
lessons.scene: مهندس كميات مساعد جديد، وإنت بتشرحله دورة القياس والمستخلص الشهرية.
dialogue: Hassan, can you explain our monthly cycle?
حسن، ممكن تشرحلي الدورة الشهرية عندنا؟
Sure. It starts with the surveys. Every week we survey the areas we worked on.
أكيد. بتبدأ بالرفع المساحي. كل أسبوع بنرفع المناطق اللي اشتغلنا فيها.
Yes, in Civil 3D, and I compare them with the daily reports and truck counts.
أيوه، على سيفيل ثري دي، وبقارنها بالتقارير اليومية وعدد النقلات.
To catch errors. If the numbers don't match, something is wrong.
عشان نمسك الأخطاء. لو الأرقام مش متطابقة، يبقى فيه حاجة غلط.
Around the twentieth, we agree the quantities with the consultant, then we submit on the twenty-fifth.
حوالي يوم عشرين بنتفق على الكميات مع الاستشاري، وبعدين نقدم يوم خمسة وعشرين.
Evidence. Every number must have a survey, a sheet or a signature behind it.
الدليل. كل رقم لازم يكون وراه رفع أو كشف أو توقيع.
phrases: Every number must have ... behind it
read: It starts with the surveys every week.
I compare the quantities with the daily reports and truck counts.
If the numbers don't match, something is wrong.
We agree the quantities with the consultant around the twentieth.
Every number must have evidence behind it.

tasks.q: Explain the monthly measurement and payment cycle.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح دورة القياس والمستخلص الشهرية.
tasks.model: It starts with weekly surveys. Then we calculate the quantities and compare them with the daily reports and truck counts. Around the twentieth we agree the quantities with the consultant, and we submit on the twenty-fifth.

tasks.q: Explain the most important rule for a QS.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح أهم قاعدة لمهندس الكميات.
tasks.model: The most important thing is evidence. Every number must have a survey, a sheet or a signature behind it, otherwise the consultant can reject it.

lessons.title: Payment terms with a subcontractor
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن مش فاهم ليه دفعته أقل من قيمة الشغل، وإنت بتشرح الخصومات.
dialogue: Hassan, our payment is less than the value of our work. Why?
حسن، دفعتنا أقل من قيمة شغلنا. ليه؟
There are two deductions: retention and the advance payment recovery.
فيه خصمين: المحتجزات واسترداد الدفعة المقدمة.
It's a small percentage we keep from each payment until the end of the work.
نسبة صغيرة بنحتفظ بيها من كل دفعة لحد آخر الشغل.
Yes. Part of it after completion, and the rest after the defects period, as your subcontract says.
أيوه. جزء بعد الإنجاز، والباقي بعد فترة الضمان، زي ما عقد الباطن بيقول.
You received an advance at the start. We recover it gradually from each payment.
استلمتوا دفعة مقدمة في الأول. بنستردها بالتدريج من كل دفعة.
OK, now it makes sense. Can you send me a breakdown?
تمام، دلوقتي مفهومة. ممكن تبعتلي التفاصيل؟
Of course. I'll send the calculation sheet with every payment from now on.
طبعًا. هبعت شيت الحساب مع كل دفعة من هنا ورايح.
read: There are two deductions, retention and advance recovery.
Retention is a small percentage we keep from each payment.
Part of it is released after completion.
We recover the advance gradually from each payment.
I will send the calculation sheet with every payment.

tasks.q: Explain retention to a subcontractor in simple words.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح المحتجزات لمقاول باطن بكلام بسيط.
tasks.model: Retention is a small percentage we keep from each payment until the end of the work. You get part of it back after completion and the rest after the defects period, as your subcontract says.

tasks.q: Explain the advance payment recovery.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح استرداد الدفعة المقدمة.
tasks.model: You received an advance payment at the start of the job. We recover it gradually from each payment, so your payments look smaller until the advance is fully recovered.

lessons.title: Hosting a client site visit
lessons.scene: ممثل المالك بيزور الموقع، وإنت بتعرّفه بالتقدم في جولة قصيرة.
dialogue: Good morning, Mr. Grant. Welcome to the site.
صباح الخير يا مستر جرانت. أهلًا بيك في الموقع.
Good morning. I'd like to see the main progress today.
صباح النور. حابب أشوف التقدم الأساسي النهاردة.
Of course. We'll start with Zone B, where the cut is complete.
طبعًا. هنبدأ بمنطقة B، اللي القطع فيها خلص.
Very good. And the fill areas?
Zone C is about seventy percent complete. You can see the layers being compacted now.
منطقة C حوالي سبعين في المية خلصانة. تقدر تشوف الطبقات وهي بتتدمك دلوقتي.
What's your biggest challenge at the moment?
Honestly, the late handover of Zone D. It's affecting our programme.
بصراحة، تأخير تسليم منطقة D. بيأثر على برنامجنا.
I'm aware of it. We're working on it.
Thank you. Any date would help us plan our resources.
شكرًا. أي ميعاد هيساعدنا نخطط الموارد.
I'll try to give you a date by the end of the week.
هحاول أديك ميعاد قبل آخر الأسبوع.
read: We will start with Zone B, where the cut is complete.
Zone C is about seventy percent complete.
You can see the layers being compacted now.
The late handover is affecting our programme.
Any date would help us plan our resources.

tasks.q: Give a short progress tour to the client.
tasks.q_ar: ادي ممثل المالك جولة قصيرة عن التقدم.
tasks.model: Welcome to the site. We'll start with Zone B, where the cut is complete. Then we'll see Zone C, which is about seventy percent complete, and you can see the layers being compacted.

tasks.q: Mention your biggest challenge and ask for help, politely.
tasks.q_ar: اذكر أكبر تحدي واطلب مساعدة بأدب.
tasks.model: Honestly, our biggest challenge is the late handover of Zone D. It's affecting our programme, so any date from your side would help us plan our resources.

lessons.title: A complaint from the neighbouring contractor
lessons.scene: مدير مقاول مجاور بيشتكي إن عربياتكم بتسد طريقه وبتعمل تراب.
dialogue: Hassan, your trucks are blocking our access road every morning.
حسن، عربياتكم بتسد طريق دخولنا كل يوم الصبح.
I'm sorry to hear that. What time does it happen?
آسف إني أسمع كده. بيحصل الساعة كام؟
Between six thirty and seven thirty, when our workers arrive.
بين ستة ونص وسبعة ونص، وقت وصول عمالنا.
That's when our trucks queue for fuel. I'll move the fuelling point.
ده الوقت اللي عربياتنا بتقف فيه طابور للوقود. هنقل نقطة التموين.
And the dust is terrible near our offices.
We'll add a water truck on that section, starting tomorrow.
هنزود عربية مياه على الجزء ده من بكرة.
Thank you. I'll tell my team.
If it happens again, please call me directly. Here's my number.
لو اتكررت، كلّمني على طول لو سمحت. ده رقمي.
We share the same site, so let's solve problems quickly.
إحنا في نفس الموقع، فخلينا نحل المشاكل بسرعة.
read: I am sorry to hear that, what time does it happen?
That is when our trucks queue for fuel.
We will add a water truck on that section.
If it happens again, please call me directly.
We share the same site, so let's solve problems quickly.

tasks.q: Respond to a complaint and ask for details.
tasks.q_ar: رد على شكوى واسأل عن التفاصيل.
tasks.model: I'm sorry to hear that. What time does it happen exactly? I want to understand the problem so we can fix it quickly.

tasks.q: Offer practical solutions and a direct contact.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض حلول عملية ووسيلة تواصل مباشرة.
tasks.model: I'll move our fuelling point away from your road, and we'll add a water truck for the dust starting tomorrow. If it happens again, please call me directly.

lessons.title: Preparing for a quantity audit
lessons.scene: فيه تدقيق من المالك على الكميات الشهر الجاي، وبتتكلموا عن التحضير.
dialogue: Hassan, the employer's auditors will review our quantities next month.
حسن، مدققين المالك هيراجعوا كمياتنا الشهر الجاي.
OK. Which period will they check?
From the start of the project until last month.
من بداية المشروع لحد الشهر اللي فات.
Then I need to organise all the measurement files by month and by item.
يبقى لازم أنظم كل ملفات القياس بالشهر والبند.
A few early surveys are not signed. I'll ask the consultant to sign them now.
شوية رفوعات في الأول مش موقّعة. هطلب من الاستشاري يوقعها دلوقتي.
I'll prepare a summary table that links each quantity to its evidence.
هجهز جدول ملخص بيربط كل كمية بالدليل بتاعها.
That will make their job easier.
And ours. If they can follow the numbers, the audit will be short.
وشغلنا كمان. لو قدروا يتابعوا الأرقام، التدقيق هيبقى قصير.
phrases: organise ... by month and by item
links each quantity to its evidence
That will make their job easier
read: The auditors will review our quantities next month.
I need to organise the files by month and by item.
A few early surveys are not signed.
I will prepare a table that links each quantity to its evidence.
If they can follow the numbers, the audit will be short.

tasks.q: Explain how you will prepare for an audit.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح هتحضّر للتدقيق إزاي.
tasks.model: I'll organise all the measurement files by month and by item. Then I'll prepare a summary table that links each quantity to its evidence, so the auditors can follow the numbers.

tasks.q: Report a gap in the records and how you will close it.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ عن فجوة في السجلات وهتقفلها إزاي.
tasks.model: There is one gap: a few early surveys are not signed. I'll ask the consultant to sign them now, before the audit starts.

lessons.title: Joint inspection of final levels
lessons.scene: بتتفق مع الاستشاري على معاينة المناسيب النهائية لمنطقة B قبل التسليم.
dialogue: David, Zone B is ready for the final level inspection.
ديفيد، منطقة B جاهزة لمعاينة المناسيب النهائية.
Great. How do you want to do it?
A joint survey on a ten-metre grid, plus the edges and the drainage lines.
رفع مشترك على شبكة عشرة متر، زائد الأطراف وخطوط التصريف.
What tolerance are you working to?
Plus or minus thirty millimetres, as in the specification.
زائد ناقص تلاتين مللي، زي المواصفات.
Correct. And if some points are outside tolerance?
مظبوط. ولو فيه نقط برّه السماحية؟
We mark them, fix them the same day and re-survey only those points.
بنعلّم عليها، نصلحها في نفس اليوم ونعيد رفع النقط دي بس.
Tuesday at eight is perfect. I'll prepare the grid on the tablet.
التلات الساعة تمانية ممتاز. هجهز الشبكة على التابلت.
Please bring the latest approved drawing too.
وهات آخر رسمة معتمدة كمان لو سمحت.
phrases: What tolerance are you working to?
read: Zone B is ready for the final level inspection.
We will do a joint survey on a ten-metre grid.
The tolerance is plus or minus thirty millimetres.
We fix them the same day and re-survey only those points.
Tuesday at eight is perfect for us.

tasks.q: Propose how to carry out a final level inspection.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح طريقة تنفيذ معاينة المناسيب النهائية.
tasks.model: Zone B is ready for the final level inspection. I suggest a joint survey on a ten-metre grid, plus the edges and the drainage lines, with a tolerance of plus or minus thirty millimetres.

tasks.q: Explain what happens if some points fail.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إيه اللي يحصل لو شوية نقط فشلت.
tasks.model: If some points are outside tolerance, we mark them, fix them the same day, and re-survey only those points, so the inspection can be closed quickly.

lessons.title: Confirming a phone agreement by email
lessons.scene: اتفقتوا على حاجات في التليفون، وإنت بتقترح تأكدها بإيميل.
dialogue: So we agree: you'll resubmit item twelve with the new sections.
يعني متفقين: هتعيد تقديم البند اتناشر بالقطاعات الجديدة.
Yes, and you'll review it before the twentieth.
أيوه، وإنتي هتراجعيه قبل يوم عشرين.
Correct. And item fifteen stays as it is this month.
مظبوط. والبند خمستاشر يفضل زي ما هو الشهر ده.
Agreed. Just to be safe, I'll send you an email to confirm what we agreed.
متفقين. عشان نبقى في الأمان، هبعتلك إيميل يأكد اللي اتفقنا عليه.
Three points only. If anything is wrong, just reply and correct it.
تلات نقط بس. لو فيه أي حاجة غلط، ردي وصححيها.
Thanks, Nadia. Talking by phone is fast, but email keeps a record.
شكرًا يا نادية. التليفون سريع، بس الإيميل بيحفظ سجل.
read: You will resubmit item twelve with the new sections.
Just to be safe, I will send you an email.
If anything is wrong, just reply and correct it.
Talking by phone is fast, but email keeps a record.
The email will confirm what we agreed today.

tasks.q: Summarise a phone agreement and propose confirming it by email.
tasks.q_ar: لخص اتفاق تليفون واقترح تأكيده بإيميل.
tasks.model: So we agree: I'll resubmit item twelve with the new sections, and you'll review it before the twentieth. Just to be safe, I'll send you an email to confirm what we agreed.

tasks.q: Explain why written confirmation is important.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه التأكيد الكتابي مهم.
tasks.model: Talking by phone is fast, but email keeps a record. If there is a disagreement later, we can check what we agreed and when.

lessons.title: Explaining a quantity difference to your manager
lessons.scene: المدير لاحظ إن كمية الردم المقاسة أقل من عدد النقلات، وإنت بتشرح السبب.
dialogue: Hassan, the trucks delivered more fill than the measured volume. Why?
حسن، العربيات وردت ردم أكتر من الحجم المقاس. ليه؟
That's normal. Loose material in a truck takes more space than compacted fill.
ده طبيعي. المادة السايبة في العربية بتاخد مساحة أكتر من الردم المدموك.
How big is the difference usually?
It depends on the material. We confirmed our factor with lab tests.
بيعتمد على المادة. أكدنا المعامل بتاعنا باختبارات معمل.
Is our difference within that range?
Mostly, yes. But last week the difference was too big.
في الأغلب أيوه. بس الأسبوع اللي فات الفرق كان كبير أوي.
إيه اللي حصل الأسبوع اللي فات؟
Some trucks were not fully loaded, but the gate counted them as full loads.
شوية عربيات ماكانتش محمّلة على الآخر، بس البوابة حسبتها حمولات كاملة.
Possibly. I'll check the tickets and adjust the next payment if needed.
ممكن. هراجع التذاكر وأعدّل الدفعة الجاية لو لزم.
phrases: adjust the next payment if needed
read: Loose material takes more space than compacted fill.
It depends on the material.
We confirmed our factor with lab tests.
Some trucks were not fully loaded.
I will check the tickets and adjust the next payment if needed.

tasks.q: Explain why delivered and measured volumes are different.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه الحجم الموّرد مختلف عن المقاس.
tasks.model: That's normal. Loose material in a truck takes more space than compacted fill. The difference depends on the material, and we confirmed our factor with lab tests.

tasks.q: Explain an unusual difference and what you will do.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح فرق غير طبيعي وهتعمل إيه.
tasks.model: Last week the difference was too big, because some trucks were not fully loaded but were counted as full. I will check the tickets and adjust the next payment if needed.

lessons.title: Interview: a problem you solved
lessons.scene: في مقابلة شغل، بيطلبوا منك تحكي عن مشكلة حليتها.
dialogue: Can you tell me about a problem you solved at work?
ممكن تحكيلي عن مشكلة حليتها في الشغل؟
Sure. On my current project, our quantities didn't match the consultant's.
أكيد. في مشروعي الحالي، كمياتنا ماكانتش متطابقة مع الاستشاري.
We used different original ground data. They used the tender survey, and we used a joint survey.
كنا مستخدمين بيانات أرض طبيعية مختلفة. هم استخدموا رفع المناقصة، وإحنا استخدمنا رفع مشترك.
I showed them the signed joint survey and compared both calculations side by side.
وريتهم الرفع المشترك الموقّع وقارنت الحسابين جنب بعض.
They accepted our data, and the difference was paid in the next certificate.
قبلوا بياناتنا، والفرق اتدفع في الشهادة اللي بعدها.
That clear evidence solves disagreements faster than long arguments.
إن الدليل الواضح بيحل الخلافات أسرع من النقاش الطويل.
read: Our quantities did not match the consultant's.
We used different original ground data.
I compared both calculations side by side.
The difference was paid in the next certificate.
Clear evidence solves disagreements faster than long arguments.

tasks.q: Tell an interviewer about a problem you solved, using situation, action and result.
tasks.q_ar: احكي لمقابِل الشغل عن مشكلة حليتها: الموقف، اللي عملته، والنتيجة.
tasks.model: Our quantities didn't match the consultant's, because we used different original ground data. I showed them the signed joint survey and compared both calculations side by side. They accepted our data and the difference was paid.

tasks.q: Say what you learned from the experience.
tasks.q_ar: قول اتعلمت إيه من التجربة.
tasks.model: I learned that clear evidence solves disagreements faster than long arguments. Now I always keep signed surveys and calculations ready.

lessons.title: A difficult day (review)
lessons.scene: مراجعة للمستوى: آخر يوم صعب، والمدير بيسألك حصل إيه وهتعمل إيه.
dialogue: Hassan, I heard today was difficult. What happened?
حسن، سمعت إن النهاردة كان صعب. إيه اللي حصل؟
Three things. First, the consultant rejected a layer because of oversize rocks.
تلات حاجات. أولًا، الاستشاري رفض طبقة بسبب صخور كبيرة.
Yes, we removed the rocks and he approved it after lunch.
أيوه، شلنا الصخور واعتمدها بعد الغدا.
Second, the haulage subcontractor threatened to slow down because of a late payment.
ثانيًا، مقاول النقل هدد إنه يبطّأ بسبب دفعة متأخرة.
I approved that payment an hour ago.
أنا اعتمدت الدفعة دي من ساعة.
Thank you. I already told him. Third, the designer may change the levels near the east boundary.
شكرًا. قلتله خلاص. ثالثًا، المصمم ممكن يغير المناسيب جنب الحد الشرقي.
We're holding the final layer there, and we asked for written confirmation of the hold.
موقّفين الطبقة الأخيرة هناك، وطلبنا تأكيد مكتوب للتأجيل.
read: The consultant rejected a layer because of oversize rocks.
We removed the rocks and he approved it after lunch.
The subcontractor threatened to slow down.
The designer may change the levels near the boundary.
We asked for written confirmation of the hold.

tasks.q: Report three problems from a difficult day in order.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ عن تلات مشاكل من يوم صعب بالترتيب.
tasks.model: Today we had three problems. First, a layer was rejected because of oversize rocks, but we fixed it. Second, the haulage subcontractor threatened to slow down. Third, the designer may change some levels.

tasks.q: Explain your position on a pending design change.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح موقفكم من تغيير تصميم لسه ماتقررش.
tasks.model: We are holding the final layer near the east boundary until the designer decides. We asked for written confirmation of the hold, because it may affect our programme.

lessons.title: Presenting a delay analysis
lessons.scene: في اجتماع مع الاستشاري بتعرض تحليل التأخير في منطقة D، وهو بيقول إن جزء منه من عندكم.
dialogue: Thanks for your time, David. I'd like to walk you through our delay analysis for Zone D.
شكرًا على وقتك يا ديفيد. حابب أمشي معاك في تحليل التأخير بتاعنا لمنطقة D.
Go ahead, but keep in mind we think some of the delay is yours.
اتفضل، بس خلي في بالك إن إحنا شايفين إن جزء من التأخير من عندكم.
That's fair, and I've shown it separately. The access was handed over fourteen days late.
ده منطقي، وأنا موضّحه لوحده. الموقع اتسلم متأخر أربعتاشر يوم.
Agreed, the dates are in the minutes. What about your excavator breakdown?
متفقين، التواريخ موجودة في المحضر. وعطل الحفار بتاعكم؟
It happened during the same period, so the two delays overlap for two days.
حصل في نفس الفترة، فالتأخيرين متداخلين في يومين.
So you accept those two days are concurrent?
يعني إنت موافق إن اليومين دول متزامنين؟
Yes. We're only asking for time for those days, not money.
أيوه. إحنا طالبين وقت بس عن الأيام دي، مش فلوس.
Those are purely caused by the late access, and they were on the critical path.
دول سببهم تأخير التسليم بس، وكانوا على المسار الحرج.
Can you show that on the programme?
Yes, page four shows the planned and actual dates side by side.
أيوه، صفحة أربعة فيها التواريخ المخططة والفعلية جنب بعض.
It looks well prepared. I'll review it and come back to you next week.
شكله متحضّر كويس. هراجعه وأرجعلك الأسبوع الجاي.
read: I would like to walk you through our delay analysis.
The access was handed over fourteen days late.
The two delays overlap for two days.
For the concurrent days, we are asking for time, not money.
The remaining days were on the critical path.

tasks.q: Present a delay analysis and separate your own delay honestly.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض تحليل تأخير وافصل تأخيركم بأمانة.
tasks.model: I'd like to walk you through our delay analysis. The access was handed over fourteen days late. Our excavator breakdown overlapped for two days, so for those concurrent days we only ask for time, not money.

tasks.q: Explain why the remaining delay is critical.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه باقي التأخير حرج.
tasks.model: The remaining twelve days were caused purely by the late access, and the work was on the critical path. Page four of our programme shows the planned and actual dates side by side.

lessons.title: Negotiating a new rate
lessons.scene: بتتفاوض مع الاستشارية على سعر بند المادة المستوردة من المحجر.
dialogue: Hassan, your proposed rate for imported fill is quite high.
حسن، السعر المقترح بتاعك للردم المستورد عالي شوية.
I understand your concern. Which part of the build-up do you disagree with?
فاهم قلقك. إنتي مختلفة مع أنهي جزء في تحليل السعر؟
Mainly the haulage. You assumed a forty-kilometre round trip.
أساسًا النقل. إنت فارض رحلة رايح جاي أربعين كيلو.
That's the actual distance to the only approved borrow pit.
دي المسافة الفعلية لأقرب محجر معتمد، والوحيد.
Is there really no closer source?
There is one, but its material failed the lab tests. I can share the results.
فيه واحد، بس مادته فشلت في اختبارات المعمل. أقدر أبعتلك النتايج.
OK, that explains the distance. What about your overhead percentage?
تمام، ده بيفسر المسافة. ونسبة المصاريف العامة عندك؟
It's the same percentage we used in the original tender.
هي نفس النسبة اللي استخدمناها في المناقصة الأصلية.
Then I can accept it. But the truck productivity looks low to me.
يبقى أقدر أقبلها. بس إنتاجية العربيات شكلها قليلة بالنسبالي.
It's based on three weeks of actual trip records. We're not guessing.
مبنية على تلات أسابيع من سجلات النقلات الفعلية. إحنا مش بنخمّن.
Send me those records and I'll recalculate it on my side.
ابعتلي السجلات دي وأنا هعيد الحساب من عندي.
Will do. I'm confident we'll meet somewhere reasonable.
حاضر. أنا واثق إننا هنتقابل عند رقم معقول.
phrases: Which part do you disagree with?
read: I understand your concern about the rate.
Which part of the build-up do you disagree with?
That is the actual distance to the only approved borrow pit.
The productivity is based on three weeks of actual records.
I am confident we will meet somewhere reasonable.

tasks.q: Respond to "your rate is too high" without getting defensive.
tasks.q_ar: رد على "سعرك عالي" من غير ما تبقى دفاعي.
tasks.model: I understand your concern. Which part of the build-up do you disagree with? If it's the haulage, that's the actual distance to the only approved borrow pit, and I can share the test results of the closer source.

tasks.q: Defend an assumption with evidence.
tasks.q_ar: دافع عن فرضية بالدليل.
tasks.model: Our truck productivity is based on three weeks of actual trip records, so we're not guessing. I'll send you the records, and I'm confident we'll meet somewhere reasonable.

lessons.title: Calming an angry subcontractor
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن متعصب جدًا بسبب خصم في دفعته، وإنت بتهدّي الموقف.
dialogue: This is unacceptable! You deducted almost a quarter of our invoice without telling us!
ده مش مقبول! خصمتوا تقريبًا ربع فاتورتنا من غير ما تقولولنا!
Faisal, I can see you're upset, and I want to sort this out with you.
فيصل، أنا شايف إنك متضايق، وعايز نحل الموضوع ده سوا.
My workers need to be paid. I can't run my business like this.
عمالي لازم ياخدوا فلوسهم. مقدرش أدير شغلي كده.
I completely understand. Let's go through the deductions one by one.
فاهم تمامًا. خلينا نمشي على الخصومات واحدة واحدة.
Fine. Start with the biggest one.
The biggest is the rework of the failed layers in Zone C.
أكبرهم إعادة شغل الطبقات اللي فشلت في منطقة C.
Those layers failed because the water truck was late. That's not our fault.
الطبقات دي فشلت لأن عربية المياه اتأخرت. دي مش غلطتنا.
That's a fair point, and I'll check the water supply records for those days.
ده كلام منطقي، وهراجع سجلات توريد المياه للأيام دي.
And you should have warned us before deducting.
وكان المفروض تنبهونا قبل ما تخصموا.
You're right. Next time you'll get a written notice before any deduction.
عندك حق. المرة الجاية هيوصلك إخطار مكتوب قبل أي خصم.
OK. When will I hear back about the water records?
ماشي. هعرف الرد بخصوص سجلات المياه إمتى؟
By Wednesday. If the delay was ours, we'll release that amount in the next payment.
قبل الأربع. لو التأخير كان من عندنا، هنفك المبلغ ده في الدفعة الجاية.
phrases: Let's go through ... one by one
read: I can see you are upset, and I want to sort this out.
Let's go through the deductions one by one.
That is a fair point, I will check the records.
Next time you will get a written notice before any deduction.
If the delay was ours, we will release that amount.

tasks.q: Calm down an angry person and move to facts.
tasks.q_ar: هدّي شخص غضبان وانقل الكلام للحقايق.
tasks.model: I can see you're upset, and I want to sort this out with you. Let's go through the deductions one by one, starting with the biggest one.

tasks.q: Accept a valid complaint and commit to a fair action.
tasks.q_ar: اقبل شكوى صحيحة والتزم بتصرف عادل.
tasks.model: You're right, we should have warned you before deducting. I'll check the water supply records, and if the delay was ours, we'll release that amount in the next payment.

lessons.title: Pushing back on an unrealistic deadline
lessons.scene: المدير طالب تخلّص كميات ثلاث مناطق في يومين، وإنت بتعترض بلباقة وبتقترح بديل.
dialogue: Hassan, I need the final quantities for Zones B, C and D by Thursday.
حسن، محتاج الكميات النهائية لمناطق B وC وD قبل الخميس.
I'd love to help, but I don't think that's realistic for all three zones.
نفسي أساعد، بس مش شايف إن ده واقعي للتلات مناطق.
Why not? You have the surveys.
For Zone D the final survey hasn't been done yet. It's scheduled for Saturday.
منطقة D لسه الرفع النهائي ماتعملش. متجدول يوم السبت.
The client wants the numbers before the board meeting.
المالك عايز الأرقام قبل اجتماع مجلس الإدارة.
Then here's what I suggest: final figures for B and C on Thursday, and a reliable estimate for D.
يبقى اقتراحي كده: أرقام نهائية لـ B وC يوم الخميس، وتقدير موثوق لـ D.
How reliable would the estimate be?
Within a few percent, based on the last progress survey. I'll label it clearly as an estimate.
في حدود نسبة صغيرة، على أساس آخر رفع للتقدم. وهكتب عليه بوضوح إنه تقدير.
And the final figure for D?
Next Monday, two days after the survey.
OK, that works. Just make sure the estimate isn't mistaken for a final number.
تمام، ده ينفع. بس اتأكد إن التقدير مايتفهمش إنه رقم نهائي.
Absolutely. I'll put it in a separate column with a note.
أكيد. هحطه في عمود لوحده بملاحظة.
phrases: label it clearly as an estimate
read: I would love to help, but that is not realistic for all three zones.
The final survey for Zone D has not been done yet.
Here is what I suggest: final figures for B and C on Thursday.
I will label it clearly as an estimate.
I will put it in a separate column with a note.

tasks.q: Say no to an unrealistic deadline politely, with a reason.
tasks.q_ar: قول لأ لموعد غير واقعي بأدب ومع السبب.
tasks.model: I'd love to help, but I don't think that's realistic for all three zones. The final survey for Zone D hasn't been done yet; it's scheduled for Saturday.

tasks.q: Offer an alternative that meets the real need.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض بديل يحقق الاحتياج الحقيقي.
tasks.model: Here's what I suggest: final figures for B and C on Thursday, and a reliable estimate for D, clearly labelled as an estimate. The final figure for D will follow next Monday.

lessons.title: Warning about a time bar
lessons.scene: بتنبّه المدير إن فيه مدة تعاقدية للإخطار عن المطالبة هتخلص قريب.
dialogue: Khaled, I need to flag something urgent about the rock we found in Zone H.
خالد، محتاج أنبهك لحاجة عاجلة عن الصخر اللي لقيناه في منطقة H.
Under our contract, we must give notice of a claim within a fixed period after we become aware of the event.
حسب عقدنا، لازم نبعت إخطار بالمطالبة خلال مدة محددة من وقت ما نعرف بالحدث.
When did we become aware of it?
On the third of this month. So the deadline is close.
يوم تلاتة في الشهر ده. فالمهلة قربت.
What happens if we miss it?
We could lose the right to extra time and money. The notice period is strict.
ممكن نخسر حقنا في الوقت والفلوس الزيادة. مدة الإخطار صارمة.
Then let's send it today. What do we need?
Just a short notice describing the event. The detailed claim can follow later.
إخطار قصير بس بيوصف الحدث. المطالبة التفصيلية ممكن تيجي بعدين.
Draft it and I'll sign it this afternoon.
I'll also start recording the extra resources from today.
وهبدأ كمان أسجل الموارد الإضافية من النهاردة.
phrases: I need to flag something urgent
read: I need to flag something urgent about the rock in Zone H.
We must give notice within a fixed period after we become aware.
We could lose the right to extra time and money.
The detailed claim can follow later.
I will start recording the extra resources from today.

tasks.q: Warn your manager about a contractual deadline.
tasks.q_ar: نبّه مديرك على مهلة تعاقدية.
tasks.model: I need to flag something urgent. Under our contract, we must give notice of a claim within a fixed period after we become aware of the event. We became aware on the third, so the deadline is close.

tasks.q: Explain what must be done now and what can wait.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إيه اللي لازم يتعمل دلوقتي وإيه اللي يستنى.
tasks.model: We should send a short notice today describing the event, because missing the deadline could cost us the right to time and money. The detailed claim can follow later with full records.

lessons.title: Disputing a deduction for defects
lessons.scene: الاستشارية خصمت قيمة إصلاح ميول في منطقة B، وإنت شايف إن العيب مش مسؤوليتكم.
dialogue: We've deducted the cost of repairing the slope erosion in Zone B.
خصمنا تكلفة إصلاح تآكل الميول في منطقة B.
I'd like to understand the basis for that deduction.
The slopes were part of your scope, and they've eroded.
الميول كانت ضمن نطاق شغلكم، واتآكلت.
They were, but they were approved and handed over two months ago.
كانت، بس اتعتمدت واتسلمت من شهرين.
The defects period still applies, though.
Agreed, but the erosion was caused by the heavy rain and the blocked drainage channel.
متفق، بس التآكل سببه المطر الشديد وقناة التصريف المسدودة.
Another contractor dumped material in it. We reported it in writing at the time.
مقاول تاني رمى مخلفات فيها. وبلّغنا عنها كتابة في وقتها.
I wasn't aware of that letter.
I'll forward it now, with the photos. A defect caused by others shouldn't be charged to us.
هبعتهولك دلوقتي بالصور. العيب اللي سببه حد تاني مايتحسبش علينا.
If the letter confirms it, I'll reverse the deduction.
لو الجواب بيأكد ده، هلغي الخصم.
Thank you. We're happy to repair it, but as additional work.
شكرًا. إحنا مستعدين نصلحه، بس كشغل إضافي.
read: I would like to understand the basis for that deduction.
The slopes were approved and handed over two months ago.
The erosion was caused by the blocked drainage channel.
A defect caused by others should not be charged to us.
We are happy to repair it, but as additional work.

tasks.q: Question a deduction and ask for its basis.
tasks.q_ar: اسأل عن أساس خصم واعترض عليه.
tasks.model: I'd like to understand the basis for that deduction. The slopes were approved and handed over two months ago, and the erosion was caused by the heavy rain and a blocked drainage channel.

tasks.q: Offer a solution that protects your position.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض حل يحمي موقفك.
tasks.model: We reported the blocked channel in writing at the time. A defect caused by others shouldn't be charged to us, but we're happy to repair it as additional work.

lessons.title: A value engineering proposal
lessons.scene: بتعرض على ممثل المالك فكرة توفّر فلوس: معالجة مادة الموقع بدل استيراد ردم.
dialogue: Mr. Grant, we have a proposal that could save time and money on Zone F.
مستر جرانت، عندنا اقتراح ممكن يوفر وقت وفلوس في منطقة F.
Instead of importing fill from the borrow pit, we could treat the site material and reuse it.
بدل ما نستورد ردم من المحجر، ممكن نعالج مادة الموقع ونستخدمها تاني.
By screening out the oversize rocks and mixing it with a small amount of lime.
بغربلة الصخور الكبيرة وخلطها بكمية صغيرة من الجير.
Our trial results say yes, but we'd need the designer's approval.
نتايج التجربة بتقول أيوه، بس محتاجين موافقة المصمم.
Mainly haulage and import costs. We'd also cut around three weeks from the programme.
أساسًا تكاليف النقل والاستيراد. وكمان هنوفر حوالي تلات أسابيع من البرنامج.
We'd propose to share them, as the contract allows for value engineering.
هنقترح نقسمه، زي ما العقد بيسمح للهندسة القيمية.
Put it in writing with the trial results, and I'll take it to the design team.
اكتبه رسمي بنتايج التجربة، وأنا هعرضه على فريق التصميم.
phrases: cut three weeks from the programme
read: We have a proposal that could save time and money.
Instead of importing fill, we could treat the site material.
Our trial results say it meets the specification.
We would also cut around three weeks from the programme.
We would propose to share the savings.

tasks.q: Present a cost-saving idea to the client.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض فكرة توفير على المالك.
tasks.model: We have a proposal that could save time and money. Instead of importing fill from the borrow pit, we could treat the site material by screening out the oversize rocks and mixing it with a little lime.

tasks.q: Explain the conditions and the benefits.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الشروط والفوايد.
tasks.model: Our trial results meet the specification, but we need the designer's approval. The savings come mainly from haulage and import costs, and we'd propose to share them, as the contract allows.

lessons.title: Chasing a pending decision
lessons.scene: مكالمة مع الاستشاري تتابع فيها قرار المهندس بخصوص المطالبة اللي بقالها فترة.
dialogue: Hi David, sorry to chase you, but I'm calling about our claim for the late access.
أهلًا ديفيد، آسف إني بتابع وراك، بس بكلمك عن مطالبتنا بخصوص تأخير التسليم.
Yes, it's on my desk. It's been a busy month.
أيوه، على مكتبي. الشهر كان زحمة.
I understand. We submitted it about six weeks ago.
فاهم. قدمناها من حوالي ست أسابيع.
Is there a deadline you're worried about?
The contract gives a period for the engineer to respond, and we're getting close to it.
العقد بيدي مدة للمهندس يرد فيها، وإحنا بنقرب منها.
Fair enough. Is there anything missing from your submission?
ماشي. فيه حاجة ناقصة في التقديم بتاعكم؟
Not that we know of. If you need anything else, we can send it within a day.
مش عارفين حاجة. لو محتاج أي حاجة تانية، نقدر نبعتها خلال يوم.
Actually, I'd like the daily labour records for those weeks.
الحقيقة، عايز سجلات العمالة اليومية للأسابيع دي.
No problem, you'll have them tomorrow. Could we pencil in a meeting to discuss it?
مفيش مشكلة، هتوصلك بكرة. ممكن نحجز مبدئيًا ميعاد نناقشها؟
Perfect. I'll send an invitation and the records together.
ممتاز. هبعت الدعوة والسجلات مع بعض.
read: Sorry to chase you, but I am calling about our claim.
We submitted it about six weeks ago.
The contract gives a period for the engineer to respond.
If you need anything else, we can send it within a day.
Could we pencil in a meeting to discuss it?

tasks.q: Chase a pending decision politely but firmly.
tasks.q_ar: تابع قرار متأخر بأدب وحزم.
tasks.model: Sorry to chase you, but I'm calling about our claim for the late access. We submitted it about six weeks ago, and the contract gives a period for the engineer to respond, so we're getting close to it.

tasks.q: Offer support and secure a next step.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض مساعدة وثبّت خطوة جاية.
tasks.model: If you need anything else, we can send it within a day. Could we pencil in a meeting next week to discuss the claim?

lessons.title: Presenting the monthly report
lessons.scene: بتعرض التقرير الشهري في اجتماع المالك: الإنجاز، المخاطر، والقرارات المطلوبة.
dialogue: Good morning, everyone. I'll cover three things: progress, key risks and the decisions we need from you.
صباح الخير للجميع. هغطي تلات حاجات: التقدم، المخاطر الأساسية، والقرارات اللي محتاجينها منكم.
In terms of progress, we've completed about sixty percent of the total earthworks volume.
من ناحية التقدم، خلّصنا حوالي ستين في المية من إجمالي حجم أعمال الحفر والردم.
Is that in line with the programme?
We're about two weeks behind, mainly due to the late access to Zone D.
متأخرين حوالي أسبوعين، أساسًا بسبب تأخير تسليم منطقة D.
The biggest risk is the shortage of suitable fill. If the value engineering proposal is rejected, we'll depend on one borrow pit.
أكبر خطر هو نقص الردم الصالح. لو اقتراح الهندسة القيمية اترفض، هنعتمد على محجر واحد.
Two. A handover date for Zone H, and approval of the treated material by the end of the month.
اتنين. ميعاد تسليم منطقة H، واعتماد المادة المعالجة قبل آخر الشهر.
I'll push the design team on the second one.
هضغط على فريق التصميم في التانية.
Thank you. If both happen, we can recover most of the delay.
شكرًا. لو الاتنين حصلوا، نقدر نعوّض معظم التأخير.
Clear and concise. Thank you, Hassan.
phrases: the decisions we need from you
read: I will cover three things: progress, key risks and decisions.
We have completed about sixty percent of the total volume.
We are about two weeks behind, mainly due to late access.
The biggest risk is the shortage of suitable fill.
If both decisions happen, we can recover most of the delay.

tasks.q: Open a presentation with a clear structure and give progress.
tasks.q_ar: افتح عرض بهيكل واضح وقدّم التقدم.
tasks.model: Good morning, everyone. I'll cover three things: progress, key risks and the decisions we need from you. In terms of progress, we've completed about sixty percent of the total volume, and we're about two weeks behind.

tasks.q: Present a risk and the decisions you need.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض خطر والقرارات المطلوبة.
tasks.model: The biggest risk is the shortage of suitable fill. We need two decisions: a handover date for Zone H and approval of the treated material. If both happen, we can recover most of the delay.

lessons.title: Balancing safety and production
lessons.scene: مسؤول السلامة عايز يقلل سرعة العربيات أكتر، وإنت قلقان على الإنتاج، وبتوصلوا لحل وسط.
dialogue: I want to reduce the speed limit on the haul road from thirty to twenty.
عايز أقلل حد السرعة على طريق النقل من تلاتين لعشرين.
I fully support safety, but that could cut our trips by around fifteen percent.
أنا داعم السلامة تمامًا، بس ده ممكن يقلل نقلاتنا بحوالي خمستاشر في المية.
We had two near misses at the crossing this month.
حصل عندنا حادثتين وشيكتين عند التقاطع الشهر ده.
That's serious. Were both at the same crossing?
ده خطير. الاتنين عند نفس التقاطع؟
Yes, where the haul road crosses the access road.
أيوه، المكان اللي طريق النقل بيعدي فيه طريق الدخول.
Then what if we keep thirty on the straight sections, and twenty near the crossing only?
طب إيه رأيك نخلي تلاتين في الأجزاء المستقيمة، وعشرين جنب التقاطع بس؟
That could work, if we add a flagman at the crossing.
ده ممكن ينفع، لو زودنا عامل إشارة عند التقاطع.
Agreed. And speed bumps before the crossing on both sides.
متفقين. ومطبات قبل التقاطع من الناحيتين.
Good. I'll monitor it for two weeks.
If the near misses continue, we'll reduce the limit everywhere. Safety comes first.
لو الحوادث الوشيكة استمرت، هنقلل الحد في كل حتة. السلامة أولًا.
phrases: what if we keep ... and ... only?
read: I fully support safety, but that could cut our trips.
We had two near misses at the crossing this month.
What if we keep thirty on the straight sections?
We will add a flagman and speed bumps at the crossing.
If the near misses continue, we will reduce the limit everywhere.

tasks.q: Support a safety concern while explaining the production impact.
tasks.q_ar: ادعم قلق السلامة ووضح الأثر على الإنتاج.
tasks.model: I fully support safety, but a lower limit everywhere could cut our trips by around fifteen percent. Since both near misses were at the crossing, let's focus on that area.

tasks.q: Propose a compromise that keeps people safe.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح حل وسط يحافظ على أمان الناس.
tasks.model: What if we keep thirty on the straight sections and twenty near the crossing, with a flagman and speed bumps? If the near misses continue, we'll reduce the limit everywhere.

lessons.title: Briefing a new site engineer on the contract
lessons.scene: مهندس موقع جديد، وإنت بتعرّفه بالنقط التعاقدية اللي لازم ياخد باله منها في شغله اليومي.
dialogue: Hassan, what should I know about the contract from day one?
حسن، إيه اللي لازم أعرفه عن العقد من أول يوم؟
Three habits. First, never act on a verbal instruction for extra work without confirming it in writing.
تلات عادات. أولًا، ماتنفذش أبدًا تعليمات شفوية لشغل إضافي من غير ما تأكدها كتابة.
Even if the consultant is standing next to me?
Especially then. Ask politely for a site instruction, or send a confirmation email the same day.
خصوصًا ساعتها. اطلب بأدب تعليمات موقع، أو ابعت إيميل تأكيد في نفس اليوم.
Record everything that affects time or cost: delays, standby, weather, access problems.
سجّل كل حاجة بتأثر على الوقت أو التكلفة: التأخيرات، وقت الانتظار، الجو، مشاكل الوصول.
Yes, with photos and times. Records written at the time are much stronger than memories.
أيوه، بالصور والمواعيد. السجلات اللي بتتكتب وقتها أقوى بكتير من الذاكرة.
Tell me immediately about anything unexpected, like rock or buried services. Some notices have strict time limits.
بلّغني فورًا بأي حاجة غير متوقعة، زي صخر أو مرافق مدفونة. فيه إخطارات ليها مهل صارمة.
Any time. When in doubt, ask before you act.
في أي وقت. لو شاكك، اسأل قبل ما تتصرف.
phrases: never act on a verbal instruction
When in doubt, ask before you act
لو شاكك، اسأل قبل ما تتصرف
read: Never act on a verbal instruction without confirming it in writing.
Record everything that affects time or cost.
Records written at the time are stronger than memories.
Tell me immediately about anything unexpected.
When in doubt, ask before you act.

tasks.q: Give a new engineer three contract habits.
tasks.q_ar: ادي مهندس جديد تلات عادات تعاقدية.
tasks.model: First, never act on a verbal instruction for extra work without confirming it in writing. Second, record everything that affects time or cost. Third, report anything unexpected immediately, because some notices have strict time limits.

tasks.q: Explain why records written at the time matter.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه السجلات وقت الحدث مهمة.
tasks.model: Records written at the time, with photos and times, are much stronger than memories. If there is a claim later, the consultant will trust contemporary records.

lessons.title: Negotiating access with the municipality
lessons.scene: مفتش البلدية رافض العربيات تستخدم الطريق العام في ساعات الذروة، وإنت بتتفاوض.
dialogue: Your trucks can't use the public road between seven and nine in the morning.
عربياتكم ماينفعش تستخدم الطريق العام بين سبعة وتسعة الصبح.
I understand the traffic concerns. May I explain our situation?
فاهم مخاوف الزحمة. ممكن أشرح موقفنا؟
Our only route to the borrow pit uses this road. Two hours without trips means a significant loss of production.
الطريق الوحيد للمحجر بيستخدم الشارع ده. ساعتين من غير نقلات يعني خسارة إنتاج كبيرة.
The residents have complained about the noise and the dust.
We take that seriously. What if we limit the number of trucks during those hours instead of stopping completely?
إحنا واخدين ده بجدية. إيه رأيك نحدد عدد العربيات في الساعات دي بدل ما نوقف خالص؟
How many trucks are we talking about?
Half the normal number, all covered, and with a sweeper truck cleaning the road.
نص العدد العادي، كلها متغطية، ومعاها عربية كنس بتنضف الطريق.
We'll ban horns near the houses and brief every driver.
هنمنع الكلاكسات جنب البيوت ونبلغ كل سواق.
I can accept a one-month trial. If there are complaints, the ban comes back.
أقدر أوافق على تجربة شهر. لو فيه شكاوى، المنع يرجع.
That's fair. Could you confirm the conditions in writing?
ده عادل. ممكن تأكد الشروط كتابة؟
read: I understand the traffic concerns, may I explain our situation?
Two hours without trips means a significant loss of production.
What if we limit the number of trucks instead of stopping?
All trucks will be covered, with a sweeper cleaning the road.
Could you confirm the conditions in writing?

tasks.q: Respond to an authority's restriction by explaining your situation.
tasks.q_ar: رد على قيد من جهة رسمية بشرح موقفك.
tasks.model: I understand the traffic concerns. May I explain our situation? Our only route to the borrow pit uses this road, so two hours without trips means a significant loss of production.

tasks.q: Offer conditions that address their concerns.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض شروط تعالج مخاوفهم.
tasks.model: What if we limit the trucks to half the normal number during those hours, all covered, with a sweeper truck and no horns near the houses? We'd accept a one-month trial.

lessons.title: Unforeseen rock
lessons.scene: لقيتوا صخر في منطقة H مكانش ظاهر في تقرير التربة، وبتناقش الاستشاري.
dialogue: David, we've hit hard rock in Zone H at about one metre below ground.
ديفيد، قابلنا صخر صلب في منطقة H على عمق حوالي متر تحت الأرض.
Is it widespread or just a few boulders?
منتشر ولا شوية صخور كبيرة بس؟
It looks continuous across most of the zone. Our excavators can't break it without a hydraulic breaker.
شكله متصل في معظم المنطقة. الحفارات بتاعتنا ماتقدرش تكسره من غير كسارة هيدروليك.
The ground investigation report didn't show rock there.
تقرير فحص التربة ماكانش فيه صخر هناك.
Exactly. The nearest borehole is more than two hundred metres away, and it showed only sand.
بالظبط. أقرب جسة على بعد أكتر من مية متر، وماكانش فيها غير رمل.
So you consider it an unforeseeable condition.
يعني إنتو شايفينها ظروف ماكانش ممكن توقعها.
Yes. An experienced contractor couldn't have expected it from the information we had at tender.
أيوه. مقاول خبير ماكانش هيتوقعها من المعلومات اللي كانت عندنا في المناقصة.
What do you need from me now?
First, a joint inspection today to record the extent. Then we'll submit our notice.
الأول، معاينة مشتركة النهاردة نسجل فيها امتداد الصخر. وبعدين هنقدم الإخطار.
I can come at two. Should you stop work there?
أقدر آجي الساعة اتنين. توقفوا الشغل هناك؟
We've moved the excavators to Zone G, so there's no idle equipment while we wait.
نقلنا الحفارات لمنطقة G، فمفيش معدات واقفة وإحنا مستنيين.
Good. That keeps the cost down for everyone.
كويس. ده بيقلل التكلفة على الكل.
phrases: widespread or just a few boulders
read: We have hit hard rock at about one metre below ground.
The ground investigation report did not show rock there.
An experienced contractor could not have expected it.
First, we need a joint inspection to record the extent.
We moved the excavators, so there is no idle equipment.

tasks.q: Report unforeseen ground conditions and why they were unforeseeable.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ عن ظروف أرض غير متوقعة وليه ماكانش ممكن توقعها.
tasks.model: We've hit hard rock in Zone H about one metre below ground. The ground investigation report didn't show rock there, and the nearest borehole showed only sand, so an experienced contractor couldn't have expected it.

tasks.q: Explain your immediate actions to protect the project and your rights.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إجراءاتك الفورية لحماية المشروع وحقوقكم.
tasks.model: We'd like a joint inspection today to record the extent, and then we'll submit our notice. Meanwhile we moved the excavators to Zone G, so there's no idle equipment.

lessons.title: Teaching a junior to check claims
lessons.scene: المساعد بيراجع فاتورة مقاول باطن، وإنت بتعلمه يراجع إزاي بدل ما يقبل الأرقام.
dialogue: Hassan, the subcontractor's invoice looks fine. Shall I approve it?
حسن، فاتورة مقاول الباطن شكلها كويس. أعتمدها؟
Before you approve anything, tell me what you checked.
قبل ما تعتمد أي حاجة، قولي راجعت إيه.
The totals add up, and the rates match the subcontract.
الإجماليات مظبوطة، والأسعار مطابقة لعقد الباطن.
Good start. Did you check the quantities against our own records?
بداية كويسة. راجعت الكميات على سجلاتنا إحنا؟
Not yet. I assumed their numbers were right.
That's the key lesson: never assume. Compare their trip count with the gate sheets.
دي أهم نقطة: ماتفترضش أبدًا. قارن عدد النقلات بتاعهم بكشوف البوابة.
Check that every item has an instruction or a contract basis, and look for anything claimed twice.
اتأكد إن كل بند ليه تعليمات أو أساس في العقد، ودوّر على أي حاجة متطالب بيها مرتين.
More often than you think, usually by mistake. Standby hours are a common one.
أكتر مما تتخيل، غالبًا بالغلط. ساعات الانتظار من أشهر الحاجات.
I'll go through it again and bring you the differences.
Great. Write down each difference with its evidence, and we'll discuss it with them.
عظيم. اكتب كل فرق بالدليل بتاعه، وهنناقشه معاهم.
read: Before you approve anything, tell me what you checked.
Did you check the quantities against our own records?
That is the key lesson: never assume.
Look for anything claimed twice.
Write down each difference with its evidence.

tasks.q: Teach a junior how to check an invoice.
tasks.q_ar: علّم مبتدئ يراجع فاتورة إزاي.
tasks.model: Before you approve anything, check the quantities against our own records, like the gate sheets. Make sure every item has an instruction or a contract basis, and look for anything claimed twice.

tasks.q: Explain the key lesson you want them to remember.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح أهم درس عايزه يفتكره.
tasks.model: The key lesson is never assume. Even if the totals add up and the rates match, the quantities can still be wrong. Write down each difference with its evidence.

lessons.title: Defending a rate build-up
lessons.scene: الاستشارية بتراجع تحليل سعر بند الكسارة الهيدروليك، وبتسأل عن كل جزء.
dialogue: Let's go through your build-up for rock breaking line by line.
خلينا نمشي على تحليل سعر تكسير الصخر سطر سطر.
Sure. The main cost is the excavator with a hydraulic breaker, at the hire company's rate.
أكيد. التكلفة الأساسية هي الحفار بالكسارة الهيدروليك، بسعر شركة الإيجار.
Do you have a quotation for that?
Yes, three quotations. We used the lowest one.
Good. Where does your output figure come from?
From a two-day trial in Zone H, measured jointly with your surveyor.
من تجربة يومين في منطقة H، اتقاست بالاشتراك مع المساح بتاعكم.
Two days is a short trial.
Agreed. We're happy to adjust the rate after two more weeks of actual production.
متفقين. مستعدين نعدّل السعر بعد أسبوعين كمان من الإنتاج الفعلي.
That's sensible. What about the wear on the breaker tools?
It's included as a separate line, based on the supplier's replacement interval.
موجود كسطر لوحده، على أساس فترة الاستبدال من المورد.
I'll accept it as an interim rate, subject to review.
That works for us. Let's agree the review date now.
ده مناسب لينا. خلينا نتفق على ميعاد المراجعة دلوقتي.
phrases: an interim rate, subject to review
read: The main cost is the excavator with a hydraulic breaker.
We have three quotations and we used the lowest one.
The output comes from a trial measured jointly with your surveyor.
We are happy to adjust the rate after two more weeks.
Let's agree the review date now.

tasks.q: Explain where the numbers in your rate come from.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الأرقام في سعرك جاية منين.
tasks.model: The main cost is the excavator with a breaker, priced from the lowest of three quotations. The output comes from a two-day trial measured jointly with your surveyor.

tasks.q: Accept a fair condition and fix a next step.
tasks.q_ar: اقبل شرط عادل وثبّت خطوة جاية.
tasks.model: We're happy for it to be an interim rate, subject to review after two more weeks of actual production. Let's agree the review date now.

lessons.title: Whose design error?
lessons.scene: فيه خطأ في رسومات الميول اكتُشف بعد التنفيذ، والمصمم بيحاول يحمّلكم جزء منه.
dialogue: Hassan, the slopes in Zone E are steeper than they should be.
حسن، الميول في منطقة E أشد من المفروض.
We built them exactly as shown on revision C of your drawing.
إحنا نفذناها بالظبط زي المراجعة C من رسمتكم.
Revision C had an error. We fixed it in revision D.
المراجعة C كان فيها غلط. صلحناه في المراجعة D.
We finished those slopes a month ago, and we never received revision D.
إحنا خلّصنا الميول دي من شهر، وعمرنا مااستلمنا المراجعة D.
Really? It should have gone through document control.
بجد؟ المفروض كانت عدّت على إدارة الوثائق.
I've checked our transmittal register. The last drawing we received for Zone E was revision C.
راجعت سجل الاستلام عندنا. آخر رسمة استلمناها لمنطقة E كانت المراجعة C.
Then the reworking is not your responsibility.
Correct. We can regrade the slopes, but it will be additional work with its own instruction.
مظبوط. نقدر نعيد تسوية الميول، بس هتبقى شغل إضافي بتعليمات خاصة بيه.
Understood. I'll inform the engineer today.
Thank you. Please also make sure revision D reaches us formally.
شكرًا. واتأكد إن المراجعة D توصلنا رسمي كمان لو سمحت.
read: We built them exactly as shown on revision C.
We never received revision D.
The last drawing we received was revision C.
The reworking is not our responsibility.
Please make sure revision D reaches us formally.

tasks.q: Defend your work when the design was wrong.
tasks.q_ar: دافع عن شغلك لما التصميم كان غلط.
tasks.model: We built the slopes exactly as shown on revision C of your drawing. We finished them a month ago, and according to our transmittal register we never received revision D.

tasks.q: Agree to fix it under the right conditions.
tasks.q_ar: وافق تصلح بالشروط الصح.
tasks.model: We can regrade the slopes, but it will be additional work with its own instruction, because the error was in the design, not in our construction.

lessons.title: Presenting a productivity analysis
lessons.scene: بتعرض على المدير تحليل لوقت المعدات الضايع وإزاي تحسّنوه.
dialogue: Khaled, I analysed the equipment logs for the last four weeks.
خالد، حللت سجلات المعدات لآخر أربع أسابيع.
Our excavators are productive only about sixty percent of their working hours.
الحفارات بتاعتنا بتنتج حوالي ستين في المية بس من ساعات الشغل.
The biggest loss is waiting for trucks. That's almost a quarter of the time.
أكبر خسارة الانتظار للعربيات. ده تقريبًا ربع الوقت.
Not necessarily. The real problem is the queue at the weighbridge at peak times.
مش بالضرورة. المشكلة الحقيقية الطابور عند الميزان في وقت الذروة.
Stagger the shift start times by thirty minutes, and add a second weighbridge lane.
نوزّع مواعيد بداية الورديات بفرق نص ساعة، ونضيف حارة تانية للميزان.
If we cut the waiting time by half, our output should increase noticeably without new equipment.
لو قللنا وقت الانتظار للنص، الإنتاج هيزيد بشكل ملحوظ من غير معدات جديدة.
Let's try it next week and measure the result.
خلينا نجربها الأسبوع الجاي ونقيس النتيجة.
read: Our excavators are productive only about sixty percent of the time.
The biggest loss is waiting for trucks.
The real problem is the queue at the weighbridge.
We could stagger the shift start times by thirty minutes.
Output should increase without new equipment.

tasks.q: Present a finding from data and its real cause.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض نتيجة من البيانات وسببها الحقيقي.
tasks.model: I analysed the equipment logs for four weeks. Our excavators are productive only about sixty percent of the time. The biggest loss is waiting for trucks, but the real problem is the queue at the weighbridge.

tasks.q: Propose a low-cost improvement and how to measure it.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح تحسين قليل التكلفة وإزاي نقيسه.
tasks.model: Let's stagger the shift start times by thirty minutes and add a second weighbridge lane. If we cut the waiting time by half, output will increase without new equipment. We can measure it next week.

lessons.title: Asked to accelerate
lessons.scene: ممثل المالك عايزكم تسرّعوا عشان تعوضوا التأخير، وإنت بتوضح مين يتحمل التكلفة.
dialogue: Hassan, we need Zone D finished three weeks earlier than your current forecast.
حسن، محتاجين منطقة D تخلص قبل توقعكم الحالي بتلات أسابيع.
We can do that, but it means acceleration: more equipment and a second shift.
نقدر، بس ده معناه تسريع: معدات أكتر وردية تانية.
Can't you do it with your current resources?
Not realistically. Our current forecast already reflects full use of what we have.
مش بشكل واقعي. توقعنا الحالي أصلًا مبني على الاستخدام الكامل للي عندنا.
Who pays for the extra resources?
Most of the current delay comes from the late access, which wasn't our risk.
معظم التأخير الحالي من تأخير التسليم، وده ماكانش من مخاطرنا.
So you'd expect us to pay.
For the part that recovers the employer's delay, yes. That's why we need a formal instruction to accelerate.
للجزء اللي بيعوّض تأخير المالك، أيوه. وعشان كده محتاجين تعليمات رسمية بالتسريع.
I'll prepare a costed proposal by Sunday, with the resources and the new dates.
هجهز عرض بالتكلفة قبل الأحد، بالموارد والتواريخ الجديدة.
OK. Don't start until we've agreed the cost.
تمام. ماتبدأش لحد ما نتفق على التكلفة.
Agreed. We'll be ready to mobilise within a week of the instruction.
متفقين. هنكون جاهزين نحشد الموارد خلال أسبوع من التعليمات.
read: It means acceleration, more equipment and a second shift.
Our forecast already reflects full use of our resources.
Most of the delay comes from the late access.
That is why we need a formal instruction to accelerate.
We will be ready to mobilise within a week.

tasks.q: Explain what acceleration requires.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح التسريع محتاج إيه.
tasks.model: We can finish three weeks earlier, but it means acceleration: more equipment and a second shift. Our current forecast already reflects full use of the resources we have.

tasks.q: Explain who should pay and what you need before starting.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح مين المفروض يدفع ومحتاجين إيه قبل البداية.
tasks.model: Most of the delay comes from the late access, which wasn't our risk. So we need a formal instruction to accelerate, and I'll prepare a costed proposal before we start.

lessons.title: Settling a subcontractor's final account
lessons.scene: مقاول النقل خلّص شغله، وبتتفاوضوا على الحساب الختامي.
dialogue: Hassan, our final account is ready. We're claiming a bit more than you've certified.
حسن، حسابنا الختامي جاهز. إحنا بنطالب بشوية أكتر من اللي اعتمدتوه.
Thanks, Faisal. Let's separate the agreed items from the disputed ones.
شكرًا يا فيصل. خلينا نفصل البنود المتفق عليها عن المختلف عليها.
Most of the haulage is agreed. The dispute is about standby time.
معظم النقل متفق عليه. الخلاف على وقت الانتظار.
We accept standby when it was caused by us and recorded on the day.
بنقبل وقت الانتظار لما يكون السبب من عندنا ومتسجل في نفس اليوم.
Some days weren't signed by your supervisor.
بعض الأيام ماتوقعتش من المشرف بتاعكم.
Then we need another way to verify them. Do you have the GPS logs from your trucks?
يبقى محتاجين طريقة تانية نتحقق بيها. عندك سجلات الجي بي إس من عربياتك؟
Good. If the GPS shows the trucks waiting at our loading area, we'll accept those hours.
كويس. لو الجي بي إس بيوضح إن العربيات كانت مستنية في منطقة التحميل عندنا، هنقبل الساعات دي.
For days with no evidence at all, I'm afraid we can't pay. But I'm open to a fair compromise on the borderline cases.
للأيام اللي مفيهاش أي دليل، للأسف مانقدرش ندفع. بس أنا مستعد لحل وسط عادل في الحالات اللي على الحدود.
That sounds fair. I'll send the GPS data this week.
ده باين عادل. هبعت بيانات الجي بي إس الأسبوع ده.
Great. Let's aim to sign the final account by the end of the month.
عظيم. خلينا نستهدف نوقع الحساب الختامي قبل آخر الشهر.
phrases: separate the agreed items from the disputed ones
نفصل البنود المتفق عليها عن المختلف عليها
read: Let's separate the agreed items from the disputed ones.
We accept standby when it was recorded on the day.
Do you have the GPS logs from your trucks?
I am open to a fair compromise on the borderline cases.
Let's aim to sign the final account by the end of the month.

tasks.q: Structure a final account negotiation.
tasks.q_ar: نظّم تفاوض على حساب ختامي.
tasks.model: Let's separate the agreed items from the disputed ones. We accept standby time when it was caused by us and recorded on the day. For unsigned days, we need another way to verify them, like GPS logs.

tasks.q: Say no to unsupported claims but stay open to compromise.
tasks.q_ar: ارفض المطالبات من غير دليل بس خليك منفتح لحل وسط.
tasks.model: For days with no evidence at all, I'm afraid we can't pay. But I'm open to a fair compromise on the borderline cases, and let's aim to sign by the end of the month.

lessons.title: Explaining the volume method to an auditor
lessons.scene: المدققة بتسألك عن طريقة حساب الكميات وإزاي تتأكد إنها صح.
dialogue: Mr. Sabery, could you explain how you calculate the earthworks volumes?
أستاذ صبري، ممكن تشرح بتحسب كميات الحفر والردم إزاي؟
Certainly. We use a surface-to-surface method in Civil 3D.
طبعًا. بنستخدم طريقة سطح لسطح على سيفيل ثري دي.
For cut, the original ground and the excavated surface. Both come from joint surveys.
للقطع، الأرض الطبيعية والسطح بعد الحفر. الاتنين من رفوعات مشتركة.
How do you know the software result is correct?
بتعرف إزاي إن نتيجة البرنامج صح؟
We cross-check with a second method: average end areas from cross sections every twenty metres.
بنراجع بطريقة تانية: متوسط المساحات من قطاعات عرضية كل عشرين متر.
And how close are the two methods?
والطريقتين قريبين من بعض قد إيه؟
Usually within one percent. If the difference is bigger, we investigate before submitting.
عادةً في حدود واحد في المية. لو الفرق أكبر، بنحقق قبل ما نقدّم.
Here's Zone B: the surface report, the section sheets and the comparison.
دي منطقة B: تقرير الأسطح، وشيتات القطاعات، والمقارنة.
This is very transparent. Thank you.
You're welcome. Every file is linked to the signed survey it came from.
العفو. كل ملف مربوط بالرفع الموقّع اللي جاي منه.
phrases: We cross-check with a second method
عادةً في حدود واحد في المية
read: We use a surface-to-surface method in Civil 3D.
Both surfaces come from joint surveys.
We cross-check with a second method using cross sections.
If the difference is bigger, we investigate before submitting.
Every file is linked to the signed survey it came from.

tasks.q: Explain your volume calculation method to an auditor.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح طريقة حساب الحجم لمدقق.
tasks.model: We use a surface-to-surface method. For cut, the two surfaces are the original ground and the excavated surface, and both come from joint surveys.

tasks.q: Explain how you verify the result with a second method.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح بتتحقق من النتيجة بطريقة تانية إزاي.
tasks.model: We cross-check with a second method, the average end areas from cross sections. The two methods are usually within one percent; if not, we investigate before submitting.

lessons.title: The client wants to omit work
lessons.title_ar: المالك عايز يلغي جزء من الشغل
lessons.scene: ممثل المالك بيقول هيلغوا منطقة J من نطاقكم ويدّوها لمقاول تاني، وإنت حذر في ردك.
dialogue: Hassan, we're considering removing Zone J from your scope.
حسن، بنفكر نشيل منطقة J من نطاق شغلكم.
Another contractor can do it together with the utilities.
مقاول تاني يقدر يعملها مع المرافق.
I see. Before we respond formally, we'll need to check the contract carefully.
فاهم. قبل ما نرد رسمي، محتاجين نراجع العقد بعناية.
Omitting work to give it to others can have contractual consequences. We'd like our contracts team to review it.
إلغاء شغل عشان يتدّي لغيرنا ممكن يكون ليه تبعات تعاقدية. حابين فريق العقود عندنا يراجعه.
We're not trying to cause problems.
I understand, and we want to support the project. We've also already mobilised resources for Zone J.
فاهم، وإحنا عايزين ندعم المشروع. وكمان إحنا حشدنا موارد لمنطقة J خلاص.
Equipment bookings and a survey of the area. I'll list the costs we've already incurred.
حجوزات معدات ورفع مساحي للمنطقة. هعمل قايمة بالتكاليف اللي صرفناها.
Please send that, along with your view.
ابعت ده لو سمحت، مع رأيكم.
We'll reply in writing within the week, after our contracts team has reviewed it.
هنرد كتابة خلال الأسبوع، بعد ما فريق العقود يراجعه.
read: Before we respond formally, we need to check the contract.
Omitting work can have contractual consequences.
We would like our contracts team to review it.
I will list the costs we have already incurred.
We will reply in writing within the week.

tasks.q: Respond carefully when the client wants to remove work.
tasks.q_ar: رد بحذر لما المالك عايز يشيل شغل.
tasks.model: May I ask why? Before we respond formally, we'll need to check the contract carefully, because omitting work to give it to others can have contractual consequences.

tasks.q: Protect your position without being negative.
tasks.q_ar: احمي موقفكم من غير ما تبقى سلبي.
tasks.model: We want to support the project. We've already mobilised some resources for Zone J, so I'll list the costs we've incurred, and we'll reply in writing within the week.

lessons.title: Cash flow worries
lessons.scene: المدير قلقان من فلوس المشروع، وإنت بتشرح ليه التدفق ضعيف وإزاي تحسّنوه.
dialogue: Hassan, finance says our cash flow on this project is negative. Why?
حسن، المالية بتقول التدفق النقدي في المشروع ده بالسالب. ليه؟
Mainly timing. We pay suppliers in thirty days, but the client pays us much later.
أساسًا التوقيت. بندفع للموردين في تلاتين يوم، بس المالك بيدفعلنا بعدها بكتير.
The certification and payment periods together are longer than our supplier terms.
مدد الاعتماد والدفع مع بعض أطول من شروط الموردين بتوعنا.
Yes. Two variations worth a lot are still unpriced, so they're not in any certificate yet.
أيوه. أمرين تغيير قيمتهم كبيرة لسه ماتسعروش، فمش داخلين في أي شهادة.
Submit the variation quotations this week and ask for interim payment on account.
نقدم عروض أسعار أوامر التغيير الأسبوع ده ونطلب دفعة مؤقتة تحت الحساب.
Negotiate longer terms with the two biggest suppliers, and make sure every payment application goes in on time.
نتفاوض على مدد أطول مع أكبر موردين، ونتأكد إن كل مستخلص بيتقدم في ميعاده.
Put that in a one-page plan for the director.
حط ده في خطة صفحة واحدة للمدير العام.
read: Our cash flow is negative mainly because of timing.
We pay suppliers in thirty days, but the client pays us later.
Two variations are still unpriced.
We should ask for an interim payment on account.
We should negotiate longer terms with our biggest suppliers.

tasks.q: Explain the reasons for negative cash flow.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح أسباب التدفق النقدي السالب.
tasks.model: It's mainly timing. We pay our suppliers in thirty days, but the client's certification and payment periods are longer. Also, two big variations are still unpriced, so they're not in any certificate.

tasks.q: Propose quick actions to improve it.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح إجراءات سريعة تحسّنه.
tasks.model: We should submit the variation quotations this week and ask for an interim payment on account. On our side, we can negotiate longer terms with our two biggest suppliers.

lessons.title: Leading a safety stand-down
lessons.scene: بعد حادثة بسيطة، إنت ومسؤول السلامة بتديروا وقفة سلامة للعمال.
dialogue: Hassan, can you open the stand-down? The men respect you.
حسن، ممكن تفتتح وقفة السلامة؟ الرجالة بيحترموك.
Sure. Good morning, everyone. We've stopped work for thirty minutes because of yesterday's incident.
أكيد. صباح الخير للجميع. وقفنا الشغل نص ساعة بسبب حادثة امبارح.
A worker's hand was injured while he was clearing a blocked bucket without isolating the machine.
إيد عامل اتصابت وهو بينضف جردل مسدود من غير ما يعزل المعدة.
But it could have been. I want to be very clear: nobody puts their hands near a machine unless the engine is off.
بس كان ممكن تبقى. عايز أكون واضح جدًا: محدش يقرّب إيده من معدة إلا والموتور طافي.
And the key is with the operator.
Exactly. Engine off, key out, and the operator confirms. No exceptions, even if you're in a hurry.
بالظبط. الموتور طافي، المفتاح برّه، والسواق يأكد. مفيش استثناءات، حتى لو مستعجل.
And remember, if you feel something is unsafe, you have the right to stop the work. Nobody will blame you.
وافتكروا، لو حسيت إن فيه حاجة مش آمنة، من حقك توقف الشغل. محدش هيلومك.
Thank you, Hassan. Let's sign the attendance sheet before we restart.
شكرًا يا حسن. خلينا نوقع كشف الحضور قبل ما نرجع للشغل.
خلوا بالكم من نفسكم يا جماعة.
phrases: I want to be very clear
you have the right to stop the work
read: We have stopped work because of yesterday's incident.
I want to be very clear about this rule.
Engine off, key out, and the operator confirms.
There are no exceptions, even if you are in a hurry.
