You have the right to stop the work if it is unsafe.

tasks.q: Open a safety stand-down and explain the incident.
tasks.q_ar: افتتح وقفة سلامة واشرح الحادثة.
tasks.model: Good morning, everyone. We've stopped work for thirty minutes because of yesterday's incident. A worker's hand was injured while he cleared a blocked bucket without isolating the machine.

tasks.q: State the safety rule firmly and empower the workers.
tasks.q_ar: قول قاعدة السلامة بحزم وادّي العمال الصلاحية.
tasks.model: I want to be very clear: engine off, key out, and the operator confirms, with no exceptions. And if you feel something is unsafe, you have the right to stop the work.

lessons.title: Weather records for a claim
lessons.scene: الاستشارية بتسأل عن الأدلة على أيام المطر اللي بتطالبوا بيها.
dialogue: You're claiming nine days for exceptional rain. What's your evidence?
إنتو بتطالبوا بتسع أيام بسبب مطر استثنائي. إيه دليلكم؟
Three sources. Our site rain gauge, the national weather service data, and the daily reports.
تلات مصادر. مقياس المطر بتاعنا في الموقع، بيانات الأرصاد الوطنية، والتقارير اليومية.
Rain alone isn't enough. It has to be exceptional.
المطر لوحده مش كفاية. لازم يكون استثنائي.
Agreed. We compared this year's rainfall with the ten-year average for the same months.
متفقين. قارنّا كمية المطر السنة دي بمتوسط عشر سنين لنفس الشهور.
It was more than three times the average, and the heavy days were consecutive.
كانت أكتر من تلات أضعاف المتوسط، والأيام الشديدة كانت ورا بعض.
Did the rain actually stop your work, or just slow it down?
المطر فعلًا وقّف شغلكم، ولا بس بطّأه؟
It stopped all filling, because wet material can't be compacted to specification.
وقّف كل الردم، لأن المادة المبلولة مينفعش تتدمك حسب المواصفات.
What about the days after the rain?
We included two drying days, supported by moisture test results.
حطينا يومين تنشيف، مدعومين بنتايج اختبارات الرطوبة.
That's a well-supported claim. I'll recommend the time, at least.
دي مطالبة مدعومة كويس. هوصي بالوقت على الأقل.
Thank you. We'll provide anything else you need.
شكرًا. هنوفّر أي حاجة تانية تحتاجيها.
read: We have three sources of evidence for the rain.
We compared the rainfall with the ten-year average.
It was more than three times the average.
Wet material cannot be compacted to specification.
We included two drying days, supported by moisture tests.

tasks.q: Present evidence for a weather claim.
tasks.q_ar: قدّم أدلة لمطالبة بسبب الجو.
tasks.model: We have three sources: our site rain gauge, the national weather data, and the daily reports. We compared the rainfall with the ten-year average, and it was more than three times higher.

tasks.q: Explain why the rain stopped the work, not just slowed it.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه المطر وقّف الشغل مش بس بطّأه.
tasks.model: The rain stopped all filling, because wet material can't be compacted to specification. We also included two drying days, supported by moisture test results.

lessons.title: Responding to a warning letter
lessons.scene: المهندس بعت خطاب يحذركم من بطء التقدم، وإنت والمدير بتخططوا للرد.
dialogue: We received a letter from the engineer saying our progress is too slow.
وصلنا خطاب من المهندس بيقول إن تقدمنا بطيء أوي.
I read it. The tone is strong, but our reply should stay calm and factual.
قريته. النبرة شديدة، بس ردنا لازم يفضل هادي ومبني على حقايق.
Agreed. How should we structure it?
First, acknowledge their concern. Then explain the causes, with references to our earlier notices.
الأول نعترف بقلقهم. بعدين نشرح الأسباب، بالإشارة لإخطاراتنا السابقة.
Should we mention the late access again?
Yes, clearly. Most of the delay comes from it, and we notified them at the time.
أيوه، بوضوح. معظم التأخير منه، وإحنا بلّغناهم في وقتها.
We should be honest about them and show what we've already done to recover.
لازم نكون صريحين فيها ونوضح عملنا إيه خلاص عشان نعوّض.
End with a constructive proposal: a recovery programme and a request for the outstanding decisions.
نختم باقتراح بنّاء: برنامج تعويض وطلب للقرارات المعلّقة.
That turns a complaint into a discussion. Draft it today.
ده بيحوّل الشكوى لنقاش. اكتب المسودة النهاردة.
I'll have it ready by four, with all the references attached.
هتبقى جاهزة الساعة أربعة، بكل المراجع مرفقة.
read: The tone is strong, but our reply should stay calm and factual.
First, we acknowledge their concern clearly.
Explain the causes with references to our earlier notices.
We should be honest about our own delays.
End with a constructive proposal and a recovery programme.

tasks.q: Plan a reply to a strong letter from the engineer.
tasks.q_ar: خطط للرد على خطاب شديد من المهندس.
tasks.model: Our reply should stay calm and factual. First, we acknowledge their concern. Then we explain the causes, with references to our earlier notices about the late access.

tasks.q: Explain how to end the reply constructively.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إزاي نختم الرد بشكل بنّاء.
tasks.model: We should be honest about our own delays and show what we've done to recover. Then we end with a constructive proposal: a recovery programme and a request for the outstanding decisions.

lessons.title: Chairing an interface meeting
lessons.scene: إنت بتدير اجتماع تنسيق بين فرق الحفريات والمرافق والطرق.
dialogue: Good morning, everyone. Our aim today is to agree the sequence in Zone J for the next four weeks.
صباح الخير للجميع. هدفنا النهاردة نتفق على تسلسل الشغل في منطقة J للأربع أسابيع الجاية.
The utilities team needs to go first. Our pipes are the deepest.
فريق المرافق لازم يبدأ الأول. مواسيرنا هي الأعمق.
That makes sense. How long do you need before we can fill over them?
ده منطقي. محتاجين قد إيه قبل ما نقدر نردم فوقها؟
About two weeks, including the pressure tests.
حوالي أسبوعين، بما فيهم اختبارات الضغط.
OK. Meanwhile, we'll work in the northern half, away from your trenches.
تمام. في الوقت ده، هنشتغل في النص الشمالي، بعيد عن خنادقكم.
They'll start the sub-base once our final levels are approved. Let's put a target date on that.
هيبدأوا الأساس المساعد أول ما مناسيبنا النهائية تتعتمد. خلينا نحط تاريخ مستهدف لده.
Who is responsible for the crossing points?
Good question. I suggest your team marks them, and we protect them during filling.
سؤال كويس. أقترح فريقكم يعلّمها، وإحنا نحميها وقت الردم.
Let me summarise the actions and owners. I'll circulate the minutes this afternoon.
خليني ألخّص الإجراءات والمسؤولين عنها. هوزّع المحضر بعد الضهر.
phrases: put a target date on that
read: Our aim today is to agree the sequence in Zone J.
How long do you need before we can fill over them?
Meanwhile, we will work in the northern half.
Let me summarise the actions and owners.
I will circulate the minutes this afternoon.

tasks.q: Open a coordination meeting with a clear aim.
tasks.q_ar: افتتح اجتماع تنسيق بهدف واضح.
tasks.model: Good morning, everyone. Our aim today is to agree the sequence of work in Zone J for the next four weeks, so the teams don't block each other.

tasks.q: Close the meeting by summarising actions and owners.
tasks.q_ar: اختم الاجتماع بتلخيص الإجراءات والمسؤولين.
tasks.model: Let me summarise. Utilities go first for two weeks; we work in the northern half meanwhile; your team marks the crossing points and we protect them. I'll circulate the minutes this afternoon.

lessons.title: A disturbed control point
lessons.scene: المساح لقى إن نقطة تحكم أساسية اتحركت، وده ممكن يأثر على رفوعات قديمة.
dialogue: Hassan, we have a problem. Control point CP7 has been moved.
حسن، عندنا مشكلة. نقطة التحكم سي بي سبعة اتحركت.
When we checked it from two other points, it was off by several centimetres.
لما راجعناها من نقطتين تانيين، كانت مزاحة بكام سنتي.
When was it last checked correctly?
آخر مرة اتراجعت وكانت سليمة إمتى؟
Three weeks ago, during the monthly check.
من تلات أسابيع، في المراجعة الشهرية.
So any survey based on CP7 since then could be affected.
يعني أي رفع معتمد على سي بي سبعة من ساعتها ممكن يكون متأثر.
Exactly. Mainly the fill surveys in Zone C.
بالظبط. أساسًا رفوعات الردم في منطقة C.
Then we need to re-establish CP7 from the primary network and re-process those surveys.
يبقى لازم نعيد تثبيت سي بي سبعة من الشبكة الرئيسية ونعيد معالجة الرفوعات دي.
Yes, today. It's better they hear it from us than find it later.
أيوه، النهاردة. أحسن يسمعوها مننا بدل ما يكتشفوها بعدين.
I'll also protect the new point with a concrete block and a fence.
وهحمي النقطة الجديدة ببلوك خرسانة وسور كمان.
Good. And from now on, let's check the control points weekly near active areas.
كويس. ومن هنا ورايح، خلينا نراجع نقط التحكم كل أسبوع جنب المناطق الشغالة.
phrases: better they hear it from us
read: Control point CP7 has been moved.
Any survey based on it since then could be affected.
We need to re-establish it from the primary network.
It is better they hear it from us than find it later.
Let's check the control points weekly near active areas.

tasks.q: React to a disturbed control point and assess the impact.
tasks.q_ar: اتصرف مع نقطة تحكم اتحركت وقيّم الأثر.
tasks.model: When was it last checked correctly? If it was three weeks ago, any survey based on CP7 since then could be affected, mainly the fill surveys in Zone C.

tasks.q: Decide the actions and explain why you inform the consultant.
tasks.q_ar: قرر الإجراءات واشرح ليه هتبلّغ الاستشاري.
tasks.model: We'll re-establish CP7 from the primary network and re-process the affected surveys. We'll tell the consultant today, because it's better they hear it from us than find it later.

lessons.title: The cost of rework
lessons.scene: المدير بيسأل تكلفة إعادة الطبقات الفاشلة الشهر ده، وإنت بتعرض الأرقام والدروس.
dialogue: Hassan, how much did rework cost us this month?
حسن، إعادة الشغل كلفتنا قد إيه الشهر ده؟
I've estimated it at around three percent of the month's earthworks cost.
قدّرتها بحوالي تلاتة في المية من تكلفة الحفر والردم في الشهر.
In percentage, yes. But it's equal to about four days of full production.
كنسبة أيوه. بس هي تعادل حوالي أربع أيام إنتاج كامل.
Two causes account for most of it: layers placed too thick, and late water supply.
سببين بيمثلوا معظمها: طبقات اتفردت تخينة زيادة، وتأخير توريد المياه.
The layer thickness, completely. The water supply, partly.
سُمك الطبقة تمامًا. توريد المياه جزئيًا.
Level pegs on every layer, a pass counter on each roller, and a second water supplier.
أوتاد منسوب على كل طبقة، وعداد مرات على كل هراس، ومورد مياه تاني.
Track it monthly. I want to see it go down.
تابعها كل شهر. عايز أشوفها بتقل.
I'll add a rework indicator to the monthly report from now on.
هضيف مؤشر لإعادة الشغل في التقرير الشهري من هنا ورايح.
read: I have estimated the rework at around three percent.
It is equal to about four days of full production.
Two causes account for most of it.
The layer thickness is completely under our control.
I will add a rework indicator to the monthly report.

tasks.q: Put a cost into perspective for your manager.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح حجم تكلفة لمديرك بشكل مفهوم.
tasks.model: I've estimated the rework at around three percent of the month's earthworks cost. That sounds small, but it's equal to about four days of full production.

tasks.q: Explain the causes and the corrective actions.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الأسباب والإجراءات التصحيحية.
tasks.model: Two causes account for most of it: layers placed too thick and late water supply. We added level pegs, pass counters on the rollers and a second water supplier, and I'll track rework monthly.

lessons.title: Sharing surplus material
lessons.scene: المقاول المجاور محتاج ردم وإنتو عندكم فائض، وبتتفاوضوا على شروط.
dialogue: Hassan, I hear you have surplus fill material. We're short on our side.
حسن، سمعت إن عندكم ردم زيادة. إحنا عندنا نقص.
We do, but it's the employer's material, so we can't simply sell it.
فعلًا، بس دي مادة المالك، فمانقدرش نبيعها كده.
If the employer approves, we could load it and you collect it from our stockpile.
لو المالك وافق، نقدر نحمّلها وإنتو تستلموها من الكومة بتاعتنا.
Only for loading and the gate checking, at cost. The material itself is the employer's decision.
على التحميل وفحص البوابة بس، بالتكلفة. المادة نفسها قرار المالك.
That's reasonable. How do we measure what we take?
ده معقول. هنقيس اللي هناخده إزاي؟
We survey the stockpile before and after, jointly. No arguments later.
نرفع الكومة قبل وبعد، بالاشتراك. من غير خلافات بعدين.
Fair enough. Who asks the employer?
You do, since it's your request, but I'll confirm the quantity and the material test results.
إنتو، لأنه طلبكم، بس أنا هأكد الكمية ونتايج اختبارات المادة.
Great. Let's put it on next week's coordination agenda.
عظيم. نحطها على جدول اجتماع التنسيق الأسبوع الجاي.
Good idea. Please bring your trucks' details and the dates you need.
فكرة كويسة. هات بيانات عربياتكم والتواريخ اللي محتاجينها.
read: It is the employer's material, so we cannot simply sell it.
If the employer approves, you could collect it from our stockpile.
We would charge only for loading, at cost.
We survey the stockpile before and after, jointly.
Let's put it on next week's coordination agenda.

tasks.q: Explain why you can't just sell the material, and the options.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ليه مينفعش تبيع المادة، والخيارات المتاحة.
tasks.model: It's the employer's material, so we can't simply sell it. If the employer approves, you could collect it from our stockpile, and we'd charge only for loading, at cost.

tasks.q: Propose a fair way to measure and agree the quantity.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح طريقة عادلة لقياس الكمية والاتفاق عليها.
tasks.model: We survey the stockpile before and after, jointly, so there are no arguments later. I'll also confirm the material test results for your records.

lessons.title: Giving feedback to a team member
lessons.scene: مساعدك عمل غلطة في مستخلص، وإنت بتديله ملاحظات بشكل بنّاء.
dialogue: Karim, have you got ten minutes? I'd like to give you some feedback on the payment application.
كريم، معاك عشر دقايق؟ حابب أديك شوية ملاحظات على المستخلص.
First, the good part: your summary sheet was very clear, and the consultant commented on it.
الأول، الجزء الكويس: شيت الملخص بتاعك كان واضح جدًا، والاستشاري علّق عليه.
The issue is item eighteen. The quantity included a stockpile that was already paid last month.
المشكلة في البند تمنتاشر. الكمية كان فيها كومة اتدفعت خلاص الشهر اللي فات.
Oh no. So we claimed it twice.
يا خبر. يعني طالبنا بيها مرتين.
Yes. The consultant caught it, which affects our credibility.
أيوه. الاستشاري لقطها، وده بيأثر على مصداقيتنا.
I'm really sorry. How do I avoid it next time?
أنا آسف جدًا. أتجنبها إزاي المرة الجاية؟
Keep a cumulative register: previous quantity, this month, and total to date, for every item.
اعمل سجل تراكمي: الكمية السابقة، الشهر ده، والإجمالي لحد دلوقتي، لكل بند.
That makes sense. I'll set it up this week.
Great. Everyone makes mistakes. What matters is that we build a system so it doesn't happen again.
عظيم. الكل بيغلط. المهم إننا نعمل نظام عشان ماتتكررش.
Thanks for explaining it this way.
read: I would like to give you some feedback on the payment application.
First, the good part: your summary sheet was very clear.
The quantity included a stockpile that was already paid.
Keep a cumulative register for every item.
What matters is that we build a system so it does not happen again.

tasks.q: Give constructive feedback starting with something positive.
tasks.q_ar: ادي ملاحظات بنّاءة تبدأ بحاجة إيجابية.
tasks.model: I'd like to give you some feedback. First, the good part: your summary sheet was very clear. The issue is item eighteen: it included a stockpile already paid last month, so we claimed it twice.

tasks.q: Help them build a system to avoid repeating the mistake.
tasks.q_ar: ساعده يعمل نظام يمنع تكرار الغلطة.
tasks.model: Keep a cumulative register for every item: previous quantity, this month and total to date. Everyone makes mistakes; what matters is that we build a system so it doesn't happen again.

lessons.title: Clearing up an email misunderstanding
lessons.scene: الاستشارية فهمت إيميلك غلط وافتكرت إنكم موافقين على خصم، وإنت بتوضح.
dialogue: Hassan, your email says you accept the deduction on item nine.
حسن، الإيميل بتاعك بيقول إنكم موافقين على الخصم في البند تسعة.
I think there's been a misunderstanding. Could you read me the sentence?
أعتقد فيه سوء فهم. ممكن تقريلي الجملة؟
It says: we note the deduction on item nine.
بتقول: نحيط علمًا بالخصم في البند تسعة.
I see why it was confusing. By "note" I meant we received it, not that we agree with it.
فاهم ليه كانت ملخبطة. قصدي بكلمة "نحيط علمًا" إننا استلمناه، مش إننا موافقين عليه.
No. We disagree with the deduction, for the reasons in our earlier letter.
لأ. إحنا معترضين على الخصم، للأسباب اللي في جوابنا السابق.
Then please send a clear correction, so it's on record.
يبقى ابعت تصحيح واضح لو سمحتي، عشان يتسجل.
I'll do it today. My apologies for the confusion.
Lesson learned. In future, I'll write "we do not accept" when that's what we mean.
اتعلمت الدرس. بعد كده هكتب "لا نقبل" لما يكون ده قصدي.
Absolutely. You'll have the correction within the hour.
phrases: I see why it was confusing
read: I think there has been a misunderstanding.
By note I meant we received it, not that we agree.
We disagree with the deduction for the reasons in our letter.
I will send a clear correction today.
In future, I will write we do not accept when I mean it.

tasks.q: Clear up a misunderstanding about your position.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح سوء فهم بخصوص موقفك.
tasks.model: I think there's been a misunderstanding. By "note" I meant we received the deduction, not that we agree with it. We disagree, for the reasons in our earlier letter.

tasks.q: Correct it formally and say what you will do differently.
tasks.q_ar: صححه رسمي وقول هتعمل إيه مختلف.
tasks.model: I'll send a clear correction today, so it's on record. My apologies for the confusion. In future, I'll write "we do not accept" when that's what we mean.

lessons.title: Presenting lessons learned
lessons.scene: في جلسة الدروس المستفادة بعد خلوص مرحلة، بتعرض أهم 3 دروس.
dialogue: Hassan, what are the key lessons from Phase One?
حسن، إيه أهم الدروس من المرحلة الأولى؟
I'd highlight three. The first is about surveys.
هركز على تلاتة. الأول عن الرفع المساحي.
We lost time and money when original ground surveys weren't signed before work started. In Phase Two, no work starts without a signed survey.
خسرنا وقت وفلوس لما رفوعات الأرض الطبيعية ماكانتش متوقعة قبل الشغل. في المرحلة التانية، مفيش شغل يبدأ من غير رفع موقّع.
Notices. When we sent notices on time, our claims were accepted much more easily.
الإخطارات. لما بعتنا الإخطارات في وقتها، مطالباتنا اتقبلت بسهولة أكتر بكتير.
Coordination. Most of our rework came from interfaces with other teams, not from our own work.
التنسيق. معظم إعادة الشغل جت من التداخل مع فرق تانية، مش من شغلنا إحنا.
A weekly interface meeting with a shared look-ahead plan.
اجتماع تنسيق أسبوعي بخطة قصيرة المدى مشتركة.
Excellent. Let's turn those three into rules for Phase Two.
ممتاز. خلينا نحول الثلاثة دول لقواعد للمرحلة التانية.
I'll write them up as a one-page checklist for every engineer.
هكتبهم في قايمة مراجعة صفحة واحدة لكل مهندس.
read: I would highlight three key lessons from Phase One.
In Phase Two, no work starts without a signed survey.
When we sent notices on time, our claims were accepted more easily.
Most of our rework came from interfaces with other teams.
I will write them up as a one-page checklist.

tasks.q: Present three lessons learned clearly.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض تلات دروس مستفادة بوضوح.
tasks.model: I'd highlight three lessons. First, no work should start without a signed original ground survey. Second, notices sent on time make claims much easier. Third, most rework came from interfaces with other teams.

tasks.q: Turn the lessons into practical rules.
tasks.q_ar: حوّل الدروس لقواعد عملية.
tasks.model: For Phase Two, I suggest we hold a weekly interface meeting with a shared look-ahead plan, and I'll write the lessons up as a one-page checklist for every engineer.

lessons.title: Interview: why should we hire you?
lessons.scene: مقابلة لوظيفة مدير كميات، والسؤال الأصعب: ليه إنت؟
dialogue: This is a QS Manager role. Why should we hire you?
دي وظيفة مدير كميات. ليه نعيّنك؟
Because I combine two skill sets that are rarely found together: quantity surveying and field surveying.
لأني بجمع بين مجموعتين مهارات نادرًا ما بيتلاقوا مع بعض: حساب الكميات والمساحة الميدانية.
Why does that matter for a QS Manager?
Because in earthworks, quantities depend on surveys. I can check the data myself, not just the final numbers.
لأن في الحفريات، الكميات بتعتمد على الرفع المساحي. أقدر أراجع البيانات بنفسي، مش بس الأرقام النهائية.
On my current project, I found an error in the original ground data that would have cost us a significant amount.
في مشروعي الحالي، لقيت غلط في بيانات الأرض الطبيعية كان هيكلفنا مبلغ كبير.
I train junior QSs to check, not assume, and I build simple registers so errors are caught early.
بدرب مهندسي الكميات المبتدئين يراجعوا مش يفترضوا، وبعمل سجلات بسيطة عشان الأخطاء تتمسك بدري.
I used to do too much myself. Now I delegate more and review the critical items.
كنت بعمل حاجات كتير بنفسي. دلوقتي بفوّض أكتر وبراجع البنود الحرجة.
Thank you, Hassan. That was a strong answer.
شكرًا يا حسن. دي كانت إجابة قوية.
Thank you. I'd welcome the chance to bring this to your projects.
شكرًا. يسعدني تبقى عندي الفرصة أقدم ده لمشاريعكم.
read: I combine quantity surveying and field surveying.
In earthworks, quantities depend on surveys.
I train junior QSs to check, not assume.
I used to do too much myself, now I delegate more.
I would welcome the chance to bring this to your projects.

tasks.q: Answer "Why should we hire you?" with your unique strength.
tasks.q_ar: جاوب على "ليه نعيّنك؟" بنقطة قوتك المميزة.
tasks.model: I combine two skill sets that are rarely found together: quantity surveying and field surveying. In earthworks, quantities depend on surveys, so I can check the data myself, not just the final numbers.

tasks.q: Answer the weakness question honestly and positively.
tasks.q_ar: جاوب على سؤال نقطة الضعف بصراحة وإيجابية.
tasks.model: I used to do too much myself. Now I delegate more, train the team to check instead of assume, and I personally review the critical items.

lessons.title: Updating the baseline programme
lessons.scene: مهندس التخطيط عايز يحدّث البرنامج، وإنت بتنبّه لفرق مهم بين التحديث وتغيير البرنامج الأساسي.
dialogue: Hassan, I'm thinking of updating the baseline to show the new dates for Zone D.
حسن، بفكر أحدّث البرنامج الأساسي عشان يوضح التواريخ الجديدة لمنطقة D.
Careful. If we change the baseline, we may lose the comparison we need for our delay claim.
خلي بالك. لو غيرنا البرنامج الأساسي، ممكن نخسر المقارنة اللي محتاجينها لمطالبة التأخير.
Why? The dates have clearly changed.
The baseline shows what we planned. The update shows what actually happened. We need both.
البرنامج الأساسي بيوضح اللي خططناه. والتحديث بيوضح اللي حصل فعلًا. محتاجين الاتنين.
So I should produce a progress update instead?
يعني أعمل تحديث تقدم بدل كده؟
Exactly. Keep the approved baseline, and show the actual dates and forecasts in the monthly update.
بالظبط. حافظ على البرنامج الأساسي المعتمد، ووضّح التواريخ الفعلية والتوقعات في التحديث الشهري.
And if the engineer grants an extension of time?
ولو المهندس وافق على تمديد المدة؟
Then we revise the baseline formally, with the engineer's approval, and we archive the old one.
ساعتها نعدّل البرنامج الأساسي رسمي، بموافقة المهندس، ونأرشف القديم.
Got it. I'll save the current version as a reference before anything else.
فهمت. هحفظ النسخة الحالية كمرجع قبل أي حاجة.
Good idea. Label every version with a date and a status.
فكرة كويسة. اكتب على كل نسخة التاريخ والحالة.
Thanks. I almost made a costly mistake.
That's why we talk before we change things.
عشان كده بنتكلم قبل ما نغيّر حاجات.
phrases: what we planned vs what actually happened
اللي خططناه مقابل اللي حصل فعلًا
read: If we change the baseline, we may lose the comparison.
The baseline shows what we planned.
The update shows what actually happened.
We revise the baseline only with the engineer's approval.
Label every version with a date and a status.

tasks.q: Explain the difference between a baseline and a progress update.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الفرق بين البرنامج الأساسي وتحديث التقدم.
tasks.model: The baseline shows what we planned, and the progress update shows what actually happened. We need both, because the comparison supports our delay claim.

tasks.q: Explain when the baseline can be changed.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح إمتى ينفع نغيّر البرنامج الأساسي.
tasks.model: We keep the approved baseline and show actual dates in the monthly update. We revise the baseline only formally, with the engineer's approval, for example after an extension of time, and we archive the old version.

lessons.title: Settling disputed quantities
lessons.scene: اجتماع لتسوية كل البنود المختلف عليها قبل الحساب الختامي للمرحلة.
dialogue: We have seven disputed items. Shall we start with the largest?
عندنا سبع بنود مختلف عليها. نبدأ بالأكبر؟
I'd suggest starting with the ones closest to agreement. It builds momentum.
أقترح نبدأ بالأقرب للاتفاق. ده بيعمل زخم.
Fine. Items three and five differ only by small amounts.
ماشي. البنود تلاتة وخمسة الفرق فيهم بسيط.
Then let's split the difference on both and close them.
يبقى نقسم الفرق في الاتنين ونقفلهم.
Agreed. Now item nine, the unsuitable material.
متفقين. دلوقتي البند تسعة، المادة غير الصالحة.
For item nine, we have the engineer's signed inspection. I'm not able to compromise on that one.
في البند تسعة، معانا معاينة المهندس الموقعة. مقدرش أتنازل في ده.
I accept the material, but I still question the depth.
أنا قابلة المادة، بس لسه عندي تساؤل عن العمق.
Then let's agree the principle today, and re-check the depth with a joint survey.
يبقى نتفق على المبدأ النهاردة، ونعيد مراجعة العمق برفع مشترك.
That works. What about the standby claims?
Those need more time. Can we park them and set a separate meeting?
دي محتاجة وقت أكتر. ممكن نأجلها ونعمل اجتماع لوحده؟
Yes. So five items closed or agreed in principle today.
أيوه. يبقى خمس بنود اتقفلت أو اتفقنا على مبدئها النهاردة.
That's real progress. I'll send the summary for signature this afternoon.
ده تقدم حقيقي. هبعت الملخص للتوقيع بعد الضهر.

Let's agree the principle today and re-check the depth.
Can we park them and set a separate meeting?

tasks.q: Suggest a negotiation strategy for several disputed items.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح استراتيجية تفاوض لبنود كتير مختلف عليها.
tasks.model: I'd suggest starting with the items closest to agreement, because it builds momentum. For items with small differences, let's split the difference and close them.

tasks.q: Hold firm on one item and park another politely.
tasks.q_ar: اثبت على بند وأجّل بند تاني بأدب.
tasks.model: For item nine we have the engineer's signed inspection, so I'm not able to compromise on that one. The standby claims need more time, so can we park them and set a separate meeting?

lessons.title: Monthly meeting simulation (review)
lessons.scene: مراجعة المستوى: اجتماع شهري كامل مع ممثل المالك، فيه تقدم ومخاطر وتفاوض.
dialogue: Let's begin. Hassan, where do we stand?
Overall progress is around seventy percent, and we've recovered one of the two weeks of delay.
التقدم العام حوالي سبعين في المية، وعوّضنا أسبوع من أسبوعين التأخير.
Good. How did you recover it?
By fixing the weighbridge queue and the layer thickness problem. No extra equipment was needed.
بحل طابور الميزان ومشكلة سُمك الطبقة. ماحتجناش معدات زيادة.
ممتاز. إيه اللي لسه في خطر؟
Zone H. The rock is slowing us down, and the engineer hasn't responded to our notice yet.
منطقة H. الصخر مبطّأنا، والمهندس لسه مارداش على إخطارنا.
I'll follow that up personally. What else do you need from us?
هتابع ده بنفسي. محتاجين مننا إيه تاني؟
Approval of the treated material. It would save around three weeks and reduce imported fill.
اعتماد المادة المعالجة. هيوفر حوالي تلات أسابيع ويقلل الردم المستورد.
The design team has some doubts about long-term settlement.
فريق التصميم عنده شكوك عن الهبوط على المدى الطويل.
We can address that. We'll propose a monitoring programme with settlement plates for the first year.
نقدر نعالج ده. هنقترح برنامج مراقبة بألواح هبوط للسنة الأولى.
That could convince them. Send it this week.
ده ممكن يقنعهم. ابعته الأسبوع ده.
Will do. To summarise: a decision on the rock notice, and on the treated material, ideally before month end.
حاضر. للتلخيص: قرار في إخطار الصخر، وفي المادة المعالجة، يا ريت قبل آخر الشهر.
read: Overall progress is around seventy percent.
We recovered one week without extra equipment.
The engineer has not responded to our notice yet.
We will propose a monitoring programme with settlement plates.
Ideally, we need both decisions before the end of the month.

tasks.q: Give a confident status update in a client meeting.
tasks.q_ar: ادي تحديث حالة بثقة في اجتماع مع المالك.
tasks.model: Overall progress is around seventy percent, and we've recovered one of the two weeks of delay by fixing the weighbridge queue and the layer thickness, without extra equipment.

tasks.q: Address a client's doubt and close with clear requests.
tasks.q_ar: عالج شك عند المالك واختم بطلبات واضحة.
tasks.model: We can address the settlement concern with a monitoring programme and settlement plates for the first year. To summarise, we need a decision on the rock notice and on the treated material, ideally before month end.

lessons.title: Handling a hostile question
lessons.scene: في اجتماع مع المالك، حد بيهاجم أرقامكم قدام الكل، وإنت بترد بهدوء وثقة.
dialogue: Frankly, Hassan, your quantities keep going up. It looks like you're inflating them.
بصراحة يا حسن، كمياتكم بتزيد على طول. باين إنكم بتنفخوها.
I understand why it might look that way, and I'm glad you raised it openly.
فاهم ليه ممكن تبان كده، وأنا مبسوط إنك فتحت الموضوع بصراحة.
Certainly. Almost all of the increase comes from two instructed changes: the higher levels in Zone F and the rock in Zone H.
طبعًا. تقريبًا كل الزيادة جاية من تغييرين بتعليمات: المناسيب الأعلى في منطقة F والصخر في منطقة H.
The rest is within the normal re-measurement range, and every figure is backed by a joint survey.
الباقي في حدود إعادة القياس الطبيعية، وكل رقم وراه رفع مشترك.
So you're saying none of it is padding.
يعني إنت بتقول مفيش منها حاجة متنفّخة.
I'm saying every cubic metre can be traced to a signed survey. I'd be happy to walk your team through it line by line.
أنا بقول إن كل متر مكعب ممكن نتتبعه لرفع موقّع. ويسعدني أمشي مع فريقك عليه سطر سطر.
That would help. My board is asking hard questions.
ده هيساعد. مجلس الإدارة عندي بيسأل أسئلة صعبة.
Then let's give them a one-page reconciliation: original quantity, each change, and the current total.
يبقى نديهم ملخص مطابقة صفحة واحدة: الكمية الأصلية، وكل تغيير، والإجمالي الحالي.
If you can get that to me by Thursday, it would make my life a lot easier.
لو تقدر توصلهولي قبل الخميس، هيسهّل حياتي كتير.
Consider it done. And thank you for asking me directly rather than assuming.
اعتبره حصل. وشكرًا إنك سألتني مباشرة بدل ما تفترض.
phrases: I'm glad you raised it openly
read: I understand why it might look that way, and I am glad you raised it.
Almost all of the increase comes from two instructed changes.
Every cubic metre can be traced to a signed survey.
Let's give them a one-page reconciliation.
Thank you for asking me directly rather than assuming.

tasks.q: Respond calmly to an accusation that your quantities are inflated.
tasks.q_ar: رد بهدوء على اتهام إن كمياتكم متنفخة.
tasks.model: I understand why it might look that way, and I'm glad you raised it openly. Almost all of the increase comes from two instructed changes, and every cubic metre can be traced to a signed survey.

tasks.q: Offer transparency to rebuild trust.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض الشفافية عشان ترجع الثقة.
tasks.model: I'd be happy to walk your team through it line by line. Let's also prepare a one-page reconciliation for your board: original quantity, each change, and the current total.

lessons.title: Persuading the board to approve treated fill
lessons.scene: بتعرض قدام لجنة المالك ليه لازم يعتمدوا المادة المعالجة، ولازم تقنعهم في دقيقتين.
dialogue: Thank you for the time. I'll keep this short: approving treated site material saves time, money and risk.
شكرًا على الوقت. هختصر: اعتماد مادة الموقع المعالجة بيوفّر وقت وفلوس ومخاطر.
The board's main concern is long-term performance.
قلق المجلس الأساسي هو الأداء على المدى الطويل.
That's the right concern. Our trial sections have met the specification consistently for six weeks.
ده القلق الصح. قطاعات التجربة بتاعتنا حققت المواصفات بثبات لمدة ست أسابيع.
بس ست أسابيع مش مدى طويل.
Agreed, which is why we're proposing settlement monitoring for twelve months, at our cost.
متفق، وعشان كده بنقترح مراقبة الهبوط لمدة اتناشر شهر، على حسابنا.
We're confident in the material, and we'd rather share the risk than ask you to take it alone.
إحنا واثقين في المادة، وبنفضّل نشارك المخاطرة بدل ما نطلب منكم تتحملوها لوحدكم.
What happens if the monitoring shows a problem?
Then we'd carry out the remedial work under the defects provisions, like any other defect.
ساعتها هننفذ الإصلاح تحت بنود العيوب، زي أي عيب تاني.
And the benefit to the employer, in plain terms?
Fewer trucks on public roads, roughly three weeks saved, and a share of the cost savings.
عربيات أقل على الطرق العامة، وحوالي تلات أسابيع توفير، ونصيب من التوفير في التكلفة.
That's a compelling case. We'll vote on it on Sunday.
دي حجة مقنعة. هنصوّت عليها يوم الأحد.
read: I will keep this short: it saves time, money and risk.
Our trial sections have met the specification consistently.
We are proposing settlement monitoring for twelve months.
We would rather share the risk than ask you to take it alone.
Fewer trucks, three weeks saved, and a share of the savings.

tasks.q: Make a short, persuasive case to decision makers.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض حجة قصيرة ومقنعة لصناع القرار.
tasks.model: I'll keep this short: approving treated site material saves time, money and risk. Our trial sections have met the specification consistently, and the benefits are fewer trucks on public roads and about three weeks saved.

tasks.q: Answer the main objection by sharing the risk.
tasks.q_ar: رد على الاعتراض الأساسي بمشاركة المخاطرة.
tasks.model: That's the right concern. We're proposing twelve months of settlement monitoring at our cost, and any problem would be repaired under the defects provisions. We'd rather share the risk than ask you to take it alone.

lessons.title: A tough negotiation on standby costs
lessons.scene: تفاوض سريع ومباشر على مطالبة تكاليف معدات واقفة بسبب تأخير التسليم.
dialogue: Let's not beat around the bush. Your standby claim is too high and we won't pay it as submitted.
خلينا مانلفّش ونلّف. مطالبة الانتظار بتاعتكم عالية أوي ومش هندفعها زي ما هي.
I appreciate the honesty. Which part are you rejecting: the days, the rates, or the equipment list?
أقدّر الصراحة. إنتي رافضة أنهي جزء: الأيام، ولا الأسعار، ولا قايمة المعدات؟
The rates. You've used full hire rates for idle equipment.
الأسعار. إنتو استخدمتوا أسعار الإيجار الكاملة لمعدات واقفة.
That's a fair challenge. Idle machines don't burn fuel or wear out the same way.
ده اعتراض منطقي. المكن الواقف مابيصرفش وقود ومابيستهلكش بنفس الطريقة.
So you accept a reduced rate?
In principle, yes. But the operators were still on site and still paid, so their cost stays in full.
من حيث المبدأ أيوه. بس السواقين كانوا لسه في الموقع وبياخدوا مرتباتهم، فتكلفتهم تفضل كاملة.
That's reasonable. What reduction are you suggesting for the machines?
ده معقول. تقترح تخفيض قد إيه للمعدات؟
We'd remove fuel, maintenance and wear, and keep ownership and finance costs.
هنشيل الوقود والصيانة والاستهلاك، ونخلي تكاليف الملكية والتمويل.
The days aren't negotiable. They're recorded in the daily reports your inspector signed.
الأيام مش قابلة للتفاوض. متسجلة في التقارير اليومية اللي المفتش بتاعكم وقّعها.
Fine. Send me a revised calculation on that basis and we'll close it.
ماشي. ابعتلي حساب معدّل على الأساس ده وهنقفلها.
You'll have it tomorrow. I think that's a fair outcome for both sides.
هيوصلك بكرة. أعتقد دي نتيجة عادلة للطرفين.
phrases: Let's not beat around the bush
read: Which part are you rejecting, the days, the rates or the list?
Idle machines do not burn fuel or wear out the same way.
The operators were still on site, so their cost stays in full.
The days are not negotiable, they are in the signed reports.
I think that is a fair outcome for both sides.

tasks.q: In a tough negotiation, find out exactly what is disputed.
tasks.q_ar: في تفاوض صعب، اعرف بالظبط إيه المختلف عليه.
tasks.model: I appreciate the honesty. Which part are you rejecting: the days, the rates, or the equipment list? If it's the rates, that's a fair challenge, because idle machines don't burn fuel.

tasks.q: Give ground on one point while holding firm on another.
tasks.q_ar: تنازل في نقطة واثبت في نقطة تانية.
tasks.model: In principle, we accept a reduced rate for the machines, without fuel and wear, but the operators were still paid, so their cost stays in full. The days aren't negotiable, because your inspector signed the daily reports.

lessons.title: Explaining the claim to the director
lessons.scene: المدير العام عنده دقيقتين في الأسانسير، وعايز يفهم مطالبة الصخر بسرعة.
dialogue: Hassan, give me the rock claim in two minutes. Where are we?
حسن، اديني مطالبة الصخر في دقيقتين. إحنا فين؟
In a nutshell: we found continuous rock that the tender data didn't show. We notified on time and we're claiming time and cost.
باختصار: لقينا صخر متصل مكانش ظاهر في بيانات المناقصة. بلّغنا في الميعاد وبنطالب بوقت وتكلفة.
Strong on entitlement. The nearest borehole showed only sand, and the engineer jointly recorded the rock extent.
قوية في الاستحقاق. أقرب جسة كانت رمل بس، والمهندس سجّل امتداد الصخر بالاشتراك معانا.
Quantum. Our first rock-breaking rate was based on a short trial, so they'll push back on the cost.
المبلغ. أول سعر لتكسير الصخر كان مبني على تجربة قصيرة، فهيعترضوا على التكلفة.
What are you doing about it?
We're recording actual production every day, so in a month we'll have solid data instead of a trial.
بنسجل الإنتاج الفعلي كل يوم، فبعد شهر هيبقى عندنا بيانات قوية بدل التجربة.
Low, if we keep the records clean. The relationship with the engineer is good.
قليل، لو حافظنا على السجلات نضيفة. العلاقة مع المهندس كويسة.
Will do. I'll add a one-line status to your monthly dashboard.
حاضر. هضيف سطر حالة في لوحة المتابعة الشهرية بتاعتك.
read: In a nutshell, we found rock that the tender data did not show.
Our case is strong on entitlement.
The weak spot is the quantum.
We are recording actual production every day.
I will add a one-line status to your monthly dashboard.

tasks.q: Summarise a complex claim for a senior manager in a few sentences.
tasks.q_ar: لخّص مطالبة معقدة لمدير كبير في كام جملة.
tasks.model: In a nutshell, we found continuous rock that the tender data didn't show. We notified on time and we're claiming time and cost. Our case is strong on entitlement.

tasks.q: Be honest about the weak point and your plan.
tasks.q_ar: كن صريح في نقطة الضعف وخطتك.
tasks.model: The weak spot is the quantum, because our first rate was based on a short trial. We're recording actual production every day, so in a month we'll have solid data.

lessons.title: When the consultant is wrong
lessons.scene: الاستشاري بيأكد معلومة غلط عن المواصفات قدام فريقه، وإنت لازم تصححه من غير ما تحرجه.
dialogue: The specification requires ninety-eight percent compaction for all fill layers.
المواصفات بتطلب دمك تمانية وتسعين في المية لكل طبقات الردم.
David, could I just check one thing on that?
ديفيد، ممكن أتأكد من حاجة صغيرة في ده؟
My understanding is that ninety-eight applies to the top layer only, and ninety-five to the layers below.
فهمي إن تمانية وتسعين بتنطبق على الطبقة العليا بس، وخمسة وتسعين للطبقات اللي تحتها.
I'm fairly sure it's ninety-eight throughout.
أنا متأكد تقريبًا إنها تمانية وتسعين في الكل.
I might be wrong. Shall we look at the clause together? I have it here.
ممكن أكون غلطان. نبص على البند مع بعض؟ هو معايا هنا.
Let me see. Hmm, you're right. It's ninety-five below the top layer.
وريني. همم، عندك حق. خمسة وتسعين تحت الطبقة العليا.
Easy to mix up. The two tables are on the same page.
سهل تتلخبط. الجدولين في نفس الصفحة.
Thanks for checking. That changes the test results for last week.
شكرًا إنك راجعت. ده بيغيّر نتايج اختبارات الأسبوع اللي فات.
Yes, three layers we reworked would actually have passed.
أيوه، تلات طبقات عِدناها كانت هتنجح أصلًا.
Then please submit the details, and we'll consider the rework cost.
يبقى قدّم التفاصيل لو سمحت، وهننظر في تكلفة إعادة الشغل.
I'll do that today. Thanks for being open about it.
هعمل ده النهاردة. شكرًا إنك كنت متقبل.
phrases: could I just check one thing?
Thanks for being open about it
read: Could I just check one thing on that?
My understanding is that it applies to the top layer only.
I might be wrong, shall we look at the clause together?
It is easy to mix up, the two tables are on the same page.
Three layers we reworked would actually have passed.

tasks.q: Correct a senior person politely without embarrassing them.
tasks.q_ar: صحّح شخص أكبر منك بأدب من غير ما تحرجه.
tasks.model: Could I just check one thing? My understanding is that ninety-eight percent applies to the top layer only. I might be wrong, so shall we look at the clause together?

tasks.q: Turn the correction into a practical outcome.
tasks.q_ar: حوّل التصحيح لنتيجة عملية.
tasks.model: It's easy to mix up, the tables are on the same page. It means three layers we reworked would actually have passed, so I'll submit the details for the rework cost today.

lessons.title: An informal chat that matters
lessons.scene: كلام سريع وعامي مع مدير مقاول مجاور في الكافيتيريا، وفيه معلومة مهمة.
dialogue: Hey Hassan, how's it going? You guys look flat out.
أهلًا حسن، أخبارك؟ باين إنكم شغالين على الآخر.
Yeah, it's pretty hectic. We're trying to make up for lost time.
أيوه، الدنيا زحمة شوية. بنحاول نعوّض الوقت اللي ضاع.
Tell me about it. Between you and me, I heard the employer's changing the road levels again.
ماتقوليش. بيني وبينك، سمعت إن المالك هيغيّر مناسيب الطرق تاني.
Seriously? Where did you hear that?
From their design guys. Nothing official yet, though.
من ناس التصميم عندهم. بس لسه مفيش حاجة رسمية.
Thanks for the heads-up. That could hit our final grading in Zone J.
شكرًا على التنبيه. ده ممكن يضرب التسوية النهائية عندنا في منطقة J.
That's why I mentioned it. No point finishing something twice.
عشان كده قلتلك. مالوش لازمة تخلّص حاجة مرتين.
Exactly. I won't act on a rumour, but I'll ask the engineer whether a revision is coming.
بالظبط. مش هتصرف على إشاعة، بس هسأل المهندس لو فيه تعديل جاي.
Smart. Don't mention my name, though.
Of course not. I'll just ask if the road design is final.
طبعًا لأ. هسأل بس لو تصميم الطرق نهائي.
Cool. Anyway, I've got to run. Catch you later.
تمام. على العموم لازم أمشي. أشوفك بعدين.
See you, Tony. And thanks again.
phrases: I won't act on a rumour
read: It is pretty hectic, we are trying to make up for lost time.
Thanks for the heads-up, that could hit our final grading.
I will not act on a rumour.
I will ask the engineer whether a revision is coming.
I will just ask if the road design is final.

tasks.q: React to informal information professionally.
tasks.q_ar: اتصرف باحتراف مع معلومة غير رسمية.
tasks.model: Thanks for the heads-up. That could hit our final grading. I won't act on a rumour, but I'll ask the engineer whether a revision is coming.

tasks.q: Keep small talk friendly and natural.
tasks.q_ar: خلّي الكلام الخفيف ودود وطبيعي.
tasks.model: Yeah, it's pretty hectic. We're trying to make up for lost time after the late access. How about you, are you guys on track?

lessons.title: Presenting the claim to the engineer
lessons.scene: اجتماع رسمي بتعرض فيه المطالبة التفصيلية للصخر وبترد على أسئلة صعبة.
dialogue: Our detailed claim covers three elements: the event, the effect on time, and the cost.
المطالبة التفصيلية بتغطي تلات عناصر: الحدث، والأثر على الوقت، والتكلفة.
Start with the event. Why was the rock unforeseeable?
ابدأ بالحدث. ليه الصخر ماكانش ممكن توقعه؟
The ground investigation showed sand in every borehole near Zone H, and nothing in the tender documents suggested rock.
فحص التربة كان رمل في كل الجسات جنب منطقة H، ومفيش حاجة في مستندات المناقصة كانت بتلمّح لصخر.
A competent contractor might have done extra investigation.
مقاول كفء كان ممكن يعمل فحص إضافي.
Within the tender period, that wasn't practical, and the contract allocates ground risk based on the data provided.
في مدة المناقصة ماكانش عملي، والعقد بيوزّع مخاطرة الأرض على أساس البيانات المقدمة.
Fair point. And the effect on time?
Rock breaking reduced our output in Zone H by about two-thirds, and Zone H is on the critical path.
تكسير الصخر قلل إنتاجنا في منطقة H بحوالي التلتين، ومنطقة H على المسار الحرج.
Could you have re-sequenced to work elsewhere?
ماكانش ممكن تعيدوا الترتيب وتشتغلوا في حتة تانية؟
We did, for the equipment. But the road works depend on Zone H, so the delay to completion remains.
عملنا كده بالنسبة للمعدات. بس أعمال الطرق معتمدة على منطقة H، فالتأخير على الإنجاز فضل موجود.
Based on actual records: breaker hire, extra fuel and the reduced output, all verified against the daily reports.
مبنية على سجلات فعلية: إيجار الكسارة، والوقود الزيادة، والإنتاج المنخفض، وكله متطابق مع التقارير اليومية.
It's well structured. I'll issue my determination within the contract period.
منظمة كويس. هصدر قراري خلال المدة التعاقدية.
read: Our detailed claim covers the event, the effect on time and the cost.
Nothing in the tender documents suggested rock.
The contract allocates ground risk based on the data provided.
The road works depend on Zone H, so the delay remains.
The cost is based on actual records verified against the daily reports.

tasks.q: Present the structure of a detailed claim.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض هيكل مطالبة تفصيلية.
tasks.model: Our detailed claim covers three elements: the event, the effect on time, and the cost. The ground investigation showed sand in every borehole, and nothing in the tender documents suggested rock.

tasks.q: Answer a challenge about mitigating the delay.
tasks.q_ar: رد على اعتراض بخصوص تخفيف التأخير.
tasks.model: We did re-sequence the equipment to other zones, but the road works depend on Zone H, which is on the critical path, so the delay to completion remains.

lessons.title: Mentoring under pressure
lessons.scene: المساعد متوتر قبل أول اجتماع ليه مع الاستشاري، وإنت بتجهزه نفسيًا وعمليًا.
dialogue: Hassan, I'm nervous about tomorrow's meeting. What if they ask something I don't know?
حسن، أنا متوتر من اجتماع بكرة. لو سألوني حاجة مش عارفها؟
Then you say, "Good question, let me check and come back to you today." That's a professional answer.
ساعتها تقول: "سؤال كويس، خليني أتأكد وأرجعلك النهاردة." دي إجابة احترافية.
Won't that make me look weak?
Not at all. Guessing and being wrong is what makes you look weak.
خالص. التخمين والغلط هو اللي بيبينك ضعيف.
Know your three main numbers by heart, and know where the evidence for each one is.
احفظ أهم تلات أرقام عندك، واعرف دليل كل واحد فين.
What if they disagree with my quantity?
Ask them which part they disagree with. Don't defend the whole thing; focus on the specific point.
اسألهم مختلفين مع أنهي جزء. ماتدافعش عن الموضوع كله؛ ركّز على النقطة المحددة.
Lower your voice, slow down, and go back to the facts. Calm is contagious.
وطّي صوتك، اتكلم أبطأ، وارجع للحقايق. الهدوء بيعدي.
That really helps. Will you be there?
I'll be in the room, but you lead. I'll only step in if you ask me.
هكون في الأوضة، بس إنت اللي هتقود. مش هدخل غير لو طلبت مني.
phrases: let me check and come back to you
read: Good question, let me check and come back to you today.
Guessing and being wrong is what makes you look weak.
Know your three main numbers by heart.
Do not defend the whole thing, focus on the specific point.
Lower your voice, slow down, and go back to the facts.

tasks.q: Coach a nervous colleague before an important meeting.
tasks.q_ar: درّب زميل متوتر قبل اجتماع مهم.
tasks.model: If they ask something you don't know, say, "Good question, let me check and come back to you today." That's a professional answer. Guessing and being wrong is what makes you look weak.

tasks.q: Give advice for handling disagreement in the meeting.
tasks.q_ar: ادي نصيحة للتعامل مع الخلاف في الاجتماع.
tasks.model: Ask them which part they disagree with and focus on that specific point. If it gets heated, lower your voice, slow down and go back to the facts.

lessons.title: Negotiating the final account with the employer
lessons.title_ar: التفاوض على الحساب الختامي مع المالك
lessons.scene: اجتماع الحساب الختامي للمرحلة، والمالك عايز يقفل بأي رقم، وإنت بتحمي حقوقكم.
dialogue: Hassan, I want to close this phase. Can we agree a single figure today?
حسن، عايز أقفل المرحلة دي. نقدر نتفق على رقم واحد النهاردة؟
I'd like that too. But a single figure needs to reflect what's actually owed.
أنا كمان عايز كده. بس الرقم الواحد لازم يعكس المستحق فعلًا.
Our number is about eight percent below yours.
رقمنا أقل من رقمكم بحوالي تمانية في المية.
Could you share how you got there? Then we can see where the gap really is.
ممكن تقولي وصلتوا ليه إزاي؟ عشان نشوف الفجوة فعلًا فين.
Mainly the rock claim and two variations we consider overpriced.
أساسًا مطالبة الصخر وأمرين تغيير شايفين إن سعرهم مبالغ فيه.
On the variations, we can move a little, since some rates were estimated.
في أوامر التغيير، نقدر نتحرك شوية، لأن بعض الأسعار كانت تقديرية.
The engineer has already determined entitlement. Reopening it would only delay us both.
المهندس حدد الاستحقاق خلاص. إعادة فتحه هتأخرنا إحنا الاتنين.
We meet you partway on the variations, the rock stays as determined, and we sign this week.
نقابلكم في نص الطريق في أوامر التغيير، والصخر يفضل زي ما اتحدد، ونوقع الأسبوع ده.
That's closer to something I can take to the board. Let me run the numbers.
ده أقرب لحاجة أقدر أعرضها على المجلس. خليني أحسب الأرقام.
Of course. I'll send our breakdown tonight so your team can check it quickly.
طبعًا. هبعت التفاصيل بتاعتنا بالليل عشان فريقك يراجعها بسرعة.
read: A single figure needs to reflect what is actually owed.
Could you share how you got there?
On the variations, we can move a little.
Reopening it would only delay us both.
We meet you partway, and we sign this week.

tasks.q: Respond to pressure to settle at a lower figure.
tasks.q_ar: رد على ضغط إنك تقفل برقم أقل.
tasks.model: I'd like to close too, but a single figure needs to reflect what's actually owed. Could you share how you got to your number, so we can see where the gap really is?

tasks.q: Propose a deal that trades a concession for a firm position.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح اتفاق فيه تنازل مقابل موقف ثابت.
tasks.model: On the variations we can meet you partway, since some rates were estimated. The rock claim stays as the engineer determined, because reopening it would delay us both. Then we can sign this week.

lessons.title: Fast phone call with a supplier
lessons.scene: مكالمة سريعة وكلام طبيعي سريع: المورد بيقول هيسحب عربيات بكرة لمشروع تاني.
dialogue: Hassan, quick one. I'm gonna need four trucks back tomorrow for another job.
حسن، حاجة سريعة. هحتاج أرجّع أربع عربيات بكرة لشغلانة تانية.
Tomorrow? Yusuf, that's really short notice. We're in the middle of Zone J.
بكرة؟ يا يوسف، ده إشعار قصير أوي. إحنا في نص منطقة J.
I know, I know. The client's been chasing me all week.
عارف عارف. العميل بيطاردني طول الأسبوع.
Our agreement says seven days' notice for any reduction.
اتفاقنا بيقول إشعار سبع أيام لأي تقليل.
Yeah, but I'm kinda stuck here.
Look, I wanna help, but I can't lose four trucks overnight. What if you pull two tomorrow and two next week?
بص، أنا عايز أساعد، بس مقدرش أخسر أربع عربيات في ليلة. إيه رأيك تسحب اتنين بكرة واتنين الأسبوع الجاي؟
Two tomorrow... yeah, I could probably live with that.
اتنين بكرة... أيوه، أقدر أتعايش مع ده غالبًا.
And the two remaining stay until we finish Zone J, no matter what.
والاتنين الباقيين يفضلوا لحد ما نخلّص منطقة J، مهما حصل.
Deal. When do you think you'll finish?
Around the twentieth, if the weather holds.
حوالي يوم عشرين، لو الجو فضل كويس.
OK, I'll send you a message to confirm.
Thanks. Put it in writing, just so we're both covered.
شكرًا. اكتبها، عشان نبقى إحنا الاتنين في الأمان.
hard: GUH-na — جَنَّا (going to في الكلام السريع)
read: That is really short notice, we are in the middle of Zone J.
Our agreement says seven days notice for any reduction.
What if you pull two tomorrow and two next week?
The two remaining stay until we finish, no matter what.
Put it in writing, just so we are both covered.

tasks.q: React to a sudden supplier change and refer to the agreement.
tasks.q_ar: اتصرف مع تغيير مفاجئ من مورد وارجع للاتفاق.
tasks.model: That's really short notice, we're in the middle of Zone J. Our agreement says seven days' notice for any reduction, so I can't lose four trucks overnight.

tasks.q: Find a quick compromise and secure it in writing.
tasks.q_ar: لاقي حل وسط سريع وثبّته كتابة.
tasks.model: What if you pull two tomorrow and two next week, and the remaining two stay until we finish Zone J, no matter what? Please put it in writing, so we're both covered.

lessons.title: Admitting a mistake to the client
lessons.scene: فريقك عمل غلطة أثرت على المالك، وإنت بتعترف وتعرض الحل قبل ما يكتشفها هو.
dialogue: Mr. Grant, before the meeting starts, I want to tell you about a mistake on our side.
مستر جرانت، قبل ما الاجتماع يبدأ، عايز أقولك عن غلطة من ناحيتنا.
I appreciate you coming to me. What happened?
أقدّر إنك جيتلي. إيه اللي حصل؟
Our team placed fill over an area where a utility duct hadn't been inspected yet.
فريقنا ردم فوق منطقة فيها مجرى مرافق ماكانش اتعاين لسه.
That's a problem. Is the duct damaged?
We don't believe so, but we can't prove it without exposing it. So we'll excavate it carefully tomorrow.
مش معتقدين، بس مانقدرش نثبت ده من غير ما نكشفه. فهنحفر عليه بحذر بكرة.
We do, entirely. It was our error, and it won't affect your programme.
إحنا، بالكامل. كانت غلطتنا، ومش هتأثر على برنامجكم.
A night shift handover missed the hold point. We've now added a hold-point board at the site office.
تسليم وردية الليل فوّت نقطة التوقف. ضفنا دلوقتي لوحة بنقط التوقف في مكتب الموقع.
Well, I'd rather hear it from you than from my inspector.
طيب، أفضّل أسمعها منك بدل من المفتش بتاعي.
That's exactly why I came. Your inspector is welcome to attend the excavation.
ده بالظبط سبب إني جيت. المفتش بتاعكم مُرحب بيه يحضر الحفر.
Thank you. That's how trust is built.
phrases: I appreciate you coming to me
read: I want to tell you about a mistake on our side.
We cannot prove it without exposing it.
We cover the cost entirely, it was our error.
A night shift handover missed the hold point.
Your inspector is welcome to attend the excavation.

tasks.q: Admit a mistake to the client before they find it.
tasks.q_ar: اعترف بغلطة للمالك قبل ما يكتشفها.
tasks.model: Before the meeting starts, I want to tell you about a mistake on our side. Our team placed fill over a utility duct that hadn't been inspected yet. We'll expose it carefully tomorrow.

tasks.q: Take responsibility and explain the prevention measure.
tasks.q_ar: اتحمل المسؤولية واشرح إجراء المنع.
tasks.model: We cover the cost entirely, and it won't affect your programme. It happened because a shift handover missed the hold point, so we've added a hold-point board. Your inspector is welcome to attend.

lessons.title: Running a risk workshop
lessons.scene: بتدير ورشة سريعة لتحديد مخاطر المرحلة الجاية وترتيبها.
dialogue: Right, let's get started. In the next forty minutes, we want our top five risks for Phase Two, each with an owner.
طيب، خلينا نبدأ. في الأربعين دقيقة الجاية، عايزين أهم خمس مخاطر للمرحلة التانية، كل واحد ليه مسؤول.
Yes, five minutes, no criticism. Then we rate each one for likelihood and impact.
أيوه، خمس دقايق، من غير انتقاد. وبعدين نقيّم كل واحد من حيث الاحتمال والأثر.
I'll start: late design changes to the road levels.
أبدأ أنا: تغييرات تصميم متأخرة لمناسيب الطرق.
Good one. Others? Summer heat, fill shortage, utility clashes...
حلوة. غيرها؟ حر الصيف، نقص الردم، تعارض المرافق...
And losing key staff. Two engineers are leaving next month.
وخسارة موظفين مهمين. مهندسين ماشيين الشهر الجاي.
That's an important one that people often forget. Let's rate them now.
دي مهمة والناس بتنساها كتير. خلينا نقيّمهم دلوقتي.
Design changes: high likelihood, high impact.
تغييرات التصميم: احتمال عالي وأثر عالي.
Agreed. So that's number one. The mitigation is a design freeze date agreed with the employer.
متفقين. يبقى دي رقم واحد. والتخفيف هو تاريخ تجميد للتصميم نتفق عليه مع المالك.
I'll own that one, since it's contractual. Chris, can you own the staffing risk?
أنا هتحملها، لأنها تعاقدية. كريس، تقدر تمسك مخاطرة الموظفين؟
Sure. I'll draft a handover plan for both engineers.
أكيد. هكتب خطة تسليم للمهندسين الاتنين.
read: We want our top five risks for Phase Two, each with an owner.
Then we rate each one for likelihood and impact.
That is an important one that people often forget.
The mitigation is a design freeze date agreed with the employer.
I will own that one, since it is contractual.

tasks.q: Run the start of a risk workshop with a clear goal and method.
tasks.q_ar: ابدأ ورشة مخاطر بهدف وطريقة واضحين.
tasks.model: Let's get started. In the next forty minutes we want our top five risks for Phase Two, each with an owner. First we brainstorm for five minutes with no criticism, then we rate each risk for likelihood and impact.

tasks.q: Agree a mitigation and assign an owner.
tasks.q_ar: اتفق على إجراء تخفيف وحدد مسؤول.
tasks.model: Late design changes are high likelihood and high impact, so that's number one. The mitigation is a design freeze date agreed with the employer, and I'll own it, since it's contractual.

lessons.title: Defending the team in front of senior management
lessons.title_ar: الدفاع عن الفريق قدام الإدارة العليا
lessons.scene: المدير العام بيلوم فريق الموقع على تأخير، وإنت بتدافع عنهم بالحقايق من غير ما تتهرب من المسؤولية.
dialogue: Frankly, I'm disappointed. The site team should have finished Zone J by now.
بصراحة أنا محبط. فريق الموقع كان المفروض يخلّص منطقة J دلوقتي.
I understand the frustration, and I share it. But I'd like to put the delay in context.
فاهم الإحباط وأنا حاسس بيه. بس حابب أحط التأخير في سياقه.
No excuses. Of the five weeks of delay, three came from the late access and the rock. Both are recorded and notified.
من غير أعذار. من الخمس أسابيع تأخير، تلاتة جم من تأخير التسليم والصخر. الاتنين متسجلين ومتبلّغ عنهم.
Those are ours: rework and a slow start on night shifts. I take responsibility for them.
دول بتوعنا: إعادة شغل وبداية بطيئة للورديات الليلية. وأنا بتحمل مسؤوليتهم.
Rework is down by more than half, and night shift output has doubled in the last month.
إعادة الشغل قلت لأقل من النص، وإنتاج الوردية الليلية اتضاعف في آخر شهر.
I didn't know that. Why wasn't it in the report?
ماكنتش أعرف ده. ليه مكانش في التقرير؟
It was, on page six, but I should have put it on page one. That's my lesson.
كان موجود، في صفحة ستة، بس كان المفروض أحطه في صفحة واحد. ده درسي.
All right. I'll judge the team on the trend, not just the delay.
تمام. هحكم على الفريق من الاتجاه، مش بس من التأخير.
Thank you. They've worked very hard, and they'll keep improving.
شكرًا. اشتغلوا جامد جدًا، وهيفضلوا يتحسنوا.
phrases: I should have put it on page one
كان المفروض أحطه في صفحة واحد
read: I understand the frustration, and I share it.
I would like to put the delay in context.
Those two weeks are ours, and I take responsibility for them.
Rework is down by more than half.
I should have put it on page one.

tasks.q: Defend your team with facts while accepting your share of the blame.
tasks.q_ar: دافع عن فريقك بالحقايق وإنت متحمل نصيبك من اللوم.
tasks.model: I understand the frustration, and I share it. Of the five weeks of delay, three came from the late access and the rock, which are recorded and notified. The other two are ours, and I take responsibility for them.

tasks.q: Show improvement and learn from a communication mistake.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح التحسن واتعلم من غلطة في التواصل.
tasks.model: Since then, rework is down by more than half and night shift output has doubled. It was in the report, but I should have put it on page one. That's my lesson.

lessons.title: Negotiating with idioms
lessons.scene: مقاول الباطن بيستخدم تعبيرات اصطلاحية كتير في التفاوض على سعر مرحلة جديدة، وإنت بترد بنفس الأسلوب.
dialogue: Hassan, let's cut to the chase. For Phase Two, our rates go up by ten percent.
حسن، خلينا ندخل في الموضوع. في المرحلة التانية، أسعارنا هتزيد عشرة في المية.
That's a big jump. What's driving it?
Fuel and wages. Our margins are razor thin.
الوقود والمرتبات. هامش ربحنا رفيع جدًا.
I hear you, but ten percent is a non-starter for us. The client won't budge on our rates.
فاهمك، بس عشرة في المية مرفوضة من الأساس عندنا. المالك مش هيتزحزح في أسعارنا.
So where does that leave us?
Let's look at the bigger picture. Phase Two is twice the volume, with steady work for a year.
خلينا نبص على الصورة الكبيرة. المرحلة التانية ضعف الحجم، بشغل ثابت لمدة سنة.
True. So how about a fuel adjustment clause instead of a flat increase? If fuel goes up, the rate follows.
صح. طب إيه رأيك في بند تعديل للوقود بدل زيادة ثابتة؟ لو الوقود زاد، السعر يزيد معاه.
Then the rate comes down too. It's fair both ways and nobody's gambling.
ساعتها السعر يقل كمان. ده عادل في الاتجاهين ومحدش بيقامر.
Hmm. That could work, plus a small increase for wages.
همم. ده ممكن ينفع، زائد زيادة صغيرة للمرتبات.
I can take that to my manager. Let's not leave money on the table for either side.
أقدر أعرض ده على مديري. خلينا ماحدش يضيّع فلوس من الطرفين.
read: Ten percent is a non-starter for us.
The client will not budge on our rates.
Let's look at the bigger picture.
How about a fuel adjustment clause instead of a flat increase?
It is fair both ways and nobody is gambling.

tasks.q: Reject a large increase firmly but keep the door open.
tasks.q_ar: ارفض زيادة كبيرة بحزم بس خلي الباب مفتوح.
tasks.model: I hear you, but ten percent is a non-starter for us, because the client won't budge on our rates. Let's look at the bigger picture: Phase Two is twice the volume, with steady work for a year.

tasks.q: Propose a creative alternative that is fair both ways.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح بديل مبتكر عادل للطرفين.
tasks.model: How about a fuel adjustment clause instead of a flat increase? If fuel goes up, the rate follows, and if it goes down, the rate comes down too. It's fair both ways.

lessons.title: Explaining a complex technical issue simply
lessons.scene: ممثل المالك مش مهندس، وعايز يفهم ليه الهبوط المتوقع مهم.
dialogue: Hassan, the designers keep mentioning settlement. Can you explain it like I'm not an engineer?
حسن، المصممين بيتكلموا على طول عن الهبوط. ممكن تشرحه كأني مش مهندس؟
Of course. Think of a new mattress. When you first lie on it, it sinks a little, then it stops.
طبعًا. تخيل مرتبة جديدة. أول ما تنام عليها، بتنزل شوية، وبعدين بتقف.
Fill behaves the same way. Under its own weight and the road above, it compresses slightly over time.
الردم بيتصرف بنفس الطريقة. تحت وزنه ووزن الطريق اللي فوقه، بينضغط شوية مع الوقت.
Not if it's small and even. The problem is uneven settlement, where one part sinks more than another.
مش لو كان قليل ومتساوي. المشكلة الهبوط غير المتساوي، لما جزء ينزل أكتر من جزء تاني.
Cracks in the road, or water collecting in low spots. That's what we want to avoid.
شروخ في الطريق، أو مياه بتتجمع في الأماكن الواطية. ده اللي عايزين نتجنبه.
Good compaction in thin layers, consistent material, and monitoring plates that tell us early if anything moves.
دمك كويس في طبقات رفيعة، ومادة متجانسة، وألواح مراقبة بتقولنا بدري لو أي حاجة اتحركت.
That's the clearest explanation I've had. Thank you.
My pleasure. The mattress always helps.
phrases: explain it like I'm not an engineer
That's what we want to avoid
read: Think of a new mattress, it sinks a little, then it stops.
Fill compresses slightly over time under its own weight.
The problem is uneven settlement.
That is what we want to avoid.
Monitoring plates tell us early if anything moves.

tasks.q: Explain a technical concept with a simple comparison.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح مفهوم فني بتشبيه بسيط.
tasks.model: Think of a new mattress. When you first lie on it, it sinks a little, then it stops. Fill behaves the same way: under its own weight and the road above, it compresses slightly over time.

tasks.q: Explain the real risk and how you control it.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الخطر الحقيقي وإزاي بتسيطروا عليه.
tasks.model: The real problem is uneven settlement, which causes cracks or water in low spots. We prevent it with good compaction in thin layers, consistent material, and monitoring plates that warn us early.

lessons.title: A difficult conversation about performance
lessons.scene: مهندس الوردية الليلية أداؤه نازل، وإنت بتفتح معاه حوار صريح ومحترم.
dialogue: Ahmed, thanks for coming. I want to talk about how things have been on the night shift.
أحمد، شكرًا إنك جيت. عايز أتكلم عن الوضع في الوردية الليلية.
I've noticed a few things over the last three weeks: late reports, and two hold points missed.
لاحظت كام حاجة في آخر تلات أسابيع: تقارير متأخرة، ونقطتين توقف اتفوّتوا.
I'm not here to blame you. You've been one of our most reliable engineers, so I wanted to ask: is everything all right?
أنا مش هنا عشان ألومك. إنت كنت من أكتر مهندسينا اللي يُعتمد عليهم، فحبيت أسأل: كل حاجة تمام؟
Honestly, I'm exhausted. I've done nights for four months without a break.
بصراحة، أنا مرهق. شغال ليل بقالي أربع شهور من غير إجازة.
That's too long. I should have noticed that earlier.
دي مدة طويلة أوي. كان المفروض ألاحظ ده بدري.
Telling me isn't complaining. How about rotating with Omar every two weeks, starting next week?
إنك تقولي مش شكوى. إيه رأيك تبدّل مع عمر كل أسبوعين، من الأسبوع الجاي؟
That would make a huge difference.
Good. And let's set up a hold-point checklist, so it doesn't depend on memory when you're tired.
كويس. وخلينا نعمل قايمة نقط توقف، عشان ماتعتمدش على الذاكرة وإنت تعبان.
Thanks, Hassan. I appreciate you asking instead of just writing me up.
شكرًا يا حسن. أقدّر إنك سألت بدل ما تكتب فيا تقرير.
phrases: I'm not here to blame you
read: I want to talk about how things have been on the night shift.
I am not here to blame you.
You have been one of our most reliable engineers.
Telling me is not complaining.
Let's set up a checklist, so it does not depend on memory.

tasks.q: Open a difficult performance conversation with respect.
tasks.q_ar: افتح حوار صعب عن الأداء باحترام.
tasks.model: I want to talk about how things have been on the night shift. I've noticed late reports and two missed hold points. I'm not here to blame you; you've been one of our most reliable engineers, so is everything all right?

tasks.q: Respond with support and a practical solution.
tasks.q_ar: رد بدعم وحل عملي.
tasks.model: Four months of nights is too long, and I should have noticed earlier. Telling me isn't complaining. Let's rotate with Omar every two weeks and use a hold-point checklist.

lessons.title: Pitching yourself for promotion
lessons.scene: فيه وظيفة رئيس قسم كميات اتفتحت، وإنت بتطلب من مديرك يدعم ترشيحك.
dialogue: Khaled, I'd like to put myself forward for the Head of QS role on Phase Two.
خالد، حابب أرشّح نفسي لوظيفة رئيس قسم الكميات في المرحلة التانية.
I thought you might. Why do you think you're ready?
توقعت إنك هتعمل كده. ليه شايف إنك جاهز؟
Over the last year, I've been doing much of the role already: leading the monthly applications and the claims.
في آخر سنة، كنت بعمل جزء كبير من الدور ده فعلًا: بقود المستخلصات الشهرية والمطالبات.
That's true. What results can you point to?
صح. تقدر تشاور على نتايج إيه؟
Our rock claim entitlement was accepted, our certified value tracks closely with our applications, and the auditors found no major issues.
استحقاق مطالبة الصخر اتقبل، والقيمة المعتمدة قريبة جدًا من مستخلصاتنا، والمدققين مالقوش مشاكل كبيرة.
And managing people? That's the big step.
I've been mentoring Karim, and he now prepares the applications with minimal review.
بوجّه كريم، ودلوقتي بيجهز المستخلصات بأقل مراجعة.
What would you do differently in the role?
هتعمل إيه مختلف في الدور ده؟
Standardise our registers across all zones, and bring survey and QS data into one system.
أوحّد السجلات في كل المناطق، وأجمع بيانات المساحة والكميات في نظام واحد.
That's a clear vision. I'll support your application.
Thank you. I won't let you down.
Write a short note on your plan for the first ninety days. It'll strengthen your case.
اكتب ملاحظة قصيرة عن خطتك لأول تسعين يوم. هتقوّي موقفك.
phrases: I've been doing much of the role already
كنت بعمل جزء كبير من الدور فعلًا
What results can you point to?
read: I would like to put myself forward for the Head of QS role.
I have been doing much of the role already.
Our certified value tracks closely with our applications.
I have been mentoring a junior colleague.
I would standardise our registers across all zones.

tasks.q: Ask your manager to support you for a promotion.
tasks.q_ar: اطلب من مديرك يدعمك في ترقية.
tasks.model: I'd like to put myself forward for the Head of QS role. Over the last year, I've been doing much of the role already, leading the monthly applications and the claims.

tasks.q: Show results and a vision for the role.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض نتايج ورؤية للدور.
tasks.model: Our rock claim was accepted, our certified value tracks closely with our applications, and I've been mentoring Karim. In the role, I'd standardise our registers and bring survey and QS data into one system.

lessons.title: An emergency on site
lessons.scene: جزء من جانب حفر عميق انهار، وإنت بتدير الموقف بسرعة وهدوء على الراديو.
dialogue: Hassan, there's been a slope collapse in the deep cut in Zone K!
حسن، فيه انهيار في جانب القطع العميق في منطقة K!
Is anyone hurt? Is anyone missing?
Nobody hurt. Everyone's accounted for, but an excavator is half buried.
محدش اتصاب. الكل موجود، بس فيه حفار مدفون نصه.
Good. First, clear everyone at least thirty metres back from the edge. Nobody goes near that machine.
كويس. الأول، بعّد الكل تلاتين متر على الأقل من الحافة. محدش يقرب من المعدة دي.
Done. The operator wants to try and drive it out.
Absolutely not. The slope could fail again. The machine can wait; people can't be replaced.
خالص لأ. الجانب ممكن ينهار تاني. المعدة تستنى؛ الناس ماتتعوضش.
Stop all work within a hundred metres, and put a banksman at each access to keep vehicles out.
وقّف كل الشغل في حدود مية متر، وحط مُرشد عند كل مدخل يمنع العربيات.
I'll call the project manager and the consultant now. You start the incident log, with times and photos from a safe distance.
أنا هكلم مدير المشروع والاستشاري دلوقتي. إنت ابدأ سجل الحادثة، بالمواعيد والصور من مسافة آمنة.
And nobody touches anything until the geotechnical engineer has inspected it.
ومحدش يلمس حاجة لحد ما المهندس الجيوتقني يعاين.
read: Is anyone hurt, is anyone missing?
Clear everyone at least thirty metres back from the edge.
The machine can wait, people cannot be replaced.
Stop all work within a hundred metres.
Nobody touches anything until the engineer has inspected it.

tasks.q: Give clear first instructions in a site emergency.
tasks.q_ar: ادي تعليمات أولى واضحة في طوارئ بالموقع.
tasks.model: Is anyone hurt? Is anyone missing? Clear everyone at least thirty metres back from the edge, and nobody goes near the machine. Stop all work within a hundred metres.

tasks.q: Refuse an unsafe idea firmly and explain why.
tasks.q_ar: ارفض فكرة مش آمنة بحزم ووضح ليه.
tasks.model: Absolutely not. The slope could fail again. The machine can wait; people can't be replaced. Nobody touches anything until the geotechnical engineer has inspected it.

lessons.title: Reporting an incident upward
lessons.scene: بعد انهيار الجانب، المدير العام بيكلمك عايز ملخص دقيق ومختصر.
dialogue: Hassan, I've heard about the collapse. Give me the facts.
حسن، سمعت عن الانهيار. اديني الحقايق.
At ten fifteen, part of the side slope in Zone K failed over about fifteen metres. Nobody was injured.
الساعة عشرة وربع، جزء من الميل الجانبي في منطقة K انهار على طول حوالي خمستاشر متر. محدش اتصاب.
One excavator is partly buried. We haven't recovered it yet, deliberately, until the slope is assessed.
حفار مدفون جزئيًا. مااستعدناهوش لسه، عن قصد، لحد ما الميل يتقيّم.
It's too early to say for certain. Early signs point to groundwater after last night's rain.
لسه بدري نقول بشكل أكيد. العلامات الأولية بتشاور على مياه جوفية بعد مطر امبارح.
Was the slope built to the design?
According to the last survey, yes. We'll verify that as part of the investigation.
حسب آخر رفع، أيوه. هنتحقق من ده كجزء من التحقيق.
What's the impact on the programme?
Zone K is stopped for at least three days. We've moved the crews to Zone J, so overall production continues.
منطقة K واقفة تلات أيام على الأقل. نقلنا الفرق لمنطقة J، فالإنتاج العام مستمر.
Send me a written summary by end of day.
ابعتلي ملخص مكتوب قبل آخر اليوم.
You'll have it by five, with photos, the timeline and the actions taken.
هيوصلك قبل خمسة، بالصور والجدول الزمني والإجراءات اللي اتعملت.
phrases: It's too early to say for certain
read: Part of the side slope failed over about fifteen metres.
We have not recovered it yet, deliberately.
It is too early to say for certain.
Early signs point to groundwater after the rain.
You will have it by five, with photos and the timeline.

tasks.q: Report an incident upward with only confirmed facts.
tasks.q_ar: ارفع تقرير حادثة للإدارة بالحقايق المؤكدة بس.
tasks.model: At ten fifteen, part of the side slope in Zone K failed over about fifteen metres. Nobody was injured. One excavator is partly buried, and we haven't recovered it yet, deliberately.

tasks.q: Separate early signs from conclusions about the cause.
tasks.q_ar: افصل العلامات الأولية عن الاستنتاجات بخصوص السبب.
tasks.model: It's too early to say for certain. Early signs point to groundwater after last night's rain, and we'll verify the slope geometry as part of the investigation.

lessons.title: Chairing a heated meeting
lessons.scene: إنت بتدير اجتماع بين مقاولين بيلوموا بعض على تلف طريق مشترك، والجو سخن.
dialogue: Your trucks destroyed that road! We're not paying a single riyal to fix it!
عربياتكم بوّظت الطريق ده! إحنا مش هندفع ريال واحد لتصليحه!
Tony, I hear you. Let's take a breath and look at what we actually know.
توني، سامعك. خلينا ناخد نفس ونبص على اللي نعرفه فعلًا.
I know what I've seen. Your trucks are on it all day.
أنا عارف اللي شفته. عربياتكم عليه طول اليوم.
That's true, our trucks use it more. But yours use it too, and the road was never designed for this traffic.
ده صحيح، عربياتنا بتستخدمه أكتر. بس عربياتكم كمان بتستخدمه، والطريق عمره ماكان مصمم للحركة دي.
So you want us to share the cost?
I want a fair way to split it, not an argument. What if we split it by usage?
أنا عايز طريقة عادلة للتقسيم، مش خناقة. إيه رأيك نقسمها حسب الاستخدام؟
And how do we measure usage?
Both of us have gate records. We count the loaded trips on that road for the last two months.
الاتنين عندنا سجلات بوابة. نعدّ النقلات المحمّلة على الطريق ده لآخر شهرين.
If it's based on numbers, I can live with that.
لو مبنية على أرقام، أقدر أتعايش مع ده.
Good. I'll propose it in writing, and we'll ask the employer to confirm it.
كويس. هقترحها كتابة، وهنطلب من المالك يأكدها.
Fine. Sorry for raising my voice earlier.
ماشي. آسف إني علّيت صوتي من شوية.
No problem. We all want the road fixed. That's the common ground.
مفيش مشكلة. كلنا عايزين الطريق يتصلح. ده اللي متفقين عليه.
phrases: a fair way to split it
read: Let's take a breath and look at what we actually know.
The road was never designed for this traffic.
I want a fair way to split it, not an argument.
We count the loaded trips on that road for two months.
We all want the road fixed, that is the common ground.

tasks.q: Calm a heated meeting and move it to facts.
tasks.q_ar: هدّي اجتماع سخن وانقله للحقايق.
tasks.model: I hear you. Let's take a breath and look at what we actually know. Our trucks use the road more, yes, but yours use it too, and it was never designed for this traffic.

tasks.q: Propose an objective method to share a cost.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح طريقة موضوعية لتقسيم تكلفة.
tasks.model: I want a fair way to split it, not an argument. What if we split it by usage, based on the loaded trips in both gate records for the last two months?

lessons.title: Speaking at a conference panel
lessons.scene: إنت متحدث في جلسة نقاش في مؤتمر عن التكنولوجيا في قياس الكميات.
dialogue: Our next panelist is Hassan, a quantity surveyor with a background in field surveying. Hassan, how is technology changing your work?
المتحدث اللي جاي حسن، مهندس كميات بخلفية في المساحة الميدانية. حسن، التكنولوجيا بتغير شغلك إزاي؟
Thank you. In one word: speed. What used to take a week of cross sections now takes an afternoon with surface models.
شكرًا. في كلمة واحدة: السرعة. اللي كان بياخد أسبوع قطاعات عرضية، دلوقتي بياخد بعد ضهر واحد بنماذج الأسطح.
Does speed come at the cost of accuracy?
Only if you trust the software blindly. Fast results still need a second method to check them.
بس لو وثقت في البرنامج بشكل أعمى. النتايج السريعة لسه محتاجة طريقة تانية للمراجعة.
What about drones? Everyone's talking about them.
They're excellent for stockpiles and progress tracking, but for final measurement we still rely on joint ground surveys.
ممتازة للكوم ومتابعة التقدم، بس للقياس النهائي لسه بنعتمد على الرفع الأرضي المشترك.
Mainly trust. Payment depends on data both parties have agreed to, and that culture changes slower than technology.
أساسًا الثقة. الدفع بيعتمد على بيانات الطرفين موافقين عليها، والثقافة دي بتتغير أبطأ من التكنولوجيا.
Interesting point. What advice would you give young QSs?
نقطة مثيرة للاهتمام. تنصح مهندسي الكميات الشباب بإيه؟
Learn the tools, but never stop understanding the numbers. If you can't explain a result, you don't own it.
اتعلموا الأدوات، بس ماتبطلوش تفهموا الأرقام. لو مش قادر تشرح نتيجة، يبقى إنت مش متمكن منها.
A great line to end on. Thank you, Hassan.
جملة عظيمة نختم بيها. شكرًا يا حسن.
phrases: that culture changes slower than technology
الثقافة دي بتتغير أبطأ من التكنولوجيا
read: What used to take a week now takes an afternoon.
Fast results still need a second method to check them.
For final measurement we still rely on joint ground surveys.
Payment depends on data both parties have agreed to.
If you cannot explain a result, you do not own it.

tasks.q: Answer a public question about technology and accuracy.
tasks.q_ar: جاوب على سؤال عام عن التكنولوجيا والدقة.
tasks.model: In one word: speed. What used to take a week of cross sections now takes an afternoon. But speed doesn't have to cost accuracy, as long as fast results are checked with a second method.

tasks.q: Give memorable advice to young professionals.
tasks.q_ar: ادي نصيحة لا تُنسى للشباب في المهنة.
tasks.model: Learn the tools, but never stop understanding the numbers. If you can't explain a result, you don't own it, and in our job, every number must be explainable.

lessons.title: Negotiating your salary
lessons.scene: جالك عرض شغل، وبتتفاوض على الباكيدج بثقة وأدب.
dialogue: We're pleased to offer you the position. The package is in the letter.
يسعدنا نعرض عليك الوظيفة. الباكيدج في الخطاب.
Thank you, I'm really excited about the role. Before I accept, could we discuss the package?
شكرًا، أنا متحمس جدًا للدور. قبل ما أقبل، ممكن نناقش الباكيدج؟
Of course. What did you have in mind?
The basic salary is a little below what I see for similar roles in the market, given my survey and GIS skills.
المرتب الأساسي أقل شوية من اللي بشوفه لأدوار مشابهة في السوق، بالنظر لمهاراتي في المساحة ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية.
Our budget for the basic salary is fairly fixed.
I understand. Is there flexibility in other parts, such as the housing allowance or a review after six months?
فاهم. فيه مرونة في أجزاء تانية، زي بدل السكن أو مراجعة بعد ست شهور؟
A six-month review is possible, based on performance.
المراجعة بعد ست شهور ممكنة، على أساس الأداء.
That works for me, if we agree the targets in writing at the start.
ده يناسبني، لو اتفقنا على الأهداف كتابة من الأول.
Professional training. I'm working towards a degree, and support for that would matter to me.
التدريب المهني. أنا شغال على شهادة جامعية، ودعمكم في ده هيفرق معايا.
We have a training budget. I'll check what we can offer.
عندنا ميزانية تدريب. هشوف نقدر نقدم إيه.
Thank you. If we can agree on those two points, I'd be happy to accept.
شكرًا. لو اتفقنا على النقطتين دول، يسعدني أقبل.
phrases: I'm really excited about the role
read: I am really excited about the role.
Before I accept, could we discuss the package?
