Is there flexibility in other parts of the package?
That works for me, if we agree the targets in writing.
If we can agree on those two points, I would be happy to accept.

tasks.q: Open a salary negotiation positively and give a reason.
tasks.q_ar: افتح تفاوض على المرتب بإيجابية ومع سبب.
tasks.model: Thank you, I'm really excited about the role. Before I accept, could we discuss the package? The basic salary is a little below the market for similar roles, given my survey and GIS skills.

tasks.q: Find flexibility when the main number is fixed.
tasks.q_ar: دوّر على مرونة لما الرقم الأساسي ثابت.
tasks.model: I understand the basic salary is fixed. Is there flexibility in other parts, such as a review after six months with agreed targets, or support for my professional training?

lessons.title: Persuading the team to change a habit
lessons.scene: بتقنع المراقب والفريق يستخدموا تطبيق التقارير الرقمي بدل الورق، وهو مقاوم للتغيير.
dialogue: Ravi, from next month I'd like the daily reports done on the tablet app instead of paper.
رافي، من الشهر الجاي حابب التقارير اليومية تتعمل على تطبيق التابلت بدل الورق.
Paper has worked fine for twenty years. Why change now?
الورق ماشي كويس من عشرين سنة. ليه نغير دلوقتي؟
Fair question. Paper works, but we lose time copying it, and some sheets go missing.
سؤال منطقي. الورق شغال، بس بنضيّع وقت في نقله، وبعض الشيتات بتضيع.
My guys aren't great with technology.
That's exactly why I picked a simple app. It's mostly tapping, with photos. No long typing.
عشان كده بالظبط اخترت تطبيق بسيط. أغلبه ضغط، وصور. مفيش كتابة كتير.
What's in it for us, though?
No more evening paperwork. Your report is done when you finish the shift, and nobody chases you for it.
مفيش أوراق بالليل تاني. تقريرك يخلص أول ما الوردية تخلص، ومحدش يطاردك عليه.
How about a two-week trial with your crew only? If it doesn't work, we'll fix it or drop it.
إيه رأيك في تجربة أسبوعين مع فريقك بس؟ لو ماشتغلتش، نصلحها أو نلغيها.
Two weeks, and you'll train us properly.
Deal. I'll do the training myself on Saturday morning.
اتفقنا. أنا هدرّبكم بنفسي السبت الصبح.
OK, we'll give it a go.
phrases: we'll fix it or drop it
read: Paper works, but we lose time copying it.
That is exactly why I picked a simple app.
No more evening paperwork for your team.
How about a two-week trial with your crew only?
If it does not work, we will fix it or drop it.

tasks.q: Answer resistance to change by showing the benefit to them.
tasks.q_ar: رد على مقاومة التغيير بإنك توضح فايدتهم.
tasks.model: Fair question. Paper works, but we lose time copying it and some sheets go missing. And for you, there's no more evening paperwork: your report is done when you finish the shift.

tasks.q: Lower the risk of change with a trial.
tasks.q_ar: قلل مخاطرة التغيير بتجربة.
tasks.model: How about a two-week trial with your crew only? I'll train you myself on Saturday, and if it doesn't work, we'll fix it or drop it.

lessons.title: A misunderstanding across cultures
lessons.scene: المصمم الأمريكي فهم كلامك على إنه موافقة، وإنت كنت بتجامل، فبتوضح بلطف.
dialogue: Great, so we're all set. You said yes to the new drainage levels yesterday.
عظيم، يبقى كله تمام. إنت قلت أيوه على مناسيب التصريف الجديدة امبارح.
Brian, I think we may have had a small misunderstanding there.
برايان، أعتقد إن ممكن يكون حصل سوء فهم صغير.
Oh? You said it looked good.
أوه؟ إنت قلت إنها شكلها كويس.
I did, and I meant the design looked sensible. But I didn't mean we agree to build it without an instruction.
قلت كده، وكان قصدي إن التصميم منطقي. بس ماكانش قصدي إننا موافقين ننفذه من غير تعليمات.
Ah, I see. In the States, "looks good" usually means go ahead.
آه، فهمت. في أمريكا، "شكلها كويس" عادةً معناها اتفضل نفذ.
That's useful to know. Here, people sometimes say positive things to be polite, then raise concerns formally.
معلومة مفيدة. هنا، الناس أحيانًا بتقول كلام إيجابي من باب الذوق، وبعدين بتطرح ملاحظاتها رسمي.
So what do you actually need?
Just a formal revision through the engineer, because it changes our quantities.
بس تعديل رسمي عن طريق المهندس، لأنه بيغيّر كمياتنا.
Makes sense. I'll push it through today.
Thanks. And next time I'll be clearer: "technically fine, but we need an instruction."
شكرًا. والمرة الجاية هكون أوضح: "فنيًا كويس، بس محتاجين تعليمات."
And I'll remember that "looks good" means go!
وأنا هفتكر إن "شكلها كويس" معناها اتفضل!
phrases: we may have had a small misunderstanding
ممكن يكون حصل سوء فهم صغير
I meant ... But I didn't mean ...
read: I think we may have had a small misunderstanding.
I meant the design looked sensible.
I did not mean we agree to build it without an instruction.
That is useful to know.
Next time I will say technically fine, but we need an instruction.

tasks.q: Clear up a misunderstanding caused by polite language.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح سوء فهم سببه كلام مجاملة.
tasks.model: I think we may have had a small misunderstanding. When I said it looked good, I meant the design looked sensible, not that we agree to build it without an instruction.

tasks.q: Agree a clearer way to communicate in future.
tasks.q_ar: اتفق على طريقة تواصل أوضح بعد كده.
tasks.model: That's useful to know. Next time I'll be clearer and say "technically fine, but we need an instruction," so there's no confusion.

lessons.title: Handing over the project
lessons.scene: آخر المرحلة، بتسلّم المناطق رسميًا للمالك وبتراجع اللي لسه مفتوح.
dialogue: Hassan, are we ready to take over Zones A to E?
حسن، جاهزين نستلم المناطق من A لـ E؟
Yes, with one exception. Zone C still has a short list of minor items, which won't affect your use of the area.
أيوه، باستثناء واحد. منطقة C لسه فيها قايمة قصيرة لبنود بسيطة، مش هتأثر على استخدامكم للمنطقة.
Some edge trimming and two drainage outlets to clean. We'll complete them within fourteen days.
شوية تشذيب أطراف وتنضيف مخرجين تصريف. هنخلصهم خلال أربعتاشر يوم.
The handover file includes the as-built surveys, test records, and the settlement monitoring baseline.
ملف التسليم فيه رفوعات الحالة النهائية، وسجلات الاختبارات، وقراءات البداية لمراقبة الهبوط.
Very thorough. Who do we contact during the defects period?
شامل جدًا. نتواصل مع مين في فترة الضمان؟
Me, as the single point of contact. Any defect report goes to one email address, and we respond within two working days.
أنا، كنقطة تواصل واحدة. أي بلاغ عن عيب يروح لإيميل واحد، وبنرد خلال يومين عمل.
We'd also like to agree a date for the final joint inspection, so the minor items are formally closed.
حابين كمان نتفق على ميعاد للمعاينة المشتركة النهائية، عشان البنود البسيطة تتقفل رسمي.
Let's put it in the diary for three weeks' time.
خلينا نحطها في الأجندة بعد تلات أسابيع.
Perfect. Thank you for your support throughout the project.
ممتاز. شكرًا على دعمكم طول المشروع.
read: Yes, we are ready, with one exception.
We will complete the minor items within fourteen days.
The handover file includes the as-built surveys and test records.
I will be the single point of contact during the defects period.
Thank you for your support throughout the project.

tasks.q: Confirm a handover while being transparent about open items.
tasks.q_ar: أكد التسليم وكن شفاف في البنود المفتوحة.
tasks.model: Yes, we're ready, with one exception. Zone C still has a short list of minor items, like edge trimming and two drainage outlets, which won't affect your use. We'll complete them within fourteen days.

tasks.q: Explain the handover file and the defects-period support.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح ملف التسليم ودعم فترة الضمان.
tasks.model: The handover file includes the as-built surveys, the test records and the settlement monitoring baseline. During the defects period, I'm the single point of contact, and we respond within two working days.

lessons.title: Arguing for a fair extension
lessons.scene: المهندس أعطاكم تمديد أقل من المطلوب، وإنت بتطلب إعادة النظر بحجة قوية.
dialogue: We've granted twenty days for the rock, not the thirty-five you claimed.
منحناكم عشرين يوم للصخر، مش التلاتة وتلاتين اللي طالبتوا بيهم.
Thank you for the determination. We'd like to understand how you reached twenty.
شكرًا على القرار. حابين نفهم وصلتوا لعشرين إزاي.
We assumed you could have used two breakers instead of one.
افترضنا إنكم كان ممكن تستخدموا كسارتين بدل واحدة.
I see the logic. But at that time, only one breaker was available in the region, and we have the hire companies' letters confirming it.
فاهم المنطق. بس في الوقت ده، كان فيه كسارة واحدة بس متاحة في المنطقة، ومعانا خطابات شركات الإيجار اللي بتأكد ده.
Were those letters in your submission?
They were in appendix seven, but I accept they were easy to miss. I'll highlight them.
كانت في الملحق سبعة، بس أنا معترف إنها كانت سهلة تتفوّت. هبرزها.
If only one was available, the assumption changes.
لو واحدة بس كانت متاحة، الافتراض بيتغير.
Exactly. And once a second breaker became available, we mobilised it within two days. Our records show that.
بالظبط. وأول ما كسارة تانية بقت متاحة، جبناها خلال يومين. سجلاتنا بتوضح ده.
So you're saying the delay before that was unavoidable.
يعني إنت بتقول إن التأخير قبل كده ماكانش ممكن تجنبه.
Yes. We're not asking for more than the facts support. Thirty-five is what the records show.
أيوه. إحنا مش بنطلب أكتر من اللي الحقايق بتدعمه. تلاتة وتلاتين هو اللي السجلات بتقوله.
Send me a short note with the letters and the mobilisation dates. I'll reconsider.
ابعتلي ملاحظة قصيرة بالخطابات وتواريخ الحشد. هعيد النظر.
Thank you. You'll have it tomorrow.
read: We would like to understand how you reached twenty days.
Only one breaker was available in the region at that time.
I accept they were easy to miss, so I will highlight them.
Once a second breaker was available, we mobilised it within two days.
We are not asking for more than the facts support.

tasks.q: Challenge a determination respectfully by asking for its basis.
tasks.q_ar: اعترض على قرار باحترام بإنك تسأل عن أساسه.
tasks.model: Thank you for the determination. We'd like to understand how you reached twenty days. I see the logic of two breakers, but at that time only one was available in the region, and we have letters confirming it.

tasks.q: Show the delay was unavoidable and keep the claim credible.
tasks.q_ar: وضّح إن التأخير ماكانش ممكن تجنبه وخلي المطالبة موثوقة.
tasks.model: Once a second breaker became available, we mobilised it within two days, as our records show. We're not asking for more than the facts support: thirty-five days is what the records show.

lessons.title: Introducing yourself at a networking event
lessons.scene: في فعالية مهنية في الرياض، بتتعرف على مديرة مشاريع وبتعمل علاقة مهنية.
dialogue: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Sarah, I run projects for a developer here in Riyadh.
أهلًا، ماأعتقدش إننا اتقابلنا. أنا سارة، بدير مشاريع لشركة تطوير هنا في الرياض.
Nice to meet you, Sarah. I'm Hassan, a quantity surveyor on a large earthworks package.
اتشرفت يا سارة. أنا حسن، مهندس كميات في حزمة حفريات كبيرة.
Earthworks! That's where budgets usually go wrong.
حفريات! دي المنطقة اللي الميزانيات بتبوظ فيها عادةً.
You're not wrong. Usually because the original ground isn't surveyed properly before work starts.
عندك حق. غالبًا لأن الأرض الطبيعية ماتترفعش صح قبل ما الشغل يبدأ.
Partly. I'm also a trained surveyor, so I check the data behind the quantities, not just the totals.
جزئيًا. أنا كمان مساح متدرب، فبراجع البيانات اللي ورا الكميات، مش بس الإجماليات.
That's an unusual combination. Very useful at the cost-planning stage.
دي توليفة نادرة. مفيدة جدًا في مرحلة تخطيط التكلفة.
That's exactly where I'd like to grow: getting involved earlier, before the design is fixed.
ده بالظبط المكان اللي عايز أتطور فيه: إني أشارك بدري، قبل ما التصميم يتثبت.
We might have something in the new year. Do you have a card?
ممكن يكون عندنا حاجة السنة الجديدة. معاك كارت؟
Here you go. Could I connect with you on LinkedIn as well?
اتفضلي. ممكن أضيفك على لينكدإن كمان؟
Sure. Send me a short note so I remember where we met.
أكيد. ابعتلي رسالة قصيرة عشان أفتكر اتقابلنا فين.
I will. It was a pleasure talking to you.
حاضر. كان من دواعي سروري الكلام معاكي.
phrases: It was a pleasure talking to you
كان من دواعي سروري الكلام معاك
read: Nice to meet you, I am a quantity surveyor on a large earthworks package.
I check the data behind the quantities, not just the totals.
That is exactly where I would like to grow.
Could I connect with you on LinkedIn as well?
It was a pleasure talking to you.

tasks.q: Introduce yourself memorably in one or two sentences.
tasks.q_ar: عرّف بنفسك بطريقة تتفتكر في جملة أو اتنين.
tasks.model: I'm Hassan, a quantity surveyor on a large earthworks package. I'm also a trained surveyor, so I check the data behind the quantities, not just the totals.

tasks.q: Turn a conversation into a professional connection.
tasks.q_ar: حوّل الكلام لعلاقة مهنية.
tasks.model: I'd like to get involved earlier, at the cost-planning stage. Could I connect with you on LinkedIn? I'll send a short note so you remember where we met.

lessons.title: Giving a site induction to visitors
lessons.scene: مجموعة طلبة هندسة بيزوروا الموقع، وإنت بتعمل لهم تعريف سلامة وشرح سريع.
dialogue: Welcome, everyone. Before we go anywhere, three safety rules, and they're not optional.
أهلًا بالجميع. قبل ما نروح أي حتة، تلات قواعد سلامة، ومش اختيارية.
One: stay with me at all times. Two: never walk behind a reversing machine. Three: if you hear three long horn blasts, walk calmly to the assembly point by the gate.
واحد: خليكم معايا طول الوقت. اتنين: ماتمشوش أبدًا ورا معدة بترجع لورا. تلاتة: لو سمعتوا تلات كلاكسات طويلة، امشوا بهدوء لنقطة التجمع جنب البوابة.
Yes, but stop walking while you do it. Most accidents happen when people look at their phones.
أيوه، بس وقّفوا وإنتو بتصوروا. معظم الحوادث بتحصل والناس باصة في موبايلاتها.
The full earthworks cycle: cutting, hauling, placing fill in layers, compacting, and testing.
دورة الحفريات كاملة: القطع، والنقل، وفرد الردم طبقات، والدمك، والاختبار.
Will they see a density test?
Yes, our technician will run one at eleven and explain what the numbers mean.
أيوه، الفني بتاعنا هيعمل واحد الساعة حداشر ويشرح الأرقام معناها إيه.
Excellent. They've only seen this in textbooks.
ممتاز. هم شافوا ده في الكتب بس.
Then today will be a good change. Any questions before we start?
يبقى النهاردة هيبقى تغيير حلو. فيه أسئلة قبل ما نبدأ؟
No, I think you've covered everything.
لأ، أعتقد إنك غطيت كل حاجة.
phrases: stay with me at all times
walk calmly to the assembly point
read: Before we go anywhere, there are three safety rules.
Never walk behind a reversing machine.
Walk calmly to the assembly point by the gate.
Most accidents happen when people look at their phones.
You will see the full earthworks cycle today.

tasks.q: Give a short safety induction to visitors.
tasks.q_ar: ادي تعريف سلامة قصير للزوار.
tasks.model: Before we go anywhere, three safety rules, and they're not optional. Stay with me at all times, never walk behind a reversing machine, and if you hear three long horn blasts, walk calmly to the assembly point.

tasks.q: Explain what visitors will see on the tour.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الزوار هيشوفوا إيه في الجولة.
tasks.model: Today you'll see the full earthworks cycle: cutting, hauling, placing fill in layers, compacting and testing. At eleven, our technician will run a density test and explain the numbers.

lessons.title: Resolving a dispute without escalation
lessons.scene: خلاف قديم على بند بقاله شهور، وإنت بتقترح حل قبل ما يتحول لنزاع رسمي.
dialogue: David, item twenty-two has been open for five months. I'd like to find a way to close it without escalating.
ديفيد، البند اتنين وعشرين مفتوح بقاله خمس شهور. حابب نلاقي طريقة نقفله من غير تصعيد.
I'd prefer that too. Escalation costs both sides time and goodwill.
أنا كمان أفضّل كده. التصعيد بيكلّف الطرفين وقت وعلاقة طيبة.
Let's start from where we agree. We both accept the work was done and is acceptable.
خلينا نبدأ من اللي متفقين عليه. إحنا الاتنين موافقين إن الشغل اتعمل وإنه مقبول.
Correct. The issue is whether it's a variation or part of the original scope.
مظبوط. المشكلة إنه أمر تغيير ولا جزء من النطاق الأصلي.
Right. Our view is that the specification didn't mention it. Yours is that it's implied.
صح. رأينا إن المواصفات ماذكرتهوش. ورأيكم إنه ضمني.
What if we ask a neutral senior engineer from each organisation to review just that clause?
إيه رأيك نطلب من مهندس كبير محايد من كل جهة يراجع البند ده بس؟
And we both accept their view?
As a recommendation, not a binding decision. If they agree with each other, we'd both find it hard to argue.
كتوصية، مش قرار ملزم. لو اتفقوا مع بعض، هيبقى صعب على أي حد فينا يجادل.
I like that. It keeps it informal and fast.
عاجبني ده. بيخليه غير رسمي وسريع.
Shall we set a deadline? Say three weeks?
Three weeks. I'll nominate someone by Thursday.
تلات أسابيع. هرشّح حد قبل الخميس.
phrases: costs both sides time and goodwill
Let's start from where we agree
خلينا نبدأ من اللي متفقين عليه
read: I would like to find a way to close it without escalating.
Let's start from where we agree.
Our view is that the specification did not mention it.
What if we ask a neutral senior engineer to review that clause?
It would be a recommendation, not a binding decision.

tasks.q: Propose resolving a long dispute informally.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح حل نزاع طويل بشكل غير رسمي.
tasks.model: Item twenty-two has been open for five months, and I'd like to close it without escalating. Let's start from where we agree: the work was done and it's acceptable. The only issue is whether it's a variation.

tasks.q: Suggest a neutral review process.
tasks.q_ar: اقترح طريقة مراجعة محايدة.
tasks.model: What if we each ask a neutral senior engineer to review just that clause? Their view would be a recommendation, not binding, but if they agree, it would be hard to argue. Shall we set three weeks?

lessons.title: A tough interview question
lessons.scene: مقابلة لوظيفة كبيرة، ورئيس اللجنة بيسأل سؤال صعب عن موقف أخلاقي.
dialogue: Tell us about a time you were under pressure to do something you disagreed with.
احكيلنا عن موقف كنت تحت ضغط تعمل حاجة مش موافق عليها.
On a previous project, I was asked to include a quantity in an application before it was surveyed.
في مشروع سابق، اتطلب مني أحط كمية في مستخلص قبل ما تترفع.
I explained that without a survey, the number was a guess, and if the consultant found it, we'd lose credibility on every item.
شرحت إن من غير رفع، الرقم ده تخمين، ولو الاستشاري اكتشفه، هنخسر مصداقيتنا في كل البنود.
Was your manager happy with that?
Not at first. So I offered an alternative: we surveyed it urgently the next morning and included it the same month.
مش في الأول. فعرضت بديل: رفعناها بشكل عاجل تاني يوم الصبح وحطيناها في نفس الشهر.
So you found a way to meet the goal without cutting corners.
يعني لقيت طريقة تحقق الهدف من غير ما تستسهل.
Exactly. The real goal was cash flow, not that particular number.
بالظبط. الهدف الحقيقي كان التدفق النقدي، مش الرقم ده بالذات.
That saying no is easier when you bring a better yes.
إن قول لأ بيبقى أسهل لما تجيب معاه أيوه أحسن.
Thank you. Integrity matters most in a role that handles money.
شكرًا. النزاهة هي الأهم في دور بيتعامل مع فلوس.
phrases: saying no is easier when you bring a better yes
قول لأ أسهل لما تجيب معاه أيوه أحسن
read: I was asked to include a quantity before it was surveyed.
Without a survey, the number was a guess.
I offered an alternative and we surveyed it the next morning.
Saying no is easier when you bring a better yes.
Integrity matters most in a role that handles money.

tasks.q: Answer a "tell us about a time" question with a clear story.
tasks.q_ar: جاوب على سؤال "احكيلنا عن موقف" بقصة واضحة.
tasks.model: On a previous project, I was asked to include a quantity before it was surveyed. I explained that without a survey it was a guess, and we could lose credibility. I offered an alternative: we surveyed it urgently the next morning.

tasks.q: State the lesson and your values in one or two sentences.
tasks.q_ar: قول الدرس وقيمك في جملة أو اتنين.
tasks.model: I learned that saying no is easier when you bring a better yes. Integrity matters most in a role that handles money, so I always look for a way to reach the goal without cutting corners.

lessons.title: Leading a lessons-learned debate
lessons.scene: نقاش مع زميل مختلف معاك في سبب مشكلة، وإنت بتوصل لاستنتاج متوازن.
dialogue: Honestly, I think our biggest problem was the subcontractors. They were simply too slow.
بصراحة، أعتقد إن أكبر مشكلة عندنا كانت مقاولي الباطن. كانوا بطيئين وخلاص.
They were slow at times, but I'm not sure that's the root cause.
كانوا بطيئين أحيانًا، بس مش متأكد إن ده السبب الجذري.
Look at when they were slow: mostly when access was late or the water supply failed.
بص كانوا بطيئين إمتى: أغلبه لما التسليم اتأخر أو المياه وقفت.
Fair point. But even with access, their output was below the plan.
نقطة منطقية. بس حتى مع التسليم، إنتاجهم كان أقل من الخطة.
Agreed. So maybe it's both: our planning assumptions were optimistic, and their resources were thin.
متفقين. يبقى يمكن الاتنين: افتراضات التخطيط عندنا كانت متفائلة، ومواردهم كانت ضعيفة.
We assumed peak productivity every day. Real sites have breakdowns, weather and queues.
افترضنا أعلى إنتاجية كل يوم. المواقع الحقيقية فيها أعطال وجو وطوابير.
So for Phase Two, a realistic productivity factor in the plan?
يبقى في المرحلة التانية، معامل إنتاجية واقعي في الخطة؟
Yes, based on our actual data, plus resource commitments written into the subcontracts.
أيوه، على أساس بياناتنا الفعلية، وزائد التزامات موارد مكتوبة في عقود الباطن.
That's a better conclusion than blaming one side.
ده استنتاج أحسن من لوم طرف واحد.
It usually is. Problems rarely have just one cause.
غالبًا بيبقى كده. المشاكل نادرًا ما يكون ليها سبب واحد.
phrases: I'm not sure that's the root cause
مش متأكد إن ده السبب الجذري
Problems rarely have just one cause
المشاكل نادرًا ما يكون ليها سبب واحد
read: They were slow at times, but I am not sure that is the root cause.
Look at when they were slow.
Maybe it is both, our assumptions were optimistic.
We assumed peak productivity every day.
Problems rarely have just one cause.

tasks.q: Challenge a simple explanation and look for the root cause.
tasks.q_ar: اعترض على تفسير بسيط ودوّر على السبب الجذري.
tasks.model: They were slow at times, but I'm not sure that's the root cause. Look at when they were slow: mostly when access was late or the water supply failed.

tasks.q: Reach a balanced conclusion with actions.
tasks.q_ar: اوصل لاستنتاج متوازن بإجراءات.
tasks.model: Maybe it's both: our planning assumptions were optimistic and their resources were thin. For Phase Two, we'll use a realistic productivity factor and write resource commitments into the subcontracts.

lessons.title: Calling a client with bad news
lessons.scene: مكالمة لازم تقول فيها للمالك إن الإنجاز هيتأخر أسبوعين بسبب مشكلة جديدة.
dialogue: Mr. Grant, I'm calling with some news you won't like, and I wanted you to hear it from me first.
مستر جرانت، بكلمك بخبر مش هيعجبك، وحبيت تسمعه مني الأول.
The settlement plates in Zone F show more movement than expected. The designer has asked us to hold the final layer.
ألواح الهبوط في منطقة F بتوضح حركة أكتر من المتوقع. والمصمم طلب مننا نأجل الطبقة الأخيرة.
At least two weeks, until the readings stabilise. That will push completion of Zone F by about two weeks.
أسبوعين على الأقل، لحد ما القراءات تستقر. ده هيأخر إنجاز منطقة F حوالي أسبوعين.
That's not good timing. The road contractor is waiting.
ده توقيت مش كويس. مقاول الطرق مستني.
I know. We've already talked to them, and they can start in Zone E first, so they won't stand idle.
عارف. اتكلمنا معاهم خلاص، ويقدروا يبدأوا في منطقة E الأول، فمش هيقعدوا من غير شغل.
No. It's within the range the designer allowed for, but it's slower to settle than predicted. Waiting is the safe choice.
لأ. هي في الحدود اللي المصمم حسبها، بس بطيئة في الاستقرار أكتر من المتوقع. الانتظار هو الاختيار الآمن.
All right. Send me the readings and the designer's note.
They'll be in your inbox within the hour, and I'll update you every week until we resume.
هتكون في الإيميل عندك خلال ساعة، وهبلّغك كل أسبوع لحد ما نرجع نشتغل.
Thanks for the early warning, Hassan.
شكرًا على التنبيه المبكر يا حسن.
read: I am calling with some news you will not like.
I wanted you to hear it from me first.
The designer has asked us to hold the final layer.
The road contractor can start in Zone E first, so they will not stand idle.
It is within the allowed range, so waiting is the safe choice.

tasks.q: Deliver bad news to a client directly and early.
tasks.q_ar: بلّغ المالك بخبر سيئ بشكل مباشر وبدري.
tasks.model: I'm calling with some news you won't like, and I wanted you to hear it from me first. The settlement plates show more movement than expected, so we must hold the final layer for at least two weeks.

tasks.q: Reduce the impact and reassure about safety.
tasks.q_ar: قلل الأثر وطمّن بخصوص السلامة.
tasks.model: We've already arranged for the road contractor to start in Zone E first, so they won't stand idle. The movement is within the allowed range; waiting is simply the safe choice.

lessons.title: Mentoring a future QS manager
lessons.scene: كريم بقى مهندس كميات، وبيسألك إزاي يكبر لمستوى مدير.
dialogue: Hassan, what's the difference between a good QS and a QS manager?
حسن، إيه الفرق بين مهندس كميات كويس ومدير كميات؟
A good QS gets the numbers right. A manager makes sure the whole team gets them right, even when he's not there.
مهندس الكميات الكويس بيطلّع الأرقام صح. المدير بيتأكد إن الفريق كله بيطلّعها صح، حتى وهو مش موجود.
Systems and people. Clear registers, clear checks, and people who feel safe to raise mistakes early.
أنظمة وناس. سجلات واضحة، ومراجعات واضحة، وناس حاسة بالأمان إنها تبلّغ عن الأخطاء بدري.
That's the other big shift. You start asking not just "how much," but "what's our position, and what's the risk?"
ده التحول الكبير التاني. بتبدأ تسأل مش بس "قد إيه"، لكن "موقفنا إيه، وإيه المخاطرة؟"
How do I practise that now?
For every variation you price, write one line on our entitlement and one line on the risk. I'll review them with you.
لكل أمر تغيير بتسعّره، اكتب سطر عن استحقاقنا وسطر عن المخاطرة. وأنا هراجعهم معاك.
And communication? I still get nervous in big meetings.
والتواصل؟ لسه بتوتر في الاجتماعات الكبيرة.
Everyone does at first. Prepare three key points, speak slower than feels natural, and stop when you've made them.
الكل كده في الأول. جهّز تلات نقط أساسية، اتكلم أبطأ من الطبيعي اللي إنت حاسه، واسكت لما تقولهم.
Yes. Most people weaken a good point by talking after it. Silence shows confidence.
أيوه. معظم الناس بتضعّف نقطة كويسة بالكلام بعدها. السكوت بيوضح الثقة.
phrases: feel safe to raise mistakes early
حاسين بالأمان يبلّغوا عن الأخطاء بدري
اتكلم أبطأ من الطبيعي اللي إنت حاسه
read: A good QS gets the numbers right.
A manager makes sure the whole team gets them right.
People should feel safe to raise mistakes early.
Prepare three key points and speak slower than feels natural.
Most people weaken a good point by talking after it.

tasks.q: Explain the difference between a good QS and a QS manager.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح الفرق بين مهندس كميات كويس ومدير كميات.
tasks.model: A good QS gets the numbers right. A manager makes sure the whole team gets them right, even when he's not there, through clear registers, clear checks, and people who feel safe to raise mistakes early.

tasks.q: Give practical advice for speaking in big meetings.
tasks.q_ar: ادي نصيحة عملية للكلام في الاجتماعات الكبيرة.
tasks.model: Prepare three key points, speak slower than feels natural, and stop when you've made them. Most people weaken a good point by talking after it; silence shows confidence.

lessons.title: Proposing a digital system to management
lessons.scene: بتعرض على المدير العام فكرة نظام يربط المساحة والكميات، ولازم تقنعه بالعائد.
dialogue: Mr. Hadi, I'd like ten minutes to propose a small investment with a quick return.
أستاذ هادي، حابب عشر دقايق أقترح استثمار صغير بعائد سريع.
Today, survey data and quantities live in separate files. Every month we spend about four days reconciling them.
النهاردة، بيانات المساحة والكميات في ملفات منفصلة. وكل شهر بنصرف حوالي أربع أيام نطابقهم.
Two engineers. And errors still slip through, like the stockpile we claimed twice last year.
مهندسين اتنين. والأخطاء لسه بتعدّي، زي الكومة اللي طالبنا بيها مرتين السنة اللي فاتت.
A shared database that links each survey to the quantities it produces. I've built a pilot with Civil 3D and a simple dashboard.
قاعدة بيانات مشتركة بتربط كل رفع بالكميات اللي بتطلع منه. عملت نموذج تجريبي بسيفيل ثري دي ولوحة متابعة بسيطة.
Mainly my time and some licences. The saved engineering days pay for it within a few months.
أساسًا وقتي وشوية تراخيص. أيام الهندسة اللي بنوفرها بتغطي تكلفته خلال كام شهر.
Low. We'd run it alongside the current method for one project before switching.
قليلة. هنشغله جنب الطريقة الحالية لمشروع واحد قبل ما نحوّل.
Run the pilot on Phase Two. Report back in three months with real numbers.
شغّل التجربة في المرحلة التانية. ورجّعلي بعد تلات شهور بأرقام حقيقية.
phrases: a small investment with a quick return
pay for it within a few months
read: I would like ten minutes to propose a small investment.
Every month we spend about four days reconciling them.
Errors still slip through, like the stockpile claimed twice.
The saved engineering days pay for it within a few months.
We would run it alongside the current method before switching.

tasks.q: Present the problem in terms of time and money.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض المشكلة بلغة الوقت والفلوس.
tasks.model: Today, survey data and quantities live in separate files. Every month two engineers spend about four days reconciling them, and errors still slip through, like the stockpile we claimed twice.

tasks.q: Present the solution, cost and risk briefly.
tasks.q_ar: اعرض الحل والتكلفة والمخاطرة باختصار.
tasks.model: I propose a shared database that links each survey to its quantities. The cost is mainly my time and some licences, and the saved days pay for it within a few months. The risk is low, because we'd run it alongside the current method first.

lessons.title: A fast-paced site meeting
lessons.scene: اجتماع صباحي سريع جدًا وكلام طبيعي متداخل؛ لازم تمسك المعلومات وتاخد قرارات.
dialogue: Morning. Quick one, we've got a lot on. Roller three's down again, so Zone F's gonna be slow.
صباح الخير. بسرعة، عندنا شغل كتير. الهراس تلاتة عطلان تاني، فمنطقة F هتبقى بطيئة.
Down again? That's the third time this month. Get the mechanic's report, and let's swap it with the spare from Zone E.
عطلان تاني؟ دي تالت مرة الشهر ده. هات تقرير الميكانيكي، وخلينا نبدّله بالاحتياطي من منطقة E.
Zone E needs it this afternoon for the top layer.
منطقة E محتاجاه بعد الضهر للطبقة العليا.
Then Zone F gets it this morning, and it goes back to E at one. Can the operator move it in time?
يبقى منطقة F تاخده الصبح، ويرجع لـ E الساعة واحدة. السواق يقدر ينقله في الوقت؟
Yeah, it's only ten minutes. Also, the lab says they're short of a technician today.
أيوه، دي عشر دقايق بس. وكمان المعمل بيقول عندهم نقص فني النهاردة.
Then we prioritise tests for the top layer in E. Everything else can wait till tomorrow morning.
يبقى نعطي أولوية لاختبارات الطبقة العليا في E. أي حاجة تانية تستنى لبكرة الصبح.
Got it. And the consultant wants to walk Zone B at ten.
فهمت. والاستشاري عايز يلف في منطقة B الساعة عشرة.
I'll go myself. Make sure the edges are trimmed before he gets there.
أنا هروح بنفسي. اتأكد إن الأطراف متشذبة قبل ما يوصل.
Will do. Anything else from your side?
حاضر. فيه حاجة تانية من ناحيتك؟
Just one: if roller three fails again, I want it off site. We can't keep losing hours.
حاجة واحدة بس: لو الهراس تلاتة عطل تاني، عايزه برّه الموقع. مانقدرش نفضل نخسر ساعات.
Fair enough. I'll tell the hire company.
read: That is the third time this month, get the mechanic's report.
Zone F gets it this morning, and it goes back to E at one.
We prioritise tests for the top layer in Zone E.
Make sure the edges are trimmed before he gets there.
If it fails again, I want it off site.

tasks.q: Make quick decisions when resources are short.
tasks.q_ar: خد قرارات سريعة لما الموارد قليلة.
tasks.model: Zone F gets the spare roller this morning, and it goes back to Zone E at one. With only one technician, we prioritise tests for the top layer in E; everything else can wait till tomorrow.

tasks.q: Set a clear limit for an unreliable resource.
tasks.q_ar: حط حد واضح لمورد مش موثوق.
tasks.model: Roller three has failed three times this month. If it fails again, I want it off site and replaced, because we can't keep losing hours.

lessons.title: Final review: a full day as QS manager
lessons.title_ar: المراجعة النهائية: يوم كامل كمدير كميات
lessons.scene: المراجعة النهائية للبرنامج: المدير العام بيقيّم يومك كمدير كميات من أوله لآخره.
dialogue: Hassan, you've been in the QS manager role for a month now. Walk me through a typical day.
حسن، بقالك شهر في دور مدير الكميات. احكيلي يوم عادي عندك.
I start at six thirty with a fifteen-minute call with the site QSs: issues, risks, and anything that needs a decision.
ببدأ ستة ونص بمكالمة ربع ساعة مع مهندسي الكميات في المواقع: المشاكل، والمخاطر، وأي حاجة محتاجة قرار.
Because problems are cheapest to fix before the trucks start moving.
لأن المشاكل بتبقى أرخص في الحل قبل ما العربيات تبدأ تتحرك.
Mid-morning, I review one thing in depth: a variation, a claim or a register. I rotate so nothing is ignored for long.
نص الصبح، براجع حاجة واحدة بعمق: أمر تغيير، أو مطالبة، أو سجل. وبلّف بينهم عشان مفيش حاجة تتساب كتير.
Client and consultant meetings. I keep them short and always end with agreed actions and owners.
اجتماعات المالك والاستشاري. بخليها قصيرة وبختمها دايمًا بإجراءات متفق عليها ومسؤولين.
Letting go. I used to check every number myself. Now I check the system, and spot-check the numbers.
إني أسيب. كنت براجع كل رقم بنفسي. دلوقتي براجع النظام، وبعمل مراجعة عشوائية للأرقام.
And your English? You were working hard on it last year.
وإنجليزيتك؟ كنت شغال عليها جامد السنة اللي فاتت.
It changed everything. I used to prepare every sentence; now I can think on my feet in a tough negotiation.
غيّرت كل حاجة. كنت بجهّز كل جملة؛ دلوقتي أقدر أفكر وأرد على طول في تفاوض صعب.
phrases: Walk me through a typical day
so nothing is ignored for long
read: I start at six thirty with a short call with the site QSs.
Problems are cheapest to fix before the trucks start moving.
I review one thing in depth every morning.
Now I check the system and spot-check the numbers.
Now I can think on my feet in a tough negotiation.

tasks.q: Walk someone through your typical working day as a manager.
tasks.q_ar: احكي لحد يوم شغلك العادي كمدير.
tasks.model: I start at six thirty with a short call with the site QSs about issues, risks and decisions, because problems are cheapest to fix before the trucks start moving. Mid-morning I review one thing in depth, and in the afternoon I hold short meetings that end with agreed actions.

tasks.q: Reflect on how you have grown professionally.
tasks.q_ar: اتكلم عن إزاي اتطورت مهنيًا.
tasks.model: The hardest part was letting go. I used to check every number myself; now I check the system and spot-check the numbers. My English also changed everything: now I can think on my feet in a tough negotiation.

tests.title: Level B1 test — A busy morning
dialogue: Good morning, Mark. Is everything ready for today?
صباح الخير يا مارك. كل حاجة جاهزة للنهاردة؟
Almost. Two excavators are working in Zone E, but the third one is in the workshop.
تقريبًا. حفارين شغالين في منطقة E، بس التالت في الورشة.
A problem with the engine. The mechanic says it will be ready tomorrow.
مشكلة في الموتور. الميكانيكي بيقول هيجهز بكرة.
OK. How many trucks do we have today?
Ten trucks. They started at six thirty.
Good. The consultant is coming at eleven to inspect the second layer in Zone C.
كويس. الاستشاري جاي الساعة حداشر يعاين الطبقة التانية في منطقة C.
Yes, all of them passed yesterday afternoon.
أيوه، كلها نجحت امبارح بعد الضهر.
It's late again. I'll call the supplier now.
Please also send the daily report before five.
وابعت التقرير اليومي قبل خمسة كمان لو سمحت.

mcq.q: How many excavators are working today?
Why is the third excavator not working?
When will the excavator be ready?
How many trucks are working?
What time did the trucks start?
What time is the consultant coming?
What will the consultant inspect?
opts: The first layer in Zone C
The second layer in Zone C

mcq.q: When did the density tests pass?
What is the problem with the water truck?
When must the daily report be sent?

opts: We need it on paper or by email

opts: Give a tour of the place

vocab.q: "The trucks need space" means the trucks need:
"I'll keep a record" means I will:

read: The consultant is coming at eleven to inspect the second layer.
All the density tests passed yesterday afternoon.
The water truck is late again, so I will call the supplier.
Please send the daily report before five o'clock.
We need a written instruction before we start the extra work.

tasks.q: Give your manager a short report about today's work, problems and plan.
tasks.q_ar: ادي مديرك تقرير قصير عن شغل النهاردة والمشاكل والخطة.
tasks.model: Today two excavators are working in Zone E, and the third one has an engine problem. We have ten trucks. The tests passed, and the consultant will inspect the layer at eleven.

tasks.q: Call a supplier about a late delivery and ask when it will arrive.
tasks.q_ar: كلّم مورد عن توريد متأخر واسأل هيوصل إمتى.
tasks.model: Hello, this is Hassan from the site. The water truck is late again. The soil is too dry, so we need it today. When will it arrive?

tests.title: Level B1 test — The joint measurement
dialogue: Hello Nadia, thank you for coming to the site.
أهلًا يا نادية، شكرًا إنك جيتي الموقع.
No problem. Which area are we measuring today?
مفيش مشكلة. هنقيس أنهي منطقة النهاردة؟
The cut in Zone D. We finished it on Sunday.
القطع في منطقة D. خلّصناه يوم الأحد.
Yes. Ali's team surveyed it on Monday morning.
أيوه. فريق علي رفعها يوم الاتنين الصبح.
Do you have the original ground survey too?
Yes, it's signed by your surveyor. Here is the copy.
أيوه، موقّع من المساح بتاعكم. دي النسخة.
Good. Did you remove any unsuitable material in this zone?
كويس. شلتوا أي مواد غير صالحة في المنطقة دي؟
Yes, a small area near the south gate. David approved it last week.
أيوه، منطقة صغيرة جنب البوابة الجنوبية. ديفيد وافق عليها الأسبوع اللي فات.
Then we will measure it as a separate item.
That's fine. When can you send me your numbers?
By Thursday, before the payment application.

mcq.q: Where are they measuring today?
When was the cut finished?
Who surveyed the area?
When was the area surveyed?
Who signed the original ground survey?
Where was the unsuitable material?
Who approved the removal?
When was the removal approved?
How will the unsuitable material be measured?
When will Nadia send her numbers?

vocab.q: "a joint measurement" is a measurement done:

opts: Cannot be used for the work

vocab.q: "Could you say that again more slowly?" is used to:

read: We finished the cut in Zone D on Sunday.
The original ground survey is signed by your surveyor.
David approved the removal last week.
We will measure it as a separate item.
Can you send me your numbers by Thursday?

tasks.q: Explain to the consultant what evidence you have for the measurement.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح للاستشاري عندك أدلة إيه للقياس.
tasks.model: We finished the cut in Zone D on Sunday. Ali's team surveyed it on Monday, and the original ground survey is signed by your surveyor. Here is the copy.

tasks.q: Tell the consultant about extra work that was approved.
tasks.q_ar: قول للاستشاري عن شغل إضافي اتوافق عليه.
tasks.model: We removed some unsuitable material in a small area near the south gate. David approved it last week, so please measure it as a separate item.

tests.title: Level B1+ test — A disagreement about delay
dialogue: Hassan, your monthly report says Zone F is delayed by ten days. Why so much?
حسن، تقريركم الشهري بيقول منطقة F متأخرة عشر أيام. ليه كده كتير؟
Mainly because of the revised levels. The new drawing came three weeks late.
أساسًا بسبب المناسيب المعدّلة. الرسمة الجديدة جت متأخرة تلات أسابيع.
But you could work in other areas while you waited.
بس كان ممكن تشتغلوا في مناطق تانية وإنتو مستنيين.
We did. We moved two excavators to Zone G, but Zone F is on the critical path.
عملنا كده. نقلنا حفارين لمنطقة G، بس منطقة F على المسار الحرج.
I see. Was there any delay from your side?
فاهم. فيه أي تأخير من ناحيتكم؟
Yes, about two days because of a broken roller. I showed it separately in the report.
أيوه، حوالي يومين بسبب هراس عطلان. وضّحته لوحده في التقرير.
Thank you for being honest. Did you send a notice about the drawing?
شكرًا على صراحتك. بعتّوا إخطار بخصوص الرسمة؟
Yes, on the fifth, by letter and email.
Then I'll review your claim when you submit it.
We'll submit it next week, with the programme and the daily reports.
هنقدمها الأسبوع الجاي، بالبرنامج والتقارير اليومية.
Please make sure the dates match the drawing register.
اتأكد إن التواريخ مطابقة لسجل الرسومات لو سمحت.
Of course. I'll check every date before we send it.
طبعًا. هراجع كل تاريخ قبل ما نبعته.

mcq.q: How many days is Zone F delayed?
What is the main cause of the delay?
How late did the new drawing come?
Where did they move two excavators?
Why couldn't the other areas solve the problem?
opts: Zone F is on the critical path

mcq.q: How long was the delay from the contractor's side?
What caused the contractor's delay?
When was the notice sent?
When will the claim be submitted?
What must match the drawing register?

vocab.q: "on the critical path" means the activity:

opts: At the time of the event
I cannot be sure it will happen

read: The new drawing came three weeks late.
We moved two excavators, but Zone F is on the critical path.
I showed our own delay separately in the report.
We sent the notice on the fifth, by letter and email.
I will check every date before we send it.

tasks.q: Explain the cause of a delay and what you did about it.
tasks.q_ar: اشرح سبب تأخير وعملت إيه بخصوصه.
tasks.model: Zone F is delayed mainly because the revised drawing came three weeks late. We moved two excavators to other areas, but Zone F is on the critical path, so the delay remains.

tasks.q: Be honest about your own delay and explain your records.
tasks.q_ar: كن صريح عن تأخيركم واشرح سجلاتكم.
tasks.model: There was also about two days of delay from our side, because of a broken roller. I showed it separately in the report, and we have daily reports and a notice sent on time.

tests.title: Level B1+ test — Negotiating with a supplier
dialogue: Hassan, I've got your request for two more rollers.
Yes, for six weeks, starting next Sunday. Can you do it?
أيوه، لمدة ست أسابيع، من الأحد الجاي. تقدر؟
I can, but the rate is higher this month because demand is high.
أقدر، بس السعر أعلى الشهر ده عشان الطلب عالي.
About fifteen percent more than your current rollers.
حوالي خمستاشر في المية أكتر من الهراسات الحالية.
That's too much. We've been a good customer for two years.
ده كتير. إحنا عميل كويس بقالنا سنتين.
I know, and I value that. What do you suggest?
عارف، وأنا مقدّر ده. تقترح إيه؟
The same rate as our current rollers, and we extend the contract by one more month.
نفس سعر الهراسات الحالية، ونمدد العقد شهر كمان.
Same rate is difficult. I can do five percent more.
نفس السعر صعب. أقدر أعمل خمسة في المية زيادة.
Five percent with the operators included, and we have a deal.
خمسة في المية والسواقين معاها، ويبقى اتفقنا.
Fine. I'll send the revised quotation this afternoon.
ماشي. هبعت عرض السعر المعدّل بعد الضهر.
Thank you. Please include the delivery date.
شكرًا. حط تاريخ التوريد لو سمحت.

mcq.q: How many extra rollers does Hassan need?
For how long does he need them?
When should the hire start?
Why is the rate higher this month?
How much higher is the first price?
How long have they been a customer?
What does Hassan offer in return for the same rate?
opts: Extending the contract by one month

mcq.q: What increase does Hamid finally offer?
What extra condition does Hassan ask for?
What must the quotation include?

That is too much, we have been a good customer for two years.
What do you suggest to solve this?
Five percent with the operators included, and we have a deal.
Please include the delivery date in the quotation.

tasks.q: Respond to a supplier who wants a higher price.
tasks.q_ar: رد على مورد عايز سعر أعلى.
tasks.model: Fifteen percent is too much. We've been a good customer for two years. What if we keep the same rate and extend the contract by one more month?

tasks.q: Close a deal with a clear condition.
tasks.q_ar: اقفل اتفاق بشرط واضح.
tasks.model: Five percent more, with the operators included, and we have a deal. Please send the revised quotation this afternoon with the delivery date.

tests.title: Level B2 test — The rock claim meeting
dialogue: Hassan, I've read your notice about the rock in Zone H. Let's talk about the next steps.
حسن، قريت إخطاركم عن الصخر في منطقة H. خلينا نتكلم عن الخطوات الجاية.
Thank you. We'd like to agree the extent of the rock first, before we discuss time and cost.
شكرًا. حابين نتفق على امتداد الصخر الأول، قبل ما نتكلم عن الوقت والتكلفة.
Agreed. My surveyor recorded it with yours last Tuesday. It covers roughly two-thirds of the zone.
متفقين. المساح بتاعي سجّله مع بتاعكم التلات اللي فات. بيغطي حوالي تلتين المنطقة.
That matches our records. The question now is whether it was foreseeable.
ده مطابق لسجلاتنا. السؤال دلوقتي هل كان ممكن توقعه.
The employer's view is that a careful contractor would have investigated further during the tender.
رأي المالك إن مقاول حريص كان هيفحص أكتر في مدة المناقصة.
I understand that view, but the tender period was four weeks, and the nearest borehole showed only sand.
فاهم الرأي ده، بس مدة المناقصة كانت أربع أسابيع، وأقرب جسة كانت رمل بس.
That's a reasonable point. What about mitigation?
We moved the excavators to Zone G within a day and brought in a hydraulic breaker within a week.
نقلنا الحفارات لمنطقة G خلال يوم وجبنا كسارة هيدروليك خلال أسبوع.
Good. I'll need your daily production records to assess the cost.
كويس. هحتاج سجلات الإنتاج اليومية بتاعتكم عشان أقيّم التكلفة.
You'll have them on Sunday, together with the breaker hire invoices.
هتوصلك يوم الأحد، مع فواتير إيجار الكسارة.
Our programme analysis shows the rock has delayed completion. We'll submit it with the detailed claim.
تحليل البرنامج بتاعنا بيوضح إن الصخر أخّر الإنجاز. هنقدمه مع المطالبة التفصيلية.

mcq.q: What does Hassan want to agree first?

dialogue: Hassan, I'll be direct. If our payment isn't released this week, I'll have to pull my trucks off site.
حسن، هكون مباشر. لو دفعتنا ماتفكتش الأسبوع ده، هضطر أسحب عربياتي من الموقع.
I hear you, Faisal, and I don't want that to happen. Let's look at why it's held.
سامعك يا فيصل، ومش عايز ده يحصل. خلينا نشوف ليه متوقفة.
Your finance team says there's a problem with our invoice.
فريق المالية عندكم بيقول فيه مشكلة في فاتورتنا.
Yes, the quantities don't match our gate records for the second week of the month.
أيوه، الكميات مش مطابقة لسجلات البوابة عندنا للأسبوع التاني من الشهر.
I don't doubt that. But the difference is about one hundred trips, so we need to find out why.
أنا مش بشكك في ده. بس الفرق حوالي مية نقلة، فلازم نعرف ليه.
Let's pay the agreed part now, and check the disputed hundred trips with your GPS data.
خلينا ندفع الجزء المتفق عليه دلوقتي، ونراجع المية نقلة المختلف عليها ببيانات الجي بي إس بتاعتكم.
How much is the agreed part?
About ninety percent of the invoice. I can ask finance to release it by Thursday.
حوالي تسعين في المية من الفاتورة. أقدر أطلب من المالية تفكه قبل الخميس.
All right. That solves my cash problem. I'll send the GPS data tomorrow.
تمام. ده بيحل مشكلة الفلوس عندي. هبعت بيانات الجي بي إس بكرة.
Good. And please talk to me first next time, before any threat to leave the site.
كويس. واتكلم معايا الأول المرة الجاية، قبل أي تهديد بترك الموقع.

tests.title: Level B2+ test — The board presentation
dialogue: Hassan, the board wants a straight answer. Will Phase Two finish on time?
حسن، المجلس عايز إجابة مباشرة. المرحلة التانية هتخلص في ميعادها؟
The honest answer is: yes, if two decisions are made this month. Otherwise we're looking at a six-week slip.
الإجابة الصريحة: أيوه، لو قرارين اتاخدوا الشهر ده. غير كده بنتكلم عن تأخير ست أسابيع.
First, the design freeze for the road levels. Every revision so far has cost us around a week.
الأول، تجميد تصميم مناسيب الطرق. كل تعديل لحد دلوقتي كلّفنا حوالي أسبوع.
Approval of the treated material for the northern zones. Without it, we depend on a single borrow pit forty kilometres away.
اعتماد المادة المعالجة للمناطق الشمالية. من غيرها، بنعتمد على محجر واحد على بعد أربعين كيلو.
The board is nervous about the treated material.
Understandably. That's why we've offered twelve months of settlement monitoring at our own cost.
مفهوم. وعشان كده عرضنا اتناشر شهر مراقبة هبوط على حسابنا.
And if they say no anyway?
Then we'd need to double the haulage fleet, which adds cost and puts more trucks on public roads.
ساعتها هنحتاج نضاعف أسطول النقل، وده بيزوّد التكلفة ويحط عربيات أكتر على الطرق العامة.
So the real choice is between a small technical risk and a certain delay.
يعني الاختيار الحقيقي بين مخاطرة فنية صغيرة وتأخير أكيد.
Exactly. And the monitoring turns that small risk into a managed one.
بالظبط. والمراقبة بتحوّل المخاطرة الصغيرة دي لمخاطرة متحكم فيها.

tests.title: Level B2+ test — A fast phone call
dialogue: Hey Hassan, got a sec? Quick heads-up: we're tweaking the drainage in Zone K again.
أهلًا حسن، معاك ثانية؟ تنبيه سريع: هنعدّل التصريف في منطقة K تاني.
Again? Brian, we're already halfway through the final layer there.
تاني؟ يا برايان، إحنا خلاص في نص الطبقة الأخيرة هناك.
Yeah, I know, sorry. The utilities team found a clash with their main line.
أيوه عارف، آسف. فريق المرافق لقى تعارض مع خطهم الرئيسي.
OK. How big a change are we talking about?
The outlet moves about thirty metres east, and the falls change on two sections.
المخرج هيتنقل حوالي تلاتين متر شرق، والميول هتتغير في قطاعين.
Then we need to stop the final layer on those two sections today, before we waste any more work.
يبقى لازم نوقف الطبقة الأخيرة في القطاعين دول النهاردة، قبل ما نضيّع شغل أكتر.
Makes sense. Can you keep going elsewhere?
منطقي. تقدروا تكملوا في حتة تانية؟
Yes, we'll move the crew to the western sections. But I'll need the revision formally, through the engineer.
أيوه، هننقل الفريق للقطاعات الغربية. بس هحتاج التعديل رسمي، عن طريق المهندس.
Sure thing. I'll get it out by Wednesday.
And please note on the drawing which work is affected. We'll need it for the variation.
ولو سمحت وضّح على الرسمة أنهي شغل متأثر. هنحتاجه لأمر التغيير.
Will do. Sorry again for the hassle.
No worries. Better now than after we finish.
ولا يهمك. أحسن دلوقتي من بعد ما نخلّص.
